5.161.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ nāmni kṛte tasya bhāskarasyāṃśumālinaḥ ..
dvijānāṃ purataḥ puṣpaḥ kathayāmāsa ceṣṭitam .. 1 ..
5.161.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं नाम्नि कृते तस्य भास्करस्यांशुमालिनः ..
द्विजानां पुरतः पुष्पः कथयामास चेष्टितम् .. 1 ..
5.161.m:
Sūta said:
When the name of that radiant Sun was thus established,
Puṣpa related his deeds in the presence of the twice-born:

5.161.s:
ātmīyaṃ kutsitaṃ teṣāṃ maṇibhadravadho yathā ..
vihito vihitā patnī tasya vyājena kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 2 ..
5.161.d:
आत्मीयं कुत्सितं तेषां मणिभद्रवधो यथा ..
विहितो विहिता पत्नी तस्य व्याजेन कृत्स्नशः .. 2 ..
5.161.m:
His own vile deeds, how the slaying of Maṇibhadra was performed,
and how his wife was appropriated entirely by deception.

5.161.s:
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ procustacchrutvā kopasaṃyutāḥ ..
sītkārānpracurānkṛtvā dhiktvāṃ pāpa pragamyatām .. 3 ..
5.161.d:
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः प्रोचुस्तच्छ्रुत्वा कोपसंयुताः ..
सीत्कारान्प्रचुरान्कृत्वा धिक्त्वां पाप प्रगम्यताम् .. 3 ..
5.161.m:
Then those brahmins, hearing that, filled with anger,
making frequent hissing sounds [of dismay, said]: “Fie on you, sinner! Go away!

5.161.s: ātmīyaṃ hema cādāya na te śuddhirbhaviṣyati .. 4 ..
5.161.d: आत्मीयं हेम चादाय न ते शुद्धिर्भविष्यति .. 4 ..
5.161.m: Take your gold; there will be no purification for you.

5.161.s:
brahmaghnastvaṃ yataḥ proktāstrayo varṇā dvijottamāḥ ..
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ smṛtiśāstraprapāṭhakaiḥ .. 5 .. ..
5.161.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नस्त्वं यतः प्रोक्तास्त्रयो वर्णा द्विजोत्तमाः ..
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः स्मृतिशास्त्रप्रपाठकैः .. 5 .. ..
5.161.m:
For you are the killer of a brahmin, since the three varṇas are declared
to be twice-born, O best of brahmins—brahmin, kṣatriya, and vaiśya—by the expounders of the smṛti treatises.”

5.161.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatastu duḥkhitaḥ puṣpo bāṣpasaṃpūritekṣaṇaḥ ..
brahmasthānādvinirgatya praruroda suduḥkhitaḥ .. 6 ..
5.161.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततस्तु दुःखितः पुष्पो बाष्पसंपूरितेक्षणः ..
ब्रह्मस्थानाद्विनिर्गत्य प्ररुरोद सुदुःखितः .. 6 ..
5.161.m:
Sūta said:
Then, grieving, with eyes flooded with tears,
Puṣpa departed from the assembly of brahmins and wept in deep sorrow.

5.161.s:
rorūyamāṇamālokya tataste nāgarā dvijāḥ ..
dayāṃ ca mahatīṃ kṛtvā tataḥ procuḥ parasparam .. 7 ..
5.161.d:
रोरूयमाणमालोक्य ततस्ते नागरा द्विजाः ..
दयां च महतीं कृत्वा ततः प्रोचुः परस्परम् .. 7 ..
5.161.m:
Seeing him weeping profusely, those Nāgara brahmins,
taking great pity, then said to one another:

5.161.s:
nānāvidhāni śāstrāṇi smṛtayaśca pṛthagvidhāḥ ..
purāṇāni samastāni vīkṣadhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ .. 8 ..
5.161.d:
नानाविधानि शास्त्राणि स्मृतयश्च पृथग्विधाः ..
पुराणानि समस्तानि वीक्षध्वं सुसमाहिताः .. 8 ..
5.161.m:
“Examine attentively the various treatises of sacred law, the diverse smṛtis,
and all the Purāṇas.

5.161.s:
kutracitkvacidevāsya kathaṃcicchuddhirasti cet ..
na tacca vidyate śāstramasminsthāne na cāsti yat..9.. na smṛtirna purāṇaṃ ca vedāṃtaṃ vā dvijottamāḥ .. na cāsti brāhmaṇaḥ so'tra sarvajñapratimo na yaḥ .. 6.162.10 .. tasmāccintayata kṣipramasya śuddhipradaṃ hi yat ..
5.161.d:
कुत्रचित्क्वचिदेवास्य कथंचिच्छुद्धिरस्ति चेत् ..
न तच्च विद्यते शास्त्रमस्मिन्स्थाने न चास्ति यत्..9.. न स्मृतिर्न पुराणं च वेदांतं वा द्विजोत्तमाः .. न चास्ति ब्राह्मणः सोऽत्र सर्वज्ञप्रतिमो न यः .. 6.162.10 .. तस्माच्चिन्तयत क्षिप्रमस्य शुद्धिप्रदं हि यत् ..

5.161.s: tacca pramāṇatāṃ nītvā śuddhirasya pradīyate .. 11 ..
5.161.d: तच्च प्रमाणतां नीत्वा शुद्धिरस्य प्रदीयते .. 11 ..
5.161.m: and having established that as an authoritative means, let purification be granted to him.”

5.161.s:
athaiko brāhmaṇaḥ prāha caṃḍaśarmeti viśrutaḥ ..
mayā skāṃdapurāṇe'sminpuraścaraṇasaṃśritā ..12..
5.161.d:
अथैको ब्राह्मणः प्राह चंडशर्मेति विश्रुतः ..
मया स्कांदपुराणेऽस्मिन्पुरश्चरणसंश्रिता ..12..
5.161.m:
Then one brahmin, celebrated as Caṇḍaśarman, said:
“In this Skandapurāṇa, concerning the preparatory rite,

5.161.s:
paṭhitā saptamī yā ca puraścaraṇasaṃjñitā ..
puraścaraṇataḥ pāpaṃ vihitaṃ tu yathā vrajet .. 13 ..
5.161.d:
पठिता सप्तमी या च पुरश्चरणसंज्ञिता ..
पुरश्चरणतः पापं विहितं तु यथा व्रजेत् .. 13 ..
5.161.m:
the seventh lunar day named Puraścaraṇa has been studied by me,
by which a committed sin goes away through the preparatory rite.

5.161.s:
samyaktathāpi vipreṃdrāstato yāti na saṃśayaḥ ..
tasmātkarotu tāmeṣa puraścaraṇasaptamīm .. 14 ..
5.161.d:
सम्यक्तथापि विप्रेंद्रास्ततो याति न संशयः ..
तस्मात्करोतु तामेष पुरश्चरणसप्तमीम् .. 14 ..
5.161.m:
Even so, completely, O best of the brahmins, it departs from that; there is no doubt.
Therefore, let him observe that Puraścaraṇasaptamī.

5.161.s:
aparaṃ bhūbhujādeśānmaṇibhadro nipātitaḥ ..
vadhakaistasya tatpāpaṃ yadi pāpaṃ prajāyate .. 15 ..
5.161.d:
अपरं भूभुजादेशान्मणिभद्रो निपातितः ..
वधकैस्तस्य तत्पापं यदि पापं प्रजायते .. 15 ..
5.161.m:
Furthermore, Maṇibhadra was struck down by order of the king
by the executioners; that sin belongs to him, if any sin is produced.

5.161.s:
rājā bhūtvā na yaḥ samyagvicārayati vādinam ..
tasya tatpātakaṃ ghoraṃ rājñaścaiva prajāyate .. 16 ..
5.161.d:
राजा भूत्वा न यः सम्यग्विचारयति वादिनम् ..
तस्य तत्पातकं घोरं राज्ञश्चैव प्रजायते .. 16 ..
5.161.m:
When one becomes a king and does not properly judge a disputant,
that terrible sin belongs to that king alone.

5.161.s:
tathāsya patnyāstatpāpaṃ jānaṃtyā yattayoditam ..
matpitrā brāhmaṇairdatto'yaṃ purā vahnisaṃnidhau .. 17 ..
5.161.d:
तथास्य पत्न्यास्तत्पापं जानंत्या यत्तयोदितम् ..
मत्पित्रा ब्राह्मणैर्दत्तोऽयं पुरा वह्निसंनिधौ .. 17 ..
5.161.m:
Likewise, the sin of his wife, who knew what was said by her:
‘He was given by my father in the presence of brahmins and fire formerly.’

5.161.s:
viḍaṃbitena cānena kṛtapratikṛtaṃ kṛtam ..
tasmānna cāsya doṣaḥ syādyataḥ proktaṃ munīśvaraiḥ .. .. 18 ..
5.161.d:
विडंबितेन चानेन कृतप्रतिकृतं कृतम् ..
तस्मान्न चास्य दोषः स्याद्यतः प्रोक्तं मुनीश्वरैः .. .. 18 ..
5.161.m:
And by this deceived man, retaliation was merely made for what was done.
Therefore, no fault should attach to him, since it has been declared by the best of sages:

5.161.s:
kṛte pratikṛtaṃ kuryāddhiṃsane pratihiṃsanam ..
na tatra jāyate doṣo yo duṣṭe duṣṭamācaret.. 19 ..
5.161.d:
कृते प्रतिकृतं कुर्याद्धिंसने प्रतिहिंसनम् ..
न तत्र जायते दोषो यो दुष्टे दुष्टमाचरेत्.. 19 ..
5.161.m:
‘One should do retaliation for an act done, and counter-violence against violence;
no fault is incurred by him who behaves wickedly toward a wicked person.’ ”

5.161.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
yadyevaṃ vada viprāsya puraścaraṇasaṃjñitām ..
saptamīmadya vipreṃdra varākasya viśuddhaye .. 6.162.20 ..
5.161.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
यद्येवं वद विप्रास्य पुरश्चरणसंज्ञिताम् ..
सप्तमीमद्य विप्रेंद्र वराकस्य विशुद्धये .. 6.162.20 ..
5.161.m:
The brahmins said:
“If it is so, tell him now, O vipra, best of brahmins, of that seventh lunar day
named Puraścaraṇa, for the purification of that wretched man.”

5.161.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
athāsya kathayāmāsa saptamīṃ tāṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
caṃḍaśarmābhidhānastu kṛtvā tasyopari kṛpām .. 21 ..
5.161.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथास्य कथयामास सप्तमीं तां द्विजोत्तमाः ..
चंडशर्माभिधानस्तु कृत्वा तस्योपरि कृपाम् .. 21 ..
5.161.m:
Sūta said:
Then he who was named Caṇḍaśarman related that seventh lunar day to him, O best of the twice-born,
having taken pity upon him.

5.161.s:
tenāpi vihitā samyagyathā tasya mukhācchrutā ..
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte vipāpmā samapadyata .. 22 ..
5.161.d:
तेनापि विहिता सम्यग्यथा तस्य मुखाच्छ्रुता ..
ततः संवत्सरस्यांते विपाप्मा समपद्यत .. 22 ..
5.161.m:
It was duly observed by him just as heard from his mouth;
then, at the end of a year, he became free from sin.

5.161.s:
.. .. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
puraścaraṇasaṃjñāṃ tu saptamīṃ vada sūtaja ..
vidhinā kena kartavyā kasminkāla upasthite .. 23 ..
5.161.d:
.. .. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
पुरश्चरणसंज्ञां तु सप्तमीं वद सूतज ..
विधिना केन कर्तव्या कस्मिन्काल उपस्थिते .. 23 ..
5.161.m:
The ṛṣis said:
Speak, O son of Sūta, of that seventh lunar day named Puraścaraṇa:
by what rite should it be performed, and when the time has arrived?

5.161.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi rohitāśvasya bhūpateḥ ..
mārkaṃḍena purā proktā pṛcchayamānena bhaktitaḥ .. 24 ..
5.161.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अहं वः कीर्तयिष्यामि रोहिताश्वस्य भूपतेः ..
मार्कंडेन पुरा प्रोक्ता पृच्छयमानेन भक्तितः .. 24 ..
5.161.m: Sūta said: / I shall narrate to you [that which was] spoken of old to King Rohitāśva / by Mārkaṇḍeya, when asked with devotion.

5.161.s:
saptakalpasmaro viprā mārkaṃḍākhyo mahāmuniḥ ..
rohitāśvena pṛṣṭaḥ sa hariścaṃdrātmajena ca .. 25 ..
5.161.d:
सप्तकल्पस्मरो विप्रा मार्कंडाख्यो महामुनिः ..
रोहिताश्वेन पृष्टः स हरिश्चंद्रात्मजेन च .. 25 ..
5.161.m: O brahmins, that great sage named Mārkaṇḍa, who remembers seven cosmic ages, / was asked by Rohitāśva, the son of Hariścandra.

5.161.s:
.. rohitāśva uvāca .. ..
ajñānājjñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
upāyaṃ tasya nāśāya kiṃcinme vada sanmune .. 26 ..
5.161.d:
.. रोहिताश्व उवाच .. ..
अज्ञानाज्ज्ञानतो वापि यत्पापं कुरुते नरः ..
उपायं तस्य नाशाय किंचिन्मे वद सन्मुने .. 26 ..
5.161.m: Rohitāśva said: / Whatever sin a man commits, whether unknowingly or knowingly, / tell me some means for its destruction, O virtuous sage.

5.161.s:
.. mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ caiva kāyikaṃ ca tṛtīyakam ..
trividhaṃ pātakaṃ loke narāṇāmiha jāyate .. 27 ..
5.161.d:
.. मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
मानसं वाचिकं चैव कायिकं च तृतीयकम् ..
त्रिविधं पातकं लोके नराणामिह जायते .. 27 ..
5.161.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Mental, vocal, and thirdly bodily— / threefold is the sin that arises here among men in the world.

5.161.s:
tatropāyā vināśāya tasya saṃparikīrtitāḥ ..
tānahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva nṛpasattama .. 28 ..
5.161.d:
तत्रोपाया विनाशाय तस्य संपरिकीर्तिताः ..
तानहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व नृपसत्तम .. 28 ..
5.161.m: The means for its destruction are fully proclaimed there; / I shall declare them to you; listen, O best of kings.

5.161.s:
mānasaṃ caiva yatpāpaṃ narāṇāmiha jāyate ..
paścāttāpe kṛte tasya tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati .. 29 ..
5.161.d:
मानसं चैव यत्पापं नराणामिह जायते ..
पश्चात्तापे कृते तस्य तत्क्षणादेव नश्यति .. 29 ..
5.161.m: As for mental sin that arises here among men, / when repentance is made for it, it is destroyed that very instant.

5.161.s:
vācikaṃ caiva yatpāpaṃ nābhuktvā tatpraṇaśyati ..
puraścaraṇabāhyaṃ tu satyametanmayoditam .. .. 6.162.30 ..
5.161.d:
वाचिकं चैव यत्पापं नाभुक्त्वा तत्प्रणश्यति ..
पुरश्चरणबाह्यं तु सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. .. 6.162.30 ..
5.161.m: And vocal sin is not destroyed without being experienced, / except by a preparatory rite; this truth has been uttered by me.

5.161.s:
nivedya brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ taduktaṃ ca samācaret ..
prāyaścittaṃ yathoktaṃ tu tataḥ śuddhimavāpnuyāt .. 31 ..
5.161.d:
निवेद्य ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां तदुक्तं च समाचरेत् ..
प्रायश्चित्तं यथोक्तं तु ततः शुद्धिमवाप्नुयात् .. 31 ..
5.161.m: Having reported it to the foremost of brahmins, one should perform what they direct; / through the expiation as prescribed, one then attains purification.

5.161.s:
athavā pārthivo jñātvā kurute tasya nigra ham ..
tena śuddhimavāproti yadyapi syātsa kilviṣī .. 32 ..
5.161.d:
अथवा पार्थिवो ज्ञात्वा कुरुते तस्य निग्र हम् ..
तेन शुद्धिमवाप्रोति यद्यपि स्यात्स किल्विषी .. 32 ..
5.161.m: Or, if the earthly king learns of it and inflicts punishment upon him, / through that he attains purification, even though he may be a sinner.

5.161.s:
lajjayā brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ yo na brūte kathaṃcana ..
na ca rājā vijānāti śarīrasthena yo mriyet ..
tasya nigrahakartā ca svayaṃ vaivasvato yamaḥ .. 33 ..
5.161.d:
लज्जया ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां यो न ब्रूते कथंचन ..
न च राजा विजानाति शरीरस्थेन यो म्रियेत् ..
तस्य निग्रहकर्ता च स्वयं वैवस्वतो यमः .. 33 ..
5.161.m: He who out of shame never speaks of it to the foremost of brahmins, / nor does the king find out, and he dies with it remaining in his body— / Yama, son of Vivasvat, is himself the inflictor of punishment upon him.

5.161.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kṛtvā pāpaṃ vijānatā ..
prāyaścittaṃ tu kartavyaṃ yathoktaṃ brāhmaṇo ditam .. 34 ..
5.161.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कृत्वा पापं विजानता ..
प्रायश्चित्तं तु कर्तव्यं यथोक्तं ब्राह्मणो दितम् .. 34 ..
5.161.m: Therefore, by every effort, when sin has been committed by one who is aware, / an expiation must be performed as prescribed, declared by the brahmins.

5.161.s:
.. rohitāśva uvāca .. ..
sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ vihitānāṃ munīśvara ..
kiṃcidvrataṃ samācakṣva dānaṃ vā homameva vā ..
vipāpmā jāyate yena puraścaraṇavarjitam .. 35 ..
5.161.d:
.. रोहिताश्व उवाच .. ..
सर्वेषामेव पापानां विहितानां मुनीश्वर ..
किंचिद्व्रतं समाचक्ष्व दानं वा होममेव वा ..
विपाप्मा जायते येन पुरश्चरणवर्जितम् .. 35 ..
5.161.m: Rohitāśva said: / For all sins that have been committed, O lord of sages, / declare some observance, or gift, or indeed a burnt offering, / by which, without a preparatory rite, one becomes freed from sin.

5.161.s:
nityaṃ pāpāni kurute naraḥ sūkṣmāṇi sarvataḥ ..
prāyaścittāni sarveṣāṃ kartuṃ śaktiḥ kathaṃ bhavet .. 36 .. ..
5.161.d:
नित्यं पापानि कुरुते नरः सूक्ष्माणि सर्वतः ..
प्रायश्चित्तानि सर्वेषां कर्तुं शक्तिः कथं भवेत् .. 36 .. ..
5.161.m: A man constantly commits subtle sins on every side; / how could there be the power to perform expiations for them all?

5.161.s:
.. mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
asti rājanvrataṃ puṇyaṃ puraścaraṇasaṃjñitam ..
puraścaraṇasaṃjñā tu saptamī sūryavallabhā .. 37 ..
5.161.d:
.. मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
अस्ति राजन्व्रतं पुण्यं पुरश्चरणसंज्ञितम् ..
पुरश्चरणसंज्ञा तु सप्तमी सूर्यवल्लभा .. 37 ..
5.161.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / There is, O king, a holy observance called Puraścaraṇa; / the seventh [lunar day], beloved of the Sun, is designated as Puraścaraṇa,

5.161.s:
yayā saṃcīrṇayā rāja nkāyastho yamasaṃbhavaḥ ..
vicitro mārjayetpāpaṃ kṛtaṃ janmani saṃcitam .. 38..
5.161.d:
यया संचीर्णया राज न्कायस्थो यमसंभवः ..
विचित्रो मार्जयेत्पापं कृतं जन्मनि संचितम् .. 38..
5.161.m: by performing which, O king, Citragupta, the scribe born of Yama, / wipes away the sin committed and accumulated throughout life.

5.161.s:
tasmātkuru mahārāja tathāśu vacanaṃ mama ..
yena vā mucyate pāpā tsarvasmātkāyasaṃbhavāt .. 39 ..
5.161.d:
तस्मात्कुरु महाराज तथाशु वचनं मम ..
येन वा मुच्यते पापा त्सर्वस्मात्कायसंभवात् .. 39 ..
5.161.m: Therefore, O great king, quickly act according to my word, / whereby one is freed from all sin arising from the body.

5.161.s:
.. rohitāśva uvāca .. ..
puraścaraṇasaṃjñā tu saptamī munisattama ..
vidhinā kena kartavyā kasminkāle vada sva me .. 6.162.40 ..
5.161.d:
.. रोहिताश्व उवाच .. ..
पुरश्चरणसंज्ञा तु सप्तमी मुनिसत्तम ..
विधिना केन कर्तव्या कस्मिन्काले वद स्व मे .. 6.162.40 ..
5.161.m: Rohitāśva said: / By what procedure is the seventh lunar day called Puraścaraṇa to be observed, / and at what time, O best of sages? Tell me.

5.161.s:
.. mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
māghamāse site pakṣe makarasthe divākare ..
sūryavāreṇa saptamyāṃ vratametatsamācaret .. 41 ..
5.161.d:
.. मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
माघमासे सिते पक्षे मकरस्थे दिवाकरे ..
सूर्यवारेण सप्तम्यां व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत् .. 41 ..
5.161.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In the month of Māgha, during the bright fortnight, when the Sun is in Capricorn, / on a Sunday on the seventh lunar day, one should undertake this observance.

5.161.s:
pākhaṃḍaiḥ patitaiḥ sārdhaṃ tasminnahani nālapet ..
bhakṣayitvā nṛpaśreṣṭha prabhāte dantadhāvanam ..
maṃtreṇānena paścācca kartavyo niyamo nṛpa .. 42 ..
5.161.d:
पाखंडैः पतितैः सार्धं तस्मिन्नहनि नालपेत् ..
भक्षयित्वा नृपश्रेष्ठ प्रभाते दन्तधावनम् ..
मंत्रेणानेन पश्चाच्च कर्तव्यो नियमो नृप .. 42 ..
5.161.m: On that day one should not converse with heretics or fallen persons. / Having cleaned one's teeth at dawn, O best of kings, / a vow is then to be made with this mantra, O king:

5.161.s:
puraścaraṇakṛtyāyāṃ saptamyāṃ divasādhipa ..
upavāsaṃ kariṣyāmi adya tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ mama ..43..
5.161.d:
पुरश्चरणकृत्यायां सप्तम्यां दिवसाधिप ..
उपवासं करिष्यामि अद्य त्वं शरणं मम ..43..
5.161.m: “On the seventh [lunar day] dedicated to the preparatory rite, O lord of the day, / I shall fast; today you are my refuge.”

5.161.s:
tato'parāhṇasamaye snātvā dhautāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ ..
pratimāṃ pūjayedbhaktyā dinādhipasamudbhavām ..44..
5.161.d:
ततोऽपराह्णसमये स्नात्वा धौतांबरः शुचिः ..
प्रतिमां पूजयेद्भक्त्या दिनाधिपसमुद्भवाम् ..44..
5.161.m: Then in the afternoon, having bathed and wearing washed clothes, being pure, / one should worship with devotion an image of the lord of day.

5.161.s:
raktaiḥ puṣpairmahāvīra pādādyaṃ pūjayettataḥ ..
pataṃgāya namaḥ pādau mārtaṃḍāyeti jānunī .. 45 ..
5.161.d:
रक्तैः पुष्पैर्महावीर पादाद्यं पूजयेत्ततः ..
पतंगाय नमः पादौ मार्तंडायेति जानुनी .. 45 ..
5.161.m: With red flowers, O mighty hero, one should then worship beginning with the feet: / [saying] “Salutations to Pataṅga” for the feet, and “to Mārtaṇḍa” for the knees;

5.161.s:
guhyaṃ divasanāthāya nābhiṃ dvādaśa mūrtaye ..
bāhū ca padmahastāya hṛdayaṃ tīkṣṇadīdhite .. 46 ..
5.161.d:
गुह्यं दिवसनाथाय नाभिं द्वादश मूर्तये ..
बाहू च पद्महस्ताय हृदयं तीक्ष्णदीधिते .. 46 ..
5.161.m: “to the Lord of Day” for the private parts; “to the Twelve-formed One” for the navel; / “to the Lotus-handed One” for the arms; and “to the Sharp-rayed One” for the heart;

5.161.s:
kaṃṭhaṃ padmadalābhāya śirastejomayāya ca ..
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivaddhūpaṃ karpūramādadet .. .. 47 ..
5.161.d:
कंठं पद्मदलाभाय शिरस्तेजोमयाय च ..
एवं संपूज्य विधिवद्धूपं कर्पूरमाददेत् .. .. 47 ..
5.161.m: “to the One with the lustre of a lotus petal” for the neck; and “to the Luminous One” for the head. / Having thus worshipped according to the rule, one should offer incense and camphor,

5.161.s:
guḍaudanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ raktavastrābhiveṣṭitam ..
raktasūtreṇa dīpaṃ ca tathaivārārtikaṃ nṛpa .. 48 ..
5.161.d:
गुडौदनं च नैवेद्यं रक्तवस्त्राभिवेष्टितम् ..
रक्तसूत्रेण दीपं च तथैवारार्तिकं नृप .. 48 ..
5.161.m: and boiled rice with jaggery wrapped in a red cloth as the food-offering, / a lamp with a red wick, and likewise the waving of lights, O king.

5.161.s:
śaṃkhe toyaṃ samādāya raktacandanamiśritam ..
saphalaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā arghyaṃ dadyāttataḥ param .. 49 ..
5.161.d:
शंखे तोयं समादाय रक्तचन्दनमिश्रितम् ..
सफलं च ततः कृत्वा अर्घ्यं दद्यात्ततः परम् .. 49 ..
5.161.m: Taking water in a conch mixed with red sandalwood paste, / and making it accompanied by fruit, one should thereafter offer the water of honour:

5.161.s:
kukṛtaṃ yatkṛtaṃ kiṃcidajñānājjñānato'pi vā ..
prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ deva mamārghyaśca pragṛhyatām .. 6.162.50 ..
5.161.d:
कुकृतं यत्कृतं किंचिदज्ञानाज्ज्ञानतोऽपि वा ..
प्रायश्चित्तं कृतं देव ममार्घ्यश्च प्रगृह्यताम् .. 6.162.50 ..
5.161.m: “Whatever wrong has been done, whether out of ignorance or even knowledge, / expiation has been made, O Lord; may my water of honour be accepted.”

5.161.s:
tataḥ saṃpūjayadvipraṃ gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ..
dattvā tu bhojanaṃ tasmai dakṣiṇāṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ ..
prāśanaṃ kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ pañcagavyasya cācaret . 51 ..
5.161.d:
ततः संपूजयद्विप्रं गन्धपुष्पानुलेपनैः ..
दत्त्वा तु भोजनं तस्मै दक्षिणां च स्वशक्तितः ..
प्राशनं कायशुद्ध्यर्थं पञ्चगव्यस्य चाचरेत् . 51 ..
5.161.m: Then one should honour a brahmin with scents, flowers, and unctions, / and having given food to him and a priestly gift according to one's means, / one should perform the sipping of the five bovine products for the purification of the body.

5.161.s:
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā samudvīkṣya divākaram..
divākaraṃ gataścaiva mantrametaṃ samuccaret .. 52 ..
5.161.d:
कृतांजलिपुटो भूत्वा समुद्वीक्ष्य दिवाकरम्..
दिवाकरं गतश्चैव मन्त्रमेतं समुच्चरेत् .. 52 ..
5.161.m: Having folded one's hands in reverence and looking up at the Sun, / turning toward the Sun, one should recite this mantra:

5.161.s:
idaṃ vrataṃ mayā deva gṛhītaṃ puratastava ..
avighnaṃ siddhimāyātu prasādāttava bhāskara .. 53 ..
5.161.d:
इदं व्रतं मया देव गृहीतं पुरतस्तव ..
अविघ्नं सिद्धिमायातु प्रसादात्तव भास्कर .. 53 ..
5.161.m: “This observance has been undertaken by me before you, O Lord; / may it reach unhindered completion through your grace, O Bhāskara.”

5.161.s:
tataśca phālgune māsi saṃprāpte munisattama ..
kundena pūjayeddevaṃ tenaiva vidhinā tataḥ .. 54 ..
5.161.d:
ततश्च फाल्गुने मासि संप्राप्ते मुनिसत्तम ..
कुन्देन पूजयेद्देवं तेनैव विधिना ततः .. 54 ..
5.161.m: And then when the month of Phālguna arrives, O best of sages, / one should worship the God with jasmine by that very same procedure.

5.161.s:
dhūpaṃ ca gugguluṃ dadyānnaivedyaṃ bhaktameva ca ..
prāśanaṃ gomayaṃ proktaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye .. 55 ..
5.161.d:
धूपं च गुग्गुलुं दद्यान्नैवेद्यं भक्तमेव च ..
प्राशनं गोमयं प्रोक्तं सर्वपापविशुद्धये .. 55 ..
5.161.m: One should offer bdellium as incense, and cooked rice as the food-offering; / the sipping of cow-dung is prescribed for the purification of all sins.

5.161.s:
caitre māsi tu saṃprāpte surabhyā pūjyeddharim ..
naivedyaṃ guṇikāḥ proktā dhūpaṃ sarjarasodbhavam .. 56 ..
5.161.d:
चैत्रे मासि तु संप्राप्ते सुरभ्या पूज्येद्धरिम् ..
नैवेद्यं गुणिकाः प्रोक्ता धूपं सर्जरसोद्भवम् .. 56 ..
5.161.m: And when the month of Caitra arrives, one should worship the Sun with fragrant flowers; / rolls of sweets are prescribed as the food-offering, and incense made from sal-resin.

5.161.s:
kuśodakaṃ ca saṃprāśya kāyaśuddhimavāpnuyāt ..
vaiśākhe kiṃśukaiḥ pūjāṃ yathāvacca ghṛtāśanaiḥ .. 57 ..
5.161.d:
कुशोदकं च संप्राश्य कायशुद्धिमवाप्नुयात् ..
वैशाखे किंशुकैः पूजां यथावच्च घृताशनैः .. 57 ..
5.161.m: And having sipped kuśa-water, one attains purification of the body. / In Vaiśākha, worship with kiṃśuka flowers and with offerings consumed by fire according to the rule;

5.161.s:
naivedyaṃ ca surāmāṃsaṃ dhūpaṃ ca vinivedayet ..
dadhiprāśanamevātra kartavyaṃ kāyaśuddhaye .. 58 ..
5.161.d:
नैवेद्यं च सुरामांसं धूपं च विनिवेदयेत् ..
दधिप्राशनमेवात्र कर्तव्यं कायशुद्धये .. 58 ..
5.161.m: and one should present […] as food-offering and incense; / sipping curd alone is to be performed here for the purification of the body.

5.161.s:
puṣpapāṭalayā pūjā vidhātavyā ravernṛpa ..
naivedye saktavaḥ proktāḥ prāśanaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ smṛtam .. 59 ..
5.161.d:
पुष्पपाटलया पूजा विधातव्या रवेर्नृप ..
नैवेद्ये सक्तवः प्रोक्ताः प्राशनं च घृतं स्मृतम् .. 59 ..
5.161.m: The worship of the Sun is to be performed with trumpet-flowers, O king; / roasted barley-meal is prescribed as the food-offering, and sipping ghee is remembered [as the rule],

5.161.s:
kapilāyā mahāvīra sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ..
āṣāḍhe munipuṣpaiśca pūjayedbhāskaraṃ nṛpa .. 6.162.60 ..
5.161.d:
कपिलाया महावीर सर्वपापविशुद्धये ..
आषाढे मुनिपुष्पैश्च पूजयेद्भास्करं नृप .. 6.162.60 ..
5.161.m: [ghee] from a tawny cow, O mighty hero, for the purification of all sins. / In Āṣāḍha, one should worship the Sun with sage-flowers, O king;

5.161.s:
naivedye ghārikā proktā prāśanaṃ madhusarpiṣoḥ ..
dhūpaṃ caivāgaruṃ dadyātparayā śraddhayā yutaḥ .. 61 ..
5.161.d:
नैवेद्ये घारिका प्रोक्ता प्राशनं मधुसर्पिषोः ..
धूपं चैवागरुं दद्यात्परया श्रद्धया युतः .. 61 ..
5.161.m: fried cakes are prescribed as the food-offering, and the sipping of honey and ghee; / and endowed with supreme faith, one should offer agallochum as incense.

5.161.s:
śrāvaṇe tu kadaṃbena pūjanaṃ tīkṣṇadīdhiteḥ ..
naivedye modakāścaiva tagaraṃ dhūpa mādadet .. 62 ..
5.161.d:
श्रावणे तु कदंबेन पूजनं तीक्ष्णदीधितेः ..
नैवेद्ये मोदकाश्चैव तगरं धूप माददेत् .. 62 ..
5.161.m: In Śrāvaṇa, the worship of the Sharp-rayed One is with kadamba flowers; / modakas are for the food-offering, and one should take tagara as incense.

5.161.s:
gośṛṃgodakamādāya sadyaḥ pāpātpramucyate ..
jātyā bhādrapade pūjā kṣīranaivedyamādadet .. 63 ..
dhūpaṃ nakhasamudbhūtaṃ prāśanaṃ kṣīrameva ca ..
āśvine kamalaiḥ pūjā naivedye ghṛtapūrikā .. 64 ..
5.161.d:
गोशृंगोदकमादाय सद्यः पापात्प्रमुच्यते ..
जात्या भाद्रपदे पूजा क्षीरनैवेद्यमाददेत् .. 63 ..
धूपं नखसमुद्भूतं प्राशनं क्षीरमेव च ..
आश्विने कमलैः पूजा नैवेद्ये घृतपूरिका .. 64 ..
5.161.m: Consuming water washed over a cow's horn, one is immediately freed from sin. / In Bhādrapada, the worship is with royal jasmine; one should offer milk-rice as the food-offering, / / incense produced from nakha, and the sipping of milk alone. / In Āśvina, the worship is with lotuses, and ghee-pancake is the food-offering.

5.161.s: dhūpaṃ kuṃkumajaṃ proktaṃ karpūraprāśanaṃ smṛtam .. 65 ..
5.161.d: धूपं कुंकुमजं प्रोक्तं कर्पूरप्राशनं स्मृतम् .. 65 ..
5.161.m: Incense made from saffron is prescribed; the consumption of camphor is remembered.

5.161.s:
tulasyā kārtike pūjā bhāskarasya prakīrtitā ..
naivedye caiva khaṃḍākhyaṃ dhūpaṃ kausuṃbhikaṃ nṛpa .. 66 ..
5.161.d:
तुलस्या कार्तिके पूजा भास्करस्य प्रकीर्तिता ..
नैवेद्ये चैव खंडाख्यं धूपं कौसुंभिकं नृप .. 66 ..
5.161.m: In the month of Kārtika, worship of the Sun is proclaimed [to be performed] with tulasī. / And for the food offering, candy sugar; [and] the incense made of safflower, O king.

5.161.s:
prāśanaṃ ca lavaṃgākhyaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhanam ..
bhṛṃgarājena pūjā ca saumye māsi samācaret .. 67 ..
5.161.d:
प्राशनं च लवंगाख्यं सर्वपापविशोधनम् ..
भृंगराजेन पूजा च सौम्ये मासि समाचरेत् .. 67 ..
5.161.m: And the consumption [of an offering] called clove purifies all sins. / In the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, one should perform worship with bhṛṅgarāja.

5.161.s:
naivedye pheṇikā deyā dhūpaṃ guḍasamudbhavam ..
kaṃkolaprāśanaṃ caiva bhāskarasya pratuṣṭaye .. 68 ..
5.161.d:
नैवेद्ये फेणिका देया धूपं गुडसमुद्भवम् ..
कंकोलप्राशनं चैव भास्करस्य प्रतुष्टये .. 68 ..
5.161.m: For the food offering, pheṇikā cakes should be given, and incense produced from molasses; / and the consumption of kaṅkola, for the satisfaction of the Sun.

5.161.s:
śatapatrikayā pūjā pauṣe māsi raveḥ smṛtā ..
sahajaṃ dhūpamādiṣṭaṃ naivedye śuṣkalī tathā .. 69 ..
5.161.d:
शतपत्रिकया पूजा पौषे मासि रवेः स्मृता ..
सहजं धूपमादिष्टं नैवेद्ये शुष्कली तथा .. 69 ..
5.161.m: In the month of Pauṣa, worship of the Sun is remembered [to be done] with the hundred-petalled rose; / natural incense is ordained, and likewise śuṣkalī cakes for the food offering.

5.161.s:
prāśane pūrvamuktāni sarvāṇyeva samācaret ..
samāptau ca tato dadyātṣaḍbhāgaṃ gṛhasaṃbhavam .. 6.162.70 ..
5.161.d:
प्राशने पूर्वमुक्तानि सर्वाण्येव समाचरेत् ..
समाप्तौ च ततो दद्यात्षड्भागं गृहसंभवम् .. 6.162.70 ..
5.161.m: For the consumption, one should perform all that were mentioned before. / And upon completion, one should then give a sixth part of what is in the house,

5.161.s:
brāhmaṇāya nṛpaśreṣṭha sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ..
iṣṭabhojyaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ svaśaktyā pārthivottama .. 71 ..
5.161.d:
ब्राह्मणाय नृपश्रेष्ठ सर्वपापविशुद्धये ..
इष्टभोज्यं ततः कार्यं स्वशक्त्या पार्थिवोत्तम .. 71 ..
5.161.m: to a brahmin, O best of kings, for the complete purification of all sins. / Then feasts of desired foods should be provided according to one's means, O best of monarchs.

5.161.s:
evaṃ tu kurute yo'tra saptamīṃ bhāskarodbhavām ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto nirmalatvaṃ sa gacchati .. 72 ..
5.161.d:
एवं तु कुरुते योऽत्र सप्तमीं भास्करोद्भवाम् ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो निर्मलत्वं स गच्छति .. 72 ..
5.161.m: Whoever performs in this manner the seventh lunar day sacred to the Sun here, / freed from all sins, he attains purity.

5.161.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
evaṃ purā vai kathitā rohitāśvāya dhīmate ..
mārkaṃḍena mahābhāga tasmāttvamapi tāṃ kuru .. 73 ..
5.161.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
एवं पुरा वै कथिता रोहिताश्वाय धीमते ..
मार्कंडेन महाभाग तस्मात्त्वमपि तां कुरु .. 73 ..
5.161.m: The brahmins said: / "Thus was it told of old to the wise Rohitāśva / by Mārkaṇḍeya, O fortunate one; therefore, you too perform it,

5.161.s: yena saṃjāyate samyakpuraścaraṇameva te .. 74 ..
5.161.d: येन संजायते सम्यक्पुरश्चरणमेव ते .. 74 ..
5.161.m: by which your preliminary rite will be properly accomplished."

5.161.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā puṣpo'pi dvijasattamāḥ ..
tāṃ cakre saptamīṃ hṛṣṭo yathā tena niveditā .. 75 ..
5.161.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पुष्पोऽपि द्विजसत्तमाः ..
तां चक्रे सप्तमीं हृष्टो यथा तेन निवेदिता .. 75 ..
5.161.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of his, Puṣpa too, O best of twice-born, / delighted, observed that seventh lunar day just as it was taught by him.

5.161.s:
ṣaḍbhāgaṃ pradadau tasmai brāhmaṇāya mahātmane ..
svavittasya gṛhasthasya kupyākupyasya kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 76 ..
5.161.d:
षड्भागं प्रददौ तस्मै ब्राह्मणाय महात्मने ..
स्ववित्तस्य गृहस्थस्य कुप्याकुप्यस्य कृत्स्नशः .. 76 ..
5.161.m: He gave a sixth part to that great-souled brahmin, / of his own wealth, consisting of house, base and precious metal, in its entirety.

5.161.s:
so'pi jagrāha tadvittaṃ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ..
suvarṇamaṇi ratnāni saṃkhyayā parivarjitam .. 77 ..
5.161.d:
सोऽपि जग्राह तद्वित्तं प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना ..
सुवर्णमणि रत्नानि संख्यया परिवर्जितम् .. 77 ..
5.161.m: He too accepted that wealth with a joyous heart— / gold, jewels, and precious stones beyond count.

5.161.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye puraścaraṇasaptamīvratavidhānavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 162 ..
5.161.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुरश्चरणसप्तमीव्रतविधानवर्णनंनाम द्विषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 162 ..
5.161.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-second chapter, named 'Description of the Ritual Rules for the Puraścaraṇasaptamī Vow' in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.162.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha te nāgarāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tadvittabhājanam ..
na kenāpi grahītavyaṃ sarvānkāmānnirasya ca .. 1 ..
5.162.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ ते नागराः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा तद्वित्तभाजनम् ..
न केनापि ग्रहीतव्यं सर्वान्कामान्निरस्य च .. 1 ..
5.162.m: Sūta said: / Then all those Nāgara brahmins, seeing him as the recipient of that wealth / which ought not to be taken by anyone, casting aside all desires,

5.162.s:
tataste samayaṃ kṛtvā samānīya ca madhyagam ..
tasyāsyena tataḥ procurbrahmasthāne vyavasthi tāḥ .. 2 ..
5.162.d:
ततस्ते समयं कृत्वा समानीय च मध्यगम् ..
तस्यास्येन ततः प्रोचुर्ब्रह्मस्थाने व्यवस्थि ताः .. 2 ..
5.162.m: having formed an agreement and brought in an arbitrator, / then spoke through his mouth, stationed at the Brahmasthāna:

5.162.s:
anena lobhayuktena tiraskṛtya dvijottamān ..
puṣpavittamupādāya prāyaścittaṃ prakīrtitam .. 3 ..
5.162.d:
अनेन लोभयुक्तेन तिरस्कृत्य द्विजोत्तमान् ..
पुष्पवित्तमुपादाय प्रायश्चित्तं प्रकीर्तितम् .. 3 ..
5.162.m: "By this man, overcome with greed, scorning the best of twice-born / and taking Puṣpa's wealth, an expiation has been declared.

5.162.s:
tathā caiva tu ṣaḍbhāgo gṛhīto vibhavasya ca ..
tasmādeṣa samastānāṃ bāhyabhūto bhaviṣyati .. 4 ..
5.162.d:
तथा चैव तु षड्भागो गृहीतो विभवस्य च ..
तस्मादेष समस्तानां बाह्यभूतो भविष्यति .. 4 ..
5.162.m: And likewise a sixth part of the wealth was accepted; / therefore he shall be cast out from all

5.162.s: nāgarāṇāṃ dvijedrāṇāṃ yathānyaḥ prākṛtastathā .. 5 ..
5.162.d: नागराणां द्विजेद्राणां यथान्यः प्राकृतस्तथा .. 5 ..
5.162.m: the Nāgara foremost of twice-born, just like an ordinary outcast.

5.162.s:
adyaprabhṛti cānena yaḥ saṃbaṃdhaṃ kariṣyati ..
so'pi bāhyastu sarveṣāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ bhaviṣyati .. 6 ..
5.162.d:
अद्यप्रभृति चानेन यः संबंधं करिष्यति ..
सोऽपि बाह्यस्तु सर्वेषां नागराणां भविष्यति .. 6 ..
5.162.m: From this day forward, whoever makes an alliance with him / shall also be cast out from all the Nāgaras.

5.162.s:
bhojanaṃ vātha pānīyaṃ yo'sya sadmani karhicit ..
kariṣyati sa cā'pyevaṃ patitaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati .. 7 ..
5.162.d:
भोजनं वाथ पानीयं योऽस्य सद्मनि कर्हिचित् ..
करिष्यति स चाऽप्येवं पतितः संभविष्यति .. 7 ..
5.162.m: Whoever at any time takes food or water / in his house, he likewise will become fallen."

5.162.s:
evamuktvā tatastena dattaṃ tālatrayaṃ dvijāḥ ..
brahmasthāne dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛtvā puṣpasamaṃ ca tam .. 8 ..
5.162.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततस्तेन दत्तं तालत्रयं द्विजाः ..
ब्रह्मस्थाने द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कृत्वा पुष्पसमं च तम् .. 8 ..
5.162.m: Having said this, three handclaps were then given by him, O twice-born, / at the Brahmasthāna, O best of twice-born, making him an outcast like Puṣpa.

5.162.s:
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve jagmuḥ svaṃsvaṃ niveśanam ..
caṃḍaśarmā sa codvignaḥ puṣpapārśvaṃ tadā gataḥ .. 9 ..
5.162.d:
अथ ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे जग्मुः स्वंस्वं निवेशनम् ..
चंडशर्मा स चोद्विग्नः पुष्पपार्श्वं तदा गतः .. 9 ..
5.162.m: Then all those brahmins went to their respective dwellings; / and Caṇḍaśarman, anxious, went to Puṣpa's presence at that time:

5.162.s:
eteṣāmeva sarveṣāṃ saṃmatena mayā tava ..
prāyaścittaṃ tadā dattaṃ tathā pi patitaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 6.163.10 ..
5.162.d:
एतेषामेव सर्वेषां संमतेन मया तव ..
प्रायश्चित्तं तदा दत्तं तथा पि पतितः कृतः .. 6.163.10 ..
5.162.m: "With the approval of all these [brahmins], I then gave you / the expiation; nevertheless, I have been made fallen.

5.162.s:
tasmādahaṃ patiṣyāmi susamiddhe hutāśane ..
naiva jīvitumicchāmi svajanaiḥ parivarjitaḥ.. 11 ..
5.162.d:
तस्मादहं पतिष्यामि सुसमिद्धे हुताशने ..
नैव जीवितुमिच्छामि स्वजनैः परिवर्जितः.. 11 ..
5.162.m: Therefore I will fall into a brightly blazing fire; / I have no desire to live, abandoned by my kinsmen."

5.162.s:
.. puṣpa uvāca .. ..
na viṣādastvayā kāryaḥ kārye'smidvijasattama ..
vittārthaṃ dūṣitastvaṃhi yato brāhmaṇasattamaiḥ .. 12 ..
5.162.d:
.. पुष्प उवाच .. ..
न विषादस्त्वया कार्यः कार्येऽस्मिद्विजसत्तम ..
वित्तार्थं दूषितस्त्वंहि यतो ब्राह्मणसत्तमैः .. 12 ..
5.162.m: Puṣpa said: / "You should not despair in this matter, O best of twice-born. / For you were censured by the best of brahmins for the sake of wealth.

5.162.s:
nāgarāṃstoṣayiṣyāmi tānahaṃ vividhairdhanaiḥ ..
yācayiṣyaṃti yanmātraṃ tava gātraviśuddhaye .. 13 ..
5.162.d:
नागरांस्तोषयिष्यामि तानहं विविधैर्धनैः ..
याचयिष्यंति यन्मात्रं तव गात्रविशुद्धये .. 13 ..
5.162.m: I will satisfy those Nāgaras with diverse riches. / Whatever amount they demand for the purification of your person,

5.162.s:
tāvanmātraṃ pradāsyāmi tebhyo hi tava kāraṇāt ..
evamuktvā samāgatya brahmasthānaṃ tvarānvitaḥ .. .. 14 ..
5.162.d:
तावन्मात्रं प्रदास्यामि तेभ्यो हि तव कारणात् ..
एवमुक्त्वा समागत्य ब्रह्मस्थानं त्वरान्वितः .. .. 14 ..
5.162.m: that much indeed I will give to them on your account." / Having spoken thus and quickly gone to the Brahmasthāna,

5.162.s:
cātuścaraṇamānīya madhyagāsyena so'bravīt ..
caṃḍaśarmā dvijo yaśca madarthe patitaḥ kṛtaḥ .._ 15 ..
5.162.d:
चातुश्चरणमानीय मध्यगास्येन सोऽब्रवीत् ..
चंडशर्मा द्विजो यश्च मदर्थे पतितः कृतः .._ 15 ..
5.162.m: having summoned the fourfold assembly, he spoke through the mouth of the arbitrator: / "As for Caṇḍaśarman, the twice-born who has been made fallen on my account

5.162.s:
yuṣmābhirvittalobhena tadvittaṃ vo dadāmyaham..
samastaṃ madgṛhe yacca kriyatāṃ vacanaṃ dvijaiḥ .. 16 ..
5.162.d:
युष्माभिर्वित्तलोभेन तद्वित्तं वो ददाम्यहम्..
समस्तं मद्गृहे यच्च क्रियतां वचनं द्विजैः .. 16 ..
5.162.m: by you out of greed for wealth, I give you that wealth— / all that is in my house; let a [favorable] verdict be made by the twice-born!"

5.162.s:
atha te kupitāḥ procuḥ sarva eva dvijottamāḥ ..
sītkārānvividhānkṛtvā krodha saṃraktalocanāḥ .. 17 ..
5.162.d:
अथ ते कुपिताः प्रोचुः सर्व एव द्विजोत्तमाः ..
सीत्कारान्विविधान्कृत्वा क्रोध संरक्तलोचनाः .. 17 ..
5.162.m: Then, enraged, all those best of twice-born spoke, / making various hissing sounds, their eyes red with anger:

5.162.s:
dhigdhikpāpasamācāra jihvā te śatadhā tataḥ ..
kiṃ na yāti yadevaṃ tvaṃ prajalpasi vigarhitam .. 18 ..
5.162.d:
धिग्धिक्पापसमाचार जिह्वा ते शतधा ततः ..
किं न याति यदेवं त्वं प्रजल्पसि विगर्हितम् .. 18 ..
5.162.m: "Fie, fie, O worker of evil! Why then does your tongue / not split into a hundred pieces when you prattle such disgraceful nonsense?

5.162.s:
patito'yaṃ kṛto 'smābhirnaiva vittasya kāraṇāt ..
prāyaścittaṃ yato dattamekenāpi durātmanā .. 19
5.162.d:
पतितोऽयं कृतो ऽस्माभिर्नैव वित्तस्य कारणात् ..
प्रायश्चित्तं यतो दत्तमेकेनापि दुरात्मना .. 19
5.162.m: He was not made fallen by us for the sake of wealth, / but because an expiation was given by a single wicked-minded man.

5.162.s:
smṛtayo dūṣitāstena purāṇāni viśeṣataḥ ..
sthānaṃ caivāsma dīyaṃ ca karma caitatprakurvatā .. 6.163.20 ..
5.162.d:
स्मृतयो दूषितास्तेन पुराणानि विशेषतः ..
स्थानं चैवास्म दीयं च कर्म चैतत्प्रकुर्वता .. 6.163.20 ..
5.162.m: By him, performing this deed, the Smṛtis were violated, and especially the Purāṇas, / and our assembly hall as well.

5.162.s:
prāyaścittaṃ pradātavyaṃ caturbhiraparaiḥ saha ..
saṃmantrya manunā proktametadeva dvijottamāḥ .. 21 ..
5.162.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं प्रदातव्यं चतुर्भिरपरैः सह ..
संमन्त्र्य मनुना प्रोक्तमेतदेव द्विजोत्तमाः .. 21 ..
5.162.m: An expiation is to be prescribed together with four others / after deliberation—precisely this was declared by Manu, O best of twice-born.

5.162.s:
tvadīyaṃ pātakaṃ cāsya śarīre'dya vyavasthitam ..
ekākinā yato dattaṃ tenāyaṃ patitaḥ sthitaḥ .. 22 ..
5.162.d:
त्वदीयं पातकं चास्य शरीरेऽद्य व्यवस्थितम् ..
एकाकिना यतो दत्तं तेनायं पतितः स्थितः .. 22 ..
5.162.m: And your sin now resides in his body; / because it was given by him alone, therefore he remains fallen."

5.162.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā dvijāḥ sarve jagmuḥ svaṃsvaṃ niketanam..
puṣpopi ca samudvigno vailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 23 ..
5.162.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा द्विजाः सर्वे जग्मुः स्वंस्वं निकेतनम्..
पुष्पोपि च समुद्विग्नो वैलक्ष्यं परमं गतः .. 23 ..
5.162.m: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, all the twice-born went to their respective dwellings; / and Puṣpa too, greatly anxious, fell into extreme dismay.

5.162.s: jagāmātha nijāvāsaṃ niḥśvasannurago yathā .. 24 ..
5.162.d: जगामाथ निजावासं निःश्वसन्नुरगो यथा .. 24 ..
5.162.m: He then went to his own abode, sighing like a serpent.

5.162.s:
tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa yāvanno sāhasaṃ kṛtam ..
tāvatsiddhirmanuṣyāṇāṃ na kathaṃcitprajāyate .. 25 ..
5.162.d:
ततः स चिन्तयामास यावन्नो साहसं कृतम् ..
तावत्सिद्धिर्मनुष्याणां न कथंचित्प्रजायते .. 25 ..
5.162.m: Then he thought: "As long as a daring deed is not done, / so long success is in no way produced for men.

5.162.s:
tasmādahaṃ kariṣyāmi caṇḍaśarmakṛte mahat ..
kṛtaghnatā yathā na syātproktaṃ caiva yato budhaiḥ .. 26 ..
5.162.d:
तस्मादहं करिष्यामि चण्डशर्मकृते महत् ..
कृतघ्नता यथा न स्यात्प्रोक्तं चैव यतो बुधैः .. 26 ..
5.162.m: Therefore, I will perform a great [deed] for Caṇḍaśarman's sake, / so that there will be no ingratitude; for it has been stated by the wise:

5.162.s:
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate tathā ..
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ .. 27 ..
5.162.d:
ब्रह्मघ्ने च सुरापे च चौरे भग्नव्रते तथा ..
निष्कृतिर्विहिता सद्भिः कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः .. 27 ..
5.162.m: 'For the killer of a brahmin, the drinker of liquor, the thief, and likewise the violator of vows, / an expiation is ordained by the virtuous; for the ungrateful man there is no expiation.'

5.162.s:
evaṃ niścitya manasā sūryavāreṇa saptamī ..
yadā''yātā dvijaśreṣṭhāstadā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam .. 28 ..
5.162.d:
एवं निश्चित्य मनसा सूर्यवारेण सप्तमी ..
यदा'ऽयाता द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तदा चाष्टोत्तरं शतम् .. 28 ..
5.162.m: Having thus resolved in his mind, when a seventh lunar day falling on Sunday / arrived, O best of twice-born, then one hundred and eight

5.162.s:
pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtāstena puṣpādityasya dhīmatā ..
tīkṣṇaṃ śastraṃ samādāya pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ ..
chittvāchittvā nijāṃgāni juhuyājjātavedasi .. 29 ..
5.162.d:
प्रदक्षिणाः कृतास्तेन पुष्पादित्यस्य धीमता ..
तीक्ष्णं शस्त्रं समादाय पूर्वोक्तविधिना ततः ..
छित्त्वाछित्त्वा निजांगानि जुहुयाज्जातवेदसि .. 29 ..
5.162.m: circumambulations of Puṣpāditya were performed by the wise man. / Then, taking a sharp weapon in accordance with the previously declared rite, / cutting off his own limbs one by one, he would offer [them] as oblation into the fire.

5.162.s:
tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ yāvatkāyaśeṣeṇa yacchati ..
tāvatpratyakṣatāṃ gatvā sa prokto bhāsvatā svayam.. 6.163.30 ..
5.162.d:
ततः पूर्णाहुतिं यावत्कायशेषेण यच्छति ..
तावत्प्रत्यक्षतां गत्वा स प्रोक्तो भास्वता स्वयम्.. 6.163.30 ..
5.162.m: Then, just as he was offering the final oblation with what remained of his body, / the Sun himself appeared before his eyes and spoke: 6.163.30

5.162.s:
puṣpa mā sāhasaṃ kārṣīḥ parituṣṭo'smi te'nagha ..
bhūya eva mahābhāga brūhi kiṃ te dadāmyaham .. 31 ..
5.162.d:
पुष्प मा साहसं कार्षीः परितुष्टोऽस्मि तेऽनघ ..
भूय एव महाभाग ब्रूहि किं ते ददाम्यहम् .. 31 ..
5.162.m: “Puṣpa, do not commit violence [against yourself]! I am well pleased with you, sinless one. / Tell me further, most fortunate one: what shall I grant you?” 31

5.162.s:
.. puṣpa uvāca .. ..
caṇḍaśarmā dvijendro'yaṃ madarthe patitaḥ kṛtaḥ ..
samastairnāgarairdeva taṃ tairnaya samānatām .. 32 ..
5.162.d:
.. पुष्प उवाच .. ..
चण्डशर्मा द्विजेन्द्रोऽयं मदर्थे पतितः कृतः ..
समस्तैर्नागरैर्देव तं तैर्नय समानताम् .. 32 ..
5.162.m: Puṣpa said: / “This lord of brahmins, Caṇḍaśarman, was made fallen on my account / by all the Nāgaras, O Lord; restore him to equality with them. 32

5.162.s:
śāstraṃ dṛṣṭvā pradattaṃ me prāyaścittaṃ mahātmanā ..
tathāpi dūṣitaḥ kṣudraiḥ samastairasahiṣṇubhiḥ .. 33 ..
5.162.d:
शास्त्रं दृष्ट्वा प्रदत्तं मे प्रायश्चित्तं महात्मना ..
तथापि दूषितः क्षुद्रैः समस्तैरसहिष्णुभिः .. 33 ..
5.162.m: The noble one examined the scriptures and gave me an expiation; / nonetheless, he was reviled by all those petty and intolerant [men].” 33

5.162.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
ekasyāpi vaco naiva śakyate kartumanyathā ..
nāgarasya dvijaśreṣṭha samastānāṃ ca kiṃ punaḥ .. 34 ..
5.162.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
एकस्यापि वचो नैव शक्यते कर्तुमन्यथा ..
नागरस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठ समस्तानां च किं पुनः .. 34 ..
5.162.m: The Blessed Lord said: / “The word of even a single Nāgara cannot be set aside, / O best of brahmins, let alone [the word] of them all. 34

5.162.s:
parameṣa dvijaḥ pūtaścaṃḍaśarmā bhaviṣyati ..
brāhmo'yaṃ nāgaraḥ khyātaḥ samaste dharaṇītale .. 35 ..
5.162.d:
परमेष द्विजः पूतश्चंडशर्मा भविष्यति ..
ब्राह्मोऽयं नागरः ख्यातः समस्ते धरणीतले .. 35 ..
5.162.m: However, this brahmin Caṇḍaśarman will be purified; / he shall be celebrated as a Brāhmanāgara throughout the whole earth. 35

5.162.s:
etasya ye sutāścaiva bhaviṣyaṃti dharātale ..
vikhyātiṃ te'pi yāsyaṃti mānyāḥ pūjyā mahībhṛtām .. 36 ..
5.162.d:
एतस्य ये सुताश्चैव भविष्यंति धरातले ..
विख्यातिं तेऽपि यास्यंति मान्याः पूज्या महीभृताम् .. 36 ..
5.162.m: Whatever sons he has on the surface of the earth, / they too will attain fame, respected and honored by kings. 36

5.162.s:
ye cāpi bāṃdhavā ścāsya suhṛdaśca samāgamam..
kariṣyaṃti samaṃ te'pi bhaviṣyaṃti suśobhanāḥ .. 37 ..
5.162.d:
ये चापि बांधवा श्चास्य सुहृदश्च समागमम्..
करिष्यंति समं तेऽपि भविष्यंति सुशोभनाः .. 37 ..
5.162.m: And whatever kinsmen and friends associate with him, / they too will become very distinguished. 37

5.162.s: tvaṃ cāpi matprasādena saṃpūrṇāṃgo bhaviṣyasi .. 38 ..
5.162.d: त्वं चापि मत्प्रसादेन संपूर्णांगो भविष्यसि .. 38 ..
5.162.m: And by my grace, you too will have your limbs fully restored.” 38

5.162.s:
evamuktvā sahasrāṃśustataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
puṣpo'pi cākṣatāṃgatvaṃ tatkṣaṇātsamapadyata .. 39 ..
5.162.d:
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्रांशुस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
पुष्पोऽपि चाक्षतांगत्वं तत्क्षणात्समपद्यत .. 39 ..
5.162.m: Having spoken thus, the thousand-rayed Sun disappeared from sight; / and Puṣpa at that very moment regained his uninjured state. 39

5.162.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgararakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye brāhmanāgarotpattivṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 163 ..
5.162.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागररखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्राह्मनागरोत्पत्तिवृत्तांतवर्णनंनाम त्रिषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 163 ..
5.162.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-third chapter, entitled 'Account of the Origin of the Brāhmanāgaras', in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection. 163

5.163.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminnaṃtare puṣpaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā ..
caṃḍaśarmagṛhaṃ gatvā diṣṭyādiṣṭyeti cābravīt .. 1 ..
5.163.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे पुष्पः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना ..
चंडशर्मगृहं गत्वा दिष्ट्यादिष्ट्येति चाब्रवीत् .. 1 ..
5.163.m: Sūta said: / Meanwhile, Puṣpa, delighted in his inner self, / went to Caṇḍaśarman's house and cried, “Good fortune! Good fortune!” 1

5.163.s:
vivarṇavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā vāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇaṃ tadā ..
bāndhavaiḥ sahitaṃ sarvairdārairbhṛtyaistathā sutaiḥ .. 2 ..
5.163.d:
विवर्णवदनं दृष्ट्वा वाष्पपूर्णेक्षणं तदा ..
बान्धवैः सहितं सर्वैर्दारैर्भृत्यैस्तथा सुतैः .. 2 ..
5.163.m: Seeing him pale-faced, with eyes filled with tears, / accompanied by all his kinsmen, his wife, his servants, and his sons, 2

5.163.s:
.. puṣpa uvāca .. ..
tavārthe ca mayā sūryaḥ kāyatyāgena toṣitaḥ ..
patitattvaṃ na te kāye tatprasādādbhaviṣyati .. .. 3 ..
5.163.d:
.. पुष्प उवाच .. ..
तवार्थे च मया सूर्यः कायत्यागेन तोषितः ..
पतितत्त्वं न ते काये तत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति .. .. 3 ..
5.163.m: Puṣpa said: / “For your sake I propitiated the Sun by giving up my body. / By his grace, there will be no fallen state in your person. 3

5.163.s:
tava putrāśca pautrāśca ye bhaviṣyaṃti vaṃśajāḥ ..
nāgarāṇāṃ ca te sarve bhaviṣyaṃti guṇādhikāḥ .. 4 ..
5.163.d:
तव पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च ये भविष्यंति वंशजाः ..
नागराणां च ते सर्वे भविष्यंति गुणाधिकाः .. 4 ..
5.163.m: Your sons and grandsons, whoever is born in your lineage, / will all surpass the Nāgaras in virtues. 4

5.163.s:
tasmāduttiṣṭha gacchāmo nadīṃ puṇyāṃ sarasvatīm ..
tasyāstaṭe nivāsāya kṛtvā caivāśramaṃ dvija .. 5 ..
5.163.d:
तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ गच्छामो नदीं पुण्यां सरस्वतीम् ..
तस्यास्तटे निवासाय कृत्वा चैवाश्रमं द्विज .. 5 ..
5.163.m: Therefore arise, let us go to the sacred river Sarasvatī; / after making a hermitage on its bank to dwell in, O brahmin, 5

5.163.s:
tvayā saha vasiṣyāmi ahameva na saṃśayaḥ ..
asti me vipulaṃ vittaṃ ye cānye te'nuyāyinaḥ .. 6 ..
5.163.d:
त्वया सह वसिष्यामि अहमेव न संशयः ..
अस्ति मे विपुलं वित्तं ये चान्ये तेऽनुयायिनः .. 6 ..
5.163.m: I myself shall dwell with you, without a doubt. / I have ample wealth, and for whatever others follow you, 6

5.163.s:
tānsarvānpoṣayiṣyāmi tyajyatāṃ mānaso jvaraḥ ..
tacchrutvā caṇḍaśarmā tu putrairbaṃdhubhiranvitaḥ .. 7 ..
5.163.d:
तान्सर्वान्पोषयिष्यामि त्यज्यतां मानसो ज्वरः ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा चण्डशर्मा तु पुत्रैर्बंधुभिरन्वितः .. 7 ..
5.163.m: I shall maintain them all; let the fever in your mind be discarded!” / Having heard that, Caṇḍaśarman, accompanied by his sons and kinsmen, 7

5.163.s:
sarasvatīṃ samuddiśya niṣkrāṃto nagarāttataḥ ..
sthānaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskṛtya suduḥkhitaḥ .. 8 ..
5.163.d:
सरस्वतीं समुद्दिश्य निष्क्रांतो नगरात्ततः ..
स्थानं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य नमस्कृत्य सुदुःखितः .. 8 ..
5.163.m: set out from the city heading towards the Sarasvatī. / Having circumambulated the place and bowed respectfully, deeply sorrowful, 8

5.163.s:
bāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇo dīna uttarābhimukho yayau ..
puṣpeṇa sahitaścaiva muhurmuhuḥ prabodhitaḥ .. 9 ..
5.163.d:
बाष्पपूर्णेक्षणो दीन उत्तराभिमुखो ययौ ..
पुष्पेण सहितश्चैव मुहुर्मुहुः प्रबोधितः .. 9 ..
5.163.m: wretched, his eyes filled with tears, he went northward / together with Puṣpa, who comforted him again and again. 9

5.163.s:
tataḥ sarasvatīṃ prāpya puṇyāṃ śītajalāṃ nadīm ..
sevitāṃ munisaṃghaistāṃ lolakallolamālinīm .. 6.164.10 ..
5.163.d:
ततः सरस्वतीं प्राप्य पुण्यां शीतजलां नदीम् ..
सेवितां मुनिसंघैस्तां लोलकल्लोलमालिनीम् .. 6.164.10 ..
5.163.m: Then, reaching the sacred river Sarasvatī with its cool waters, / frequented by hosts of sages and garlanded with rolling waves, 6.164.10

5.163.s:
tasyā dakṣiṇakūle sa nivāsamakarottadā ..
puṣpasya matimāsthāya bandhubhiḥ sakalairvṛtaḥ .. 11 ..
5.163.d:
तस्या दक्षिणकूले स निवासमकरोत्तदा ..
पुष्पस्य मतिमास्थाय बन्धुभिः सकलैर्वृतः .. 11 ..
5.163.m: he took up residence on its southern bank, / following Puṣpa's counsel, surrounded by all his kinsmen. 11

5.163.s:
tasyāsīnnagarasthasya pratijñā caṇḍaśarmaṇaḥ ..
saptaviṃśati bhirliṃgairdṛṣṭaibhokṣyāmyahaṃ sadā .. 12 ..
5.163.d:
तस्यासीन्नगरस्थस्य प्रतिज्ञा चण्डशर्मणः ..
सप्तविंशति भिर्लिंगैर्दृष्टैभोक्ष्याम्यहं सदा .. 12 ..
5.163.m: When he had lived in the city, Caṇḍaśarman had made a vow: / “I will eat only after beholding twenty-seven liṅgas, always.” 12

5.163.s:
tāṃ ca saṃsmaratastasya pratijñāṃ pūrvasaṃcitām ..
hṛdayaṃ dahyate tasya divānaktaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 13 ..
5.163.d:
तां च संस्मरतस्तस्य प्रतिज्ञां पूर्वसंचिताम् ..
हृदयं दह्यते तस्य दिवानक्तं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 13 ..
5.163.m: Remembering that vow amassed long ago, / his heart burned day and night, O best of brahmins. 13

5.163.s:
sa ca snātvā sarasvatyāṃ śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ ..
ṣaḍakṣarasya mantrasya japaṃ cakre pṛthakpṛthak .. 14 ..
5.163.d:
स च स्नात्वा सरस्वत्यां शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः ..
षडक्षरस्य मन्त्रस्य जपं चक्रे पृथक्पृथक् .. 14 ..
5.163.m: Having bathed in the Sarasvatī, purified and collected in mind, / he chanted the six-syllable mantra individually [for each], 14

5.163.s:
nāma coccārya liṃgasya namaskārāntamādadhe ..
kardamena dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ paṃcāṃgulaśatena ca .. 15 ..
5.163.d:
नाम चोच्चार्य लिंगस्य नमस्कारान्तमादधे ..
कर्दमेन द्विजश्रेष्ठाः पंचांगुलशतेन च .. 15 ..
5.163.m: and uttered the name of the liṅga concluding with namas. / O best of brahmins, out of clay measuring a hundred times five fingers, 15

5.163.s:
saṃsthāpya pūjayedbhaktyā puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ..
prāṇarudrāñjapanpaścācchraddhayā parayā yutaḥ .. 16 ..
5.163.d:
संस्थाप्य पूजयेद्भक्त्या पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः ..
प्राणरुद्राञ्जपन्पश्चाच्छ्रद्धया परया युतः .. 16 ..
5.163.m: having set [them] up, he would worship [them] with devotion, with flowers, incense, and ointments, / afterwards chanting the Prāṇarudras, endowed with supreme faith. 16

5.163.s:
duḥsthitaṃ susthitaṃ vāpi śivaliṃgaṃ na cālayet ..
iti matvā dvijendro'sau naiva tāni visarjayet .. 17 ..
5.163.d:
दुःस्थितं सुस्थितं वापि शिवलिंगं न चालयेत् ..
इति मत्वा द्विजेन्द्रोऽसौ नैव तानि विसर्जयेत् .. 17 ..
5.163.m: Thinking, “One must not move a liṅga of Śiva, whether badly situated or well situated,” / that lord of brahmins never discarded them. 17

5.163.s:
uparyupari teṣāṃ ca kardamena dvijottamāḥ ..
cakre liṃgāni nityaṃ sa saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā .. 19 ..
tataḥ kālena mahatā jātaḥ kardamaparvataḥ .. 19 ..
5.163.d:
उपर्युपरि तेषां च कर्दमेन द्विजोत्तमाः ..
चक्रे लिंगानि नित्यं स सप्तविंशतिसंख्यया .. 19 ..
ततः कालेन महता जातः कर्दमपर्वतः .. 19 ..
5.163.m:
On top of them, O best of brahmins, out of clay / he continually made liṅgas numbering twenty-seven each day. 19
Then, after a long time, a mountain of clay came to be. 19

5.163.s:
atha tuṣṭo mahādevastasya bhaktyatirekataḥ ..
nirbhidya dharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ tasya liṃgamadarśayat .. 6.164.20 ..
5.163.d:
अथ तुष्टो महादेवस्तस्य भक्त्यतिरेकतः ..
निर्भिद्य धरणीपृष्ठं तस्य लिंगमदर्शयत् .. 6.164.20 ..
5.163.m: Then Mahādeva, pleased by the abundance of his devotion, / broke through the surface of the earth and revealed a liṅga to him. 6.164.20

5.163.s:
abravītsādaraṃ taṃ ca meghagambhīrayā girā ..
caṇḍaśarmanpratuṣṭosmi tava bhaktyā'nayā dvija .. 21 ..
5.163.d:
अब्रवीत्सादरं तं च मेघगम्भीरया गिरा ..
चण्डशर्मन्प्रतुष्टोस्मि तव भक्त्याऽनया द्विज .. 21 ..
5.163.m: And he spoke to him with respect, in a voice deep as a thundercloud: / “Caṇḍaśarman, I am exceedingly pleased with you, O brahmin, because of this devotion. 21

5.163.s:
tasmālliṃgamidaṃ nityaṃ pūjayasva prabhaktitaḥ ..
saptaviṃśatiliṃgānāṃ yataḥ phalamavāpsyasi .. 22 ..
5.163.d:
तस्माल्लिंगमिदं नित्यं पूजयस्व प्रभक्तितः ..
सप्तविंशतिलिंगानां यतः फलमवाप्स्यसि .. 22 ..
5.163.m: Therefore, worship this liṅga constantly with great devotion, / from which you will obtain the fruit of twenty-seven liṅgas. 22

5.163.s:
anyopi ca naro bhaktyā yaścainaṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
saptaviṃśatiliṃgānāṃ so'pi śreyo'bhilapsyati .. 23 ..
5.163.d:
अन्योपि च नरो भक्त्या यश्चैनं पूजयिष्यति ..
सप्तविंशतिलिंगानां सोऽपि श्रेयोऽभिलप्स्यति .. 23 ..
5.163.m: Any other man also, who worships it with devotion, / will likewise obtain the welfare [resulting from] twenty-seven liṅgas.” 23

5.163.s:
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
caṃḍaśarmāpi taṃ hṛṣṭaḥ pūjayāmāsa tattvataḥ .. 24 ..
5.163.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
चंडशर्मापि तं हृष्टः पूजयामास तत्त्वतः .. 24 ..
5.163.m: Having spoken thus, the Blessed Lord disappeared from sight; / and Caṇḍaśarman too, delighted, worshipped it in proper accordance [with rule]. 24

5.163.s:
prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa tasya liṃgasya śobhanam ..
nāma cakre tatastasya vicārya ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 25 ..
5.163.d:
प्रासादं कारयामास तस्य लिंगस्य शोभनम् ..
नाम चक्रे ततस्तस्य विचार्य च मुहुर्मुहुः .. 25 ..
5.163.m: He caused a splendid temple to be built for that liṅga, / and then, after reflecting again and again, gave it a name: 25

5.163.s:
nagarasthita liṃgānāṃ yasmātsaṃsmaraṇātsthitaḥ ..
nāgareśvarasaṃjñastu tasmādeṣa bhaviṣyati .. 26 ..
5.163.d:
नगरस्थित लिंगानां यस्मात्संस्मरणात्स्थितः ..
नागरेश्वरसंज्ञस्तु तस्मादेष भविष्यति .. 26 ..
5.163.m: “Since it has arisen from the memory of the liṅgas situated in the city (nagara), / it shall therefore be known by the name Nāgareśvara.” 26

5.163.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ saṃsthāpya talliṃgaṃ caṃḍaśarmā dvijottamāḥ ..
ārādhayāmāsa tadā puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ..27..
5.163.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं संस्थाप्य तल्लिंगं चंडशर्मा द्विजोत्तमाः ..
आराधयामास तदा पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः ..27..
5.163.m: Sūta said: / Having thus established that liṅga, O best of brahmins, Caṇḍaśarman / then worshipped it with flowers, incense, and ointments; 27

5.163.s:
saptaviṃśatiliṃgānāṃ prāpnoti ca tathā phalam ..
pūjitānāṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā nagare yāni tāni ca .. .. 28 ..
5.163.d:
सप्तविंशतिलिंगानां प्राप्नोति च तथा फलम् ..
पूजितानां द्विजश्रेष्ठा नगरे यानि तानि च .. .. 28 ..
5.163.m: and in that way he obtained the fruit of the twenty-seven liṅgas / that had been worshipped in the city, O best of brahmins. 28

5.163.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā nāgareśvaratuṣṭitaḥ ..
śivalokaṃ gataḥ sākṣādyānamadhye niveśitaḥ ..29..
5.163.d:
ततः कालेन महता नागरेश्वरतुष्टितः ..
शिवलोकं गतः साक्षाद्यानमध्ये निवेशितः ..29..
5.163.m: Then, after a long time, through the favor of Nāgareśvara, / he went in bodily form to the world of Śiva, placed within a celestial conveyance. 29

5.163.s:
puṣpopi sthāpayāmāsa puṣpādityamathāparam..
puṇye sarasvatītīre tataḥ pūjāparo'bhavat .. 6.164.30 ..
5.163.d:
पुष्पोपि स्थापयामास पुष्पादित्यमथापरम्..
पुण्ये सरस्वतीतीरे ततः पूजापरोऽभवत् .. 6.164.30 ..
5.163.m: Puṣpa too established another Puṣpāditya / on the sacred bank of the Sarasvatī, and then became devoted to [his] worship. 6.164.30

5.163.s:
tasyāpi darśanaṃ gatvā prītyā vacanamabravīt ..
puṣpa tuṣṭosmi bhadraṃ te varaṃ prārthaya suvrata .. 31 ..
5.163.d:
तस्यापि दर्शनं गत्वा प्रीत्या वचनमब्रवीत् ..
पुष्प तुष्टोस्मि भद्रं ते वरं प्रार्थय सुव्रत .. 31 ..
5.163.m: [The Sun] appeared before his eyes as well and affectionately spoke these words: / “Puṣpa, I am pleased, may it be well with you; ask for a boon, O one of noble vows! 31

5.163.s: adeyamapi dāsyāmi tasmātprārthaya mā ciram .. 32 ..
5.163.d: अदेयमपि दास्यामि तस्मात्प्रार्थय मा चिरम् .. 32 ..
5.163.m: Even what should not be given I will give; therefore, ask without delay!” 32

5.163.s:
.. puṣpa uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama ..
taddehi yācamānasya mama yaddhṛdi saṃsthitam .. 33 ..
5.163.d:
.. पुष्प उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम ..
तद्देहि याचमानस्य मम यद्धृदि संस्थितम् .. 33 ..
5.163.m:
Puṣpa said:
If you are pleased with me, O god, if a boon is to be granted to me, / then grant to me as I ask that which resides in my heart. 33

5.163.s:
camatkārapure deva tava yā mūrtayaḥ sthitāḥ ..
dvādaśaiva pramāṇena pūjyāḥ sarvadivaukasām .. 34 ..
5.163.d:
चमत्कारपुरे देव तव या मूर्तयः स्थिताः ..
द्वादशैव प्रमाणेन पूज्याः सर्वदिवौकसाम् .. 34 ..
5.163.m: The forms of yours that are established in Camatkārapura, O god, / are twelve in number, worshipped by all the denizens of heaven. 34

5.163.s:
tāsāṃ pūjāphalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ saṃprāpnotu naro bhuvi ..
yaḥ pūjayati mūrtiṃ te yaiṣā saṃsthāpitā mayā .. 35 ..
5.163.d:
तासां पूजाफलं कृत्स्नं संप्राप्नोतु नरो भुवि ..
यः पूजयति मूर्तिं ते यैषा संस्थापिता मया .. 35 ..
5.163.m: May a mortal on earth obtain the entire fruit of their worship, / who worships your form that has been established here by me. 35

5.163.s:
nāgarāditya ityeṣā khyātā bhavatu bhūtale ..
yeyaṃ sarasvatītīre prāsāde sthāpitā mayā .. 36 ..
5.163.d:
नागरादित्य इत्येषा ख्याता भवतु भूतले ..
येयं सरस्वतीतीरे प्रासादे स्थापिता मया .. 36 ..
5.163.m: May it become renowned on the surface of the earth as Nāgarāditya, / this [image] which has been set up by me in a temple on the bank of the Sarasvatī. 36

5.163.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sa tatheti pratijñāya gataścādarśanaṃ raviḥ ..
dīpavadbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāstadadbhutamivā bhavat .. 37 ..
5.163.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय गतश्चादर्शनं रविः ..
दीपवद्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठास्तदद्भुतमिवा भवत् .. 37 ..
5.163.m:
Sūta said:
Having agreed, saying 'So be it,' the sun disappeared / like a lamp, O best of brahmins; that became like a marvel. 37

5.163.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā puṣpopi dvijasattamāḥ ..
sūryalokamanuprāpto vimānena suvarcasā .. 38 ..
5.163.d:
ततः कालेन महता पुष्पोपि द्विजसत्तमाः ..
सूर्यलोकमनुप्राप्तो विमानेन सुवर्चसा .. 38 ..
5.163.m: Then after a long time, O best of the twice-born, Puṣpa too / attained the world of the sun by means of a resplendent aerial chariot. 38

5.163.s:
śākambharīti vikhyātā bhāryā''sīccaṃḍaśarmaṇaḥ ..
tayā saṃsthāpitā durgā sarasvatyāḥ śubhe taṭe .. 39 ..
ārādhitā'tha sadbhaktyā divānaktaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
tatastuṣṭā varaṃ tasyāḥ sā dadau dvijasattamāḥ ..6.164.4...
5.163.d:
शाकम्भरीति विख्याता भार्या'ऽसीच्चंडशर्मणः ..
तया संस्थापिता दुर्गा सरस्वत्याः शुभे तटे .. 39 ..
आराधिताऽथ सद्भक्त्या दिवानक्तं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
ततस्तुष्टा वरं तस्याः सा ददौ द्विजसत्तमाः ..6.164.4...
5.163.m:
The wife of Caṇḍaśarman was renowned as Śākambharī; / by her, Durgā was established on the auspicious bank of the Sarasvatī. 39
She was then propitiated with true devotion day and night, O best of the twice-born; / pleased thereby, she gave her a boon, O best of brahmins: 40

5.163.s:
putri tuṣṭāsmi bhadraṃ te śākaṃbhari pragṛhyatām ..
varaṃ yatte sadābhīṣṭaṃ matprasādādasaṃśayam ..41..
5.163.d:
पुत्रि तुष्टास्मि भद्रं ते शाकंभरि प्रगृह्यताम् ..
वरं यत्ते सदाभीष्टं मत्प्रसादादसंशयम् ..41..
5.163.m: ‘Daughter, I am pleased, good fortune to you, O Śākambharī! Receive / the boon that has always been desired by you, undoubtedly through my favor.’ 41

5.163.s:
.. śākambharyuvāca .. ..
catuḥṣaṣṭigaṇā devi mātṛṇāṃ ye vyavasthitāḥ..
camatkārapure khyātā hāsyāttuṣṭiṃ vrajaṃti yāḥ .. 42 ..
5.163.d:
.. शाकम्भर्युवाच .. ..
चतुःषष्टिगणा देवि मातृणां ये व्यवस्थिताः..
चमत्कारपुरे ख्याता हास्यात्तुष्टिं व्रजंति याः .. 42 ..
5.163.m:
Śākambharī said:
‘The groups of sixty-four mothers who are situated, O goddess, / renowned in Camatkārapura, who become pleased through laughter, 42

5.163.s:
yā rātrau balidānena jāte vṛddhau tataḥ param..
tatsarvaṃ jāyatāṃ puṇyaṃ yaste mūrtiṃ prapūjayet.. 43 ..
5.163.d:
या रात्रौ बलिदानेन जाते वृद्धौ ततः परम्..
तत्सर्वं जायतां पुण्यं यस्ते मूर्तिं प्रपूजयेत्.. 43 ..
5.163.m: and who [are pleased] at night by an offering of oblations, and after that when an increase [of the family] occurs— / may all that merit accrue to whoever worships your form, 43

5.163.s: atrāgatya nadītīre yaiṣā saṃsthāpitā mayā .. 44 ..
5.163.d: अत्रागत्य नदीतीरे यैषा संस्थापिता मया .. 44 ..
5.163.m: having come here to the river bank, which has been established by me.’ 44

5.163.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
āśvinasya site pakṣe mahānavamisaṃjñite ..
yo mamāgre samāgatya pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ .. 45 ..
5.163.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
आश्विनस्य सिते पक्षे महानवमिसंज्ञिते ..
यो ममाग्रे समागत्य पूजयिष्यति भक्तितः .. 45 ..
5.163.m:
The goddess said:
‘In the bright fortnight of Āśvina, on the day known as Mahānavamī, / whoever approaches before me and worships with devotion, 45

5.163.s:
tasya kṛtsnaṃ phalaṃ sadyo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ..
nāgarasya viśeṣeṇa satyametanmayoditam .. 46 ..
5.163.d:
तस्य कृत्स्नं फलं सद्यो भविष्यति न संशयः ..
नागरस्य विशेषेण सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 46 ..
5.163.m: to him the entire fruit shall immediately accrue, there is no doubt; / especially to a Nāgara—this truth has been spoken by me.’ 46

5.163.s:
evamuktvā tu sā devī tataścādarśanaṃ gatā ..
tasyā nāmnā ca sā devī proktā śākambharī bhuvi .. 47 ..
5.163.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तु सा देवी ततश्चादर्शनं गता ..
तस्या नाम्ना च सा देवी प्रोक्ता शाकम्भरी भुवि .. 47 ..
5.163.m: Having spoken thus, the goddess then disappeared; / and by her name that goddess was called Śākambharī on earth. 47

5.163.s:
vṛddheranaṃtaraṃ tasyā yaḥ pūjāṃ kurute naraḥ ..
tasya vṛddherna vighnaḥ syātkadāciddvijasattamāḥ .. 48 ..
5.163.d:
वृद्धेरनंतरं तस्या यः पूजां कुरुते नरः ..
तस्य वृद्धेर्न विघ्नः स्यात्कदाचिद्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 48 ..
5.163.m: The man who performs her worship immediately after an increase [of the family]— / for his increase there shall never be any obstacle, O best of the twice-born. 48

5.163.s:
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe
śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgareśvaranāgarādityaśākambharyutpattivarṇanaṃnāma
catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamosdhyāyaḥ .. 164 ..
5.163.d:
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे
श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नागरेश्वरनागरादित्यशाकम्भर्युत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम
चतुःषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोस्ध्यायः .. 164 ..
5.163.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-fourth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Origin of Nāgareśvara, Nāgarāditya, and Śākambharī,' in the glory of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skandapurāṇa. 164

5.164.s:
.. .. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥprabhṛtipuṇye ca sarasvatyāstaṭeśubhe ..
bāhyānāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ ca sthānaṃ jātaṃ mahattaram .. 1 ..
5.164.d:
.. .. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततःप्रभृतिपुण्ये च सरस्वत्यास्तटेशुभे ..
बाह्यानां नागराणां च स्थानं जातं महत्तरम् .. 1 ..
5.164.m:
Sūta said:
From that time onward, on the auspicious bank of the Sarasvatī, / a very great abode was formed for the outer Nāgaras, 1

5.164.s:
putrapautrapravṛddhānāṃ dauhitrāṇāṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
camatkārapurasyāgre yajjñātaṃ vidyayā dhanaiḥ .. 2 ..
5.164.d:
पुत्रपौत्रप्रवृद्धानां दौहित्राणां द्विजोत्तमाः ..
चमत्कारपुरस्याग्रे यज्ज्ञातं विद्यया धनैः .. 2 ..
5.164.m: who had increased with sons, grandsons, and daughters' sons, O best of the twice-born, / before Camatkārapura, which became renowned for learning and riches. 2

5.164.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā ..
śaptā sarasvatī kopātkṛtā rudhiravāhinī .. 3 ..
5.164.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य विश्वामित्रेण धीमता ..
शप्ता सरस्वती कोपात्कृता रुधिरवाहिनी .. 3 ..
5.164.m: Then, after some time, by the wise Viśvāmitra / the Sarasvatī was cursed in anger and made into a river of blood. 3

5.164.s:
tataḥ saṃsevyate hṛṣṭai rākṣasaiḥ sā divāniśam..
gītanṛtyaparaiścānyairbhūtaiḥ pretaiḥ piśācakaiḥ .. 4 ..
5.164.d:
ततः संसेव्यते हृष्टै राक्षसैः सा दिवानिशम्..
गीतनृत्यपरैश्चान्यैर्भूतैः प्रेतैः पिशाचकैः .. 4 ..
5.164.m: Then she was frequented day and night by delighted rākṣasas, / and by other bhūtas, pretas, and piśācas intent on singing and dancing. 4

5.164.s:
tataste nāgarā bāhyāstāṃ tyaktvā dūrataḥ sthitāḥ ..
kāṃdiśīkāstato yātā bhakṣyamāṇāstu rākṣasaiḥ ..
narmadāyāstaṭe puṇye mārkaṇḍāśramasaṃnidhau .. 5 .. ..
5.164.d:
ततस्ते नागरा बाह्यास्तां त्यक्त्वा दूरतः स्थिताः ..
कांदिशीकास्ततो याता भक्ष्यमाणास्तु राक्षसैः ..
नर्मदायास्तटे पुण्ये मार्कण्डाश्रमसंनिधौ .. 5 .. ..
5.164.m: Then those outer Nāgaras abandoned her and stayed far away; / fleeing in all directions, being devoured by rākṣasas, they went from there / to the sacred bank of the Narmadā, near the hermitage of Mārkaṇḍa. 5

5.164.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kasmātsarasvatī śaptā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā..
mahānadyā ko'parādhastayā tasya vinirmitaḥ .. 6 ..
5.164.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कस्मात्सरस्वती शप्ता विश्वामित्रेण धीमता..
महानद्या कोऽपराधस्तया तस्य विनिर्मितः .. 6 ..
5.164.m:
The seers said:
Why was the Sarasvatī cursed by the wise Viśvāmitra? / What offense was committed against him by that great river? 6

5.164.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
āsītpurā mahadvairaṃ viśvāmitravasiṣṭhayoḥ ..
brāhmaṇyasya kṛte viprāḥ prāṇāntakaraṇaṃ mahat ..
sa sarvairbrāhmaṇaiḥ prokto viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ .. 7 ..
5.164.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
आसीत्पुरा महद्वैरं विश्वामित्रवसिष्ठयोः ..
ब्राह्मण्यस्य कृते विप्राः प्राणान्तकरणं महत् ..
स सर्वैर्ब्राह्मणैः प्रोक्तो विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः .. 7 ..
5.164.m:
Sūta said:
Formerly there was a great enmity between Viśvāmitra and Vasiṣṭha / for the sake of brahminhood, O brahmins, causing a great destruction of life. / That Viśvāmitra was addressed as a great sage by all the brahmins, 7

5.164.s:
kṣatriyo'pi puraskṛtya devadevaṃ pitāmaham ..
na caikena vasiṣṭhena tenaitadvairamāhitam .. 8 ..
5.164.d:
क्षत्रियोऽपि पुरस्कृत्य देवदेवं पितामहम् ..
न चैकेन वसिष्ठेन तेनैतद्वैरमाहितम् .. 8 ..
5.164.m: even though he was a kṣatriya, placing the god of gods, the Grandfather [Brahmā], at the forefront; / but not by Vasiṣṭha alone; because of this, that enmity was stirred up. 8

5.164.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kṣatriyo'pi kathaṃ vipro viśvā mitro mahāmate ..
vasiṣṭhena kathaṃ nokto yaḥ prokto brahmaṇā svayam .. 9 ..
5.164.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
क्षत्रियोऽपि कथं विप्रो विश्वा मित्रो महामते ..
वसिष्ठेन कथं नोक्तो यः प्रोक्तो ब्रह्मणा स्वयम् .. 9 ..
5.164.m:
The seers said:
Even though a kṣatriya, how did Viśvāmitra become a brahmin, O noble-minded one? / Why was he, who was proclaimed by Brahmā himself, not spoken to [as such] by Vasiṣṭha? 9

5.164.s: etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ sthitam..6.165.10...
5.164.d: एतन्नः सर्वमाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं स्थितम्..6.165.10...
5.164.m: Tell us all of this; a supreme curiosity has arisen in us. 10

5.164.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
āsītpurā ṛcīkākhyo bhṛguputro mahāmuniḥ ..
vratādhyayanasaṃpannaḥ sutapasvī mahāyaśāḥ .. 11 ..
5.164.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
आसीत्पुरा ऋचीकाख्यो भृगुपुत्रो महामुनिः ..
व्रताध्ययनसंपन्नः सुतपस्वी महायशाः .. 11 ..
5.164.m:
Sūta said:
Formerly there was a great sage named Ṛcīka, the son of Bhṛgu, / endowed with vows and Vedic study, a true ascetic of great renown. 11

5.164.s:
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena sa kadācinmunīśvaraḥ ..
sthānaṃ bhojakaṭaṃ nāma prāpto gādhimahīpateḥ ..
yatra sā kauśikīnāma nadī trailokyaviśrutā .. 12 ..
5.164.d:
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन स कदाचिन्मुनीश्वरः ..
स्थानं भोजकटं नाम प्राप्तो गाधिमहीपतेः ..
यत्र सा कौशिकीनाम नदी त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता .. 12 ..
5.164.m: In the course of a pilgrimage to sacred fords, that lord of sages once / arrived at the place named Bhojakaṭa, belonging to King Gādhi, / where that river named Kauśikī flows, famous throughout the three worlds. 12

5.164.s:
tasyāṃ snātvā dvijaśreṣṭho yāvattiṣṭhati tīragaḥ ..
samādhistho japaṃ kurvansaṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ .. 13 ..
5.164.d:
तस्यां स्नात्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठो यावत्तिष्ठति तीरगः ..
समाधिस्थो जपं कुर्वन्संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः .. 13 ..
5.164.m: Having bathed in it, as the best of the twice-born stood on the bank / absorbed in contemplation, performing recitation and offering libations to the ancestors and gods, 13

5.164.s:
tāvattatra samāyātā rājakanyā suśobhanā ..
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇā sarvaireva guṇairyutā .. .. 14 ..
5.164.d:
तावत्तत्र समायाता राजकन्या सुशोभना ..
सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णा सर्वैरेव गुणैर्युता .. .. 14 ..
5.164.m: just then an exceedingly beautiful princess arrived there, / complete in all auspicious marks and endowed with all good qualities. 14

5.164.s:
sa tāṃ saṃvīkṣate yāvatsarvāvayavaśobhanām ..
tāvatkāmaśarairvyāptaḥ kartavyaṃ nābhyaviṃdata .. 15 ..
5.164.d:
स तां संवीक्षते यावत्सर्वावयवशोभनाम् ..
तावत्कामशरैर्व्याप्तः कर्तव्यं नाभ्यविंदत .. 15 ..
5.164.m: As he looked upon her, beautiful in every limb, / he was pierced by the arrows of love and could not determine what ought to be done. 15

5.164.s:
tataḥ papraccha lokānsa labdhvā kṛcchreṇa cetanām ..
kasyeyaṃ kanyakā sādhvī kimarthamiha cāgatā .. 16 ..
5.164.d:
ततः पप्रच्छ लोकान्स लब्ध्वा कृच्छ्रेण चेतनाम् ..
कस्येयं कन्यका साध्वी किमर्थमिह चागता .. 16 ..
5.164.m: Then, having regained consciousness with difficulty, he asked the people: / 'Whose virtuous maiden is this, and for what purpose has she come here? 16

5.164.s: kva yāsyati varārohā sarvaṃ me kathyatāṃ janāḥ .. 17 ..
5.164.d: क्व यास्यति वरारोहा सर्वं मे कथ्यतां जनाः .. 17 ..
5.164.m: Where will the beautiful-hipped maiden go? Tell me everything, O people!' 17

5.164.s:
.. janā ūcuḥ .. ..
eṣā gādhisutānāma khyātā trailokyasundarī ..
antaḥpurātsamāyātā gaurīpūjanalālasā .. 18 ..
5.164.d:
.. जना ऊचुः .. ..
एषा गाधिसुतानाम ख्याता त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी ..
अन्तःपुरात्समायाता गौरीपूजनलालसा .. 18 ..
5.164.m:
The people said:
'She is known as the daughter of Gādhi, the beauty of the three worlds; / she has come from the inner quarters, eager to worship Gaurī, 18

5.164.s:
vāṃchamānā subharttāraṃ sarvaiḥ samuditaṃguṇaiḥ ..
prāsādo'yaṃ sthito yo'tra nadītīre bṛhattaraḥ.. 19 ..
5.164.d:
वांछमाना सुभर्त्तारं सर्वैः समुदितंगुणैः ..
प्रासादोऽयं स्थितो योऽत्र नदीतीरे बृहत्तरः.. 19 ..
5.164.m: wishing for a good husband endowed with all virtues. / This very large temple that stands here on the river bank, 19

5.164.s:
umā saṃtiṣṭhate cātra sarvaiḥ saṃpūjitā suraiḥ ..
etāṃ ca snāpayitveyaṃ pūjayitvā yathā kramam .. 6.165.20 ..
5.164.d:
उमा संतिष्ठते चात्र सर्वैः संपूजिता सुरैः ..
एतां च स्नापयित्वेयं पूजयित्वा यथा क्रमम् .. 6.165.20 ..
5.164.m: here resides Umā, worshipped by all the gods. / Having bathed her and having worshipped her in due order, 20

5.164.s:
naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ dattvā kariṣyati tataḥ param ..
vīṇāvinodamātraṃ ca śrutimārgasukhāvaham .. 21 ..
5.164.d:
नैवेद्यं विविधं दत्त्वा करिष्यति ततः परम् ..
वीणाविनोदमात्रं च श्रुतिमार्गसुखावहम् .. 21 ..
5.164.m: and having offered various food offerings, she will after that perform / a mere diversion with the lute, delightful to the path of the ear. 21

5.164.s:
tato yāsyati harmyaṃ svaṃ mandībhūte ca bhāskare ..
ṛcīkastu tadākarṇya lokānāṃ vacanaṃ ca yat .. 22 ..
5.164.d:
ततो यास्यति हर्म्यं स्वं मन्दीभूते च भास्करे ..
ऋचीकस्तु तदाकर्ण्य लोकानां वचनं च यत् .. 22 ..
5.164.m: Then, as the sun grows dim, she will go to her palace.' / Having heard that speech of the people, Ṛcīka, 22

5.164.s:
yayau gādhigṛhaṃ śīghraṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā prāptamṛcīkaṃ bhṛgu sattamam ..
saṃmukhaḥ prayayau tūrṇaṃ gādhiḥ pārthivasattamaḥ .. 23 ..
5.164.d:
ययौ गाधिगृहं शीघ्रं कामबाणप्रपीडितः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा प्राप्तमृचीकं भृगु सत्तमम् ..
संमुखः प्रययौ तूर्णं गाधिः पार्थिवसत्तमः .. 23 ..
5.164.m: tormented by the arrows of love, went quickly to the house of Gādhi. / Seeing that Ṛcīka, the best of the Bhṛgus, had suddenly arrived, / Gādhi, the best of kings, swiftly went forward to meet him. 23

5.164.s:
gṛhyoktena vidhānena kṛtvā caivārhaṇaṃ tataḥ ..
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha .. 24 ..
5.164.d:
गृह्योक्तेन विधानेन कृत्वा चैवार्हणं ततः ..
कृतांजलिपुटो भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 24 ..
5.164.m: And having performed hospitality according to the rule prescribed in the household ritual manuals, / he then joined his palms in reverence and spoke this word: 24

5.164.s:
niḥspṛhasyāpi te vipra kimāgamanakāraṇam ..
tatsarvaṃ me samācakṣva yena yacchāmi te'khilam .. 25 ..
5.164.d:
निःस्पृहस्यापि ते विप्र किमागमनकारणम् ..
तत्सर्वं मे समाचक्ष्व येन यच्छामि तेऽखिलम् .. 25 ..
5.164.m: "O brahmin, though you are free from desires, what is the reason for your coming? / Tell me all of that, so that I may grant you everything." // 25

5.164.s:
.. ṛcīka uvāca .. ..
tava kanyā'sti vipreṃdra varārhā varavarṇinī ..
brāhmoktena vivāhena tāṃ me dehi mahīpate .. 26 ..
5.164.d:
.. ऋचीक उवाच .. ..
तव कन्याऽस्ति विप्रेंद्र वरार्हा वरवर्णिनी ..
ब्राह्मोक्तेन विवाहेन तां मे देहि महीपते .. 26 ..
5.164.m: Ṛcīka said: / "O lord of kings, you have an excellent maiden worthy of a bridegroom, of fair complexion. / Bestow her upon me, O ruler of the earth, according to the rite of the Brāhma marriage. // 26

5.164.s:
etadarthamahaṃ prāpto gṛhe tava smarārditaḥ ..
sā mayā vīkṣitā rājangaurīpūjārthamāgatā .. 27 ..
5.164.d:
एतदर्थमहं प्राप्तो गृहे तव स्मरार्दितः ..
सा मया वीक्षिता राजन्गौरीपूजार्थमागता .. 27 ..
5.164.m: For this purpose I have arrived at your house, tormented by love. / She was seen by me, O king, when she had come to worship Gaurī." // 27

5.164.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā bhayasaṃtrasto gādhiḥ pārthivasattamaḥ ..
asavarṇaṃ ca taṃ matvā daridraṃ vṛddhamevaca ..
adāne śāpabhītastu tato vyājamuvāca saḥ .. 28 ..
5.164.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा भयसंत्रस्तो गाधिः पार्थिवसत्तमः ..
असवर्णं च तं मत्वा दरिद्रं वृद्धमेवच ..
अदाने शापभीतस्तु ततो व्याजमुवाच सः .. 28 ..
5.164.m: Sūta said: / Having heard that, Gādhi, the best of kings, was terrified with fear; / considering him of a different caste, impoverished, and also old, / but afraid of a curse if he did not give [her], he then spoke an excuse: // 28

5.164.s:
asmākaṃ kanyakādāne śulkamasti dvijottama ..
taccedyacchasi kanyāṃ tāṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyāmyasaṃśayam .. 29 ..
5.164.d:
अस्माकं कन्यकादाने शुल्कमस्ति द्विजोत्तम ..
तच्चेद्यच्छसि कन्यां तां तुभ्यं दास्याम्यसंशयम् .. 29 ..
5.164.m: "Among us there is a bride-price for the giving of a maiden, O best of the twice-born. / If you give that, I will give you that maiden without a doubt." // 29

5.164.s:
.. ṛcīka uvāca .. ..
brūhi pārthivaśārdūla kanyāśulkaṃ mama drutam ..
yena yacchāmi te sarvaṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham.. .. 6.165.30 ..
5.164.d:
.. ऋचीक उवाच .. ..
ब्रूहि पार्थिवशार्दूल कन्याशुल्कं मम द्रुतम् ..
येन यच्छामि ते सर्वं यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम्.. .. 6.165.30 ..
5.164.m: Ṛcīka said: / "Speak to me quickly, O tiger among kings, what the bride-price for the maiden is, / so that I may grant you all of it, even if it should be very difficult to obtain." // 30

5.164.s:
.. gādhiruvāca .. ..
ekataḥ śyāmakarṇānāmaśvānāṃ vātaraṃhasām ..
śatāni sapta vipreṃdra śvetānāṃ caiva sarvataḥ .. 31 ..
5.164.d:
.. गाधिरुवाच .. ..
एकतः श्यामकर्णानामश्वानां वातरंहसाम् ..
शतानि सप्त विप्रेंद्र श्वेतानां चैव सर्वतः .. 31 ..
5.164.m: Gādhi said: / "Seven hundred horses with the speed of the wind, / each dark-eared on one side and white everywhere else, O best of brahmins: // 31

5.164.s: ya ānīya pradadyānme tasmai kanyāṃ dadāmyaham .. 32 ..
5.164.d: य आनीय प्रदद्यान्मे तस्मै कन्यां ददाम्यहम् .. 32 ..
5.164.m: Whoever brings and gives [them] to me, to him I shall give the maiden." // 32

5.164.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sa tatheti pratijñāya ṛcīko munisattamaḥ ..
kānyakubjaṃ samāsādya gaṃgātīre viveśa ha .. .. 33 ..
5.164.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय ऋचीको मुनिसत्तमः ..
कान्यकुब्जं समासाद्य गंगातीरे विवेश ह .. .. 33 ..
5.164.m: Sūta said: / Having promised, 'So be it,' Ṛcīka, the best of sages, / reached Kānyakubja and entered the bank of the Gaṅgā. // 33

5.164.s:
aśvo voḍheti yatsūktaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭisamudbhavam ..
chaṃdaṛṣidevatāyuktaṃ japaṃ cakre tataḥ param .. 34 ..
5.164.d:
अश्वो वोढेति यत्सूक्तं चतुःषष्टिसमुद्भवम् ..
छंदऋषिदेवतायुक्तं जपं चक्रे ततः परम् .. 34 ..
5.164.m: Thereupon he performed the recitation of the hymn, 'The horse being led...', born of the sixty-fourth [sūkta], / complete with meter, seer, and deity, // 34

5.164.s:
viniyogaṃ vājikṛtaṃ gādhinā yatprakīrtitam ..
tataste vājinastasmānniṣkrāṃtāḥ salilāddvijāḥ .. 35 ..
5.164.d:
विनियोगं वाजिकृतं गाधिना यत्प्रकीर्तितम् ..
ततस्ते वाजिनस्तस्मान्निष्क्रांताः सलिलाद्द्विजाः .. 35 ..
5.164.m: directing the ritual application for the horses that had been proclaimed by Gādhi. / Then those horses emerged from the water, O twice-born ones: // 35

5.164.s:
sarvaśvetāḥ suvegāśca śyāmaikaśravaṇāstathā ..
śatāni saptasaṃkhyāni tāvatsaṃkhyai rnaraiyutāḥ .. 36 ..
5.164.d:
सर्वश्वेताः सुवेगाश्च श्यामैकश्रवणास्तथा ..
शतानि सप्तसंख्यानि तावत्संख्यै र्नरैयुताः .. 36 ..
5.164.m: all white, very swift, with one ear dark, / seven hundred in number, accompanied by as many men. // 36

5.164.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti vikhyātamaśvatīrthaṃ dharātale ..
gaṃgātīre śubhe puṇye kānyakubjasamīpagam ..
yasminsnāne kṛte martyo vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 37 ..
5.164.d:
ततः प्रभृति विख्यातमश्वतीर्थं धरातले ..
गंगातीरे शुभे पुण्ये कान्यकुब्जसमीपगम् ..
यस्मिन्स्नाने कृते मर्त्यो वाजिमेधफलं लभेत् .. 37 ..
5.164.m: From then on, it became renowned on the earth as Aśvatīrtha, / near Kānyakubja on the auspicious and holy bank of the Gaṅgā, / bathing in which a mortal attains the fruit of a horse-sacrifice. // 37

5.164.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'śvatīrthotpattivarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 165 ..
5.164.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽश्वतीर्थोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम पंचषष्ट्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः .. 165 ..
5.164.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-fifth chapter, named 'The Description of the Origin of Aśvatīrtha,' in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 165

5.165.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ṛcīko'pi samādāya puruṣairāptakāribhiḥ ..
tānaśvānprajagāmātha yatra gādhirvyavasthitaḥ .. 1 ..
5.165.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ऋचीकोऽपि समादाय पुरुषैराप्तकारिभिः ..
तानश्वान्प्रजगामाथ यत्र गाधिर्व्यवस्थितः .. 1 ..
5.165.m: Sūta said: / Ṛcīka, having taken those horses / with trustworthy men, then went to where Gādhi was residing. // 1

5.165.s:
tasmai nivedayāmāsa kanyārthaṃ tānhayottamān ..
gādhistu tānpragṛhyātha yogyānvājimakhasya ca .. 2 ..
5.165.d:
तस्मै निवेदयामास कन्यार्थं तान्हयोत्तमान् ..
गाधिस्तु तान्प्रगृह्याथ योग्यान्वाजिमखस्य च .. 2 ..
5.165.m: He presented those excellent horses to him for the sake of the maiden. / Then Gādhi, having accepted them, fit for a horse-sacrifice, // 2

5.165.s:
ekaikaṃ paramaṃ teṣāṃ sa jagāmātha pārthivaḥ ..
tatastāṃ pradadau tasmai kanyāṃ trailokyasundarīm .. 3 ..
5.165.d:
एकैकं परमं तेषां स जगामाथ पार्थिवः ..
ततस्तां प्रददौ तस्मै कन्यां त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरीम् .. 3 ..
5.165.m: and examining each one of them as supreme, that king / then gave him that maiden, beautiful in the three worlds. // 3

5.165.s:
viprāgnisākṣisaṃbhūtāṃ gṛhyoktavidhinā nvitaḥ ..
tato vivāhe nirvṛtta ṛcīko munisattamaḥ .. 4 ..
5.165.d:
विप्राग्निसाक्षिसंभूतां गृह्योक्तविधिना न्वितः ..
ततो विवाहे निर्वृत्त ऋचीको मुनिसत्तमः .. 4 ..
5.165.m: Attended by the rite enjoined in the Gṛhya texts, born in the presence of brahmins and the fire as witnesses, / when the marriage was thus concluded, Ṛcīka, the best of sages, // 4

5.165.s:
tasyāḥ saṃveśane caiva niṣkāmaḥ samapadyata ..
athābravīnnijāṃ bhāryāṃ niṣkāmaḥ saṃsthito muniḥ .. 5 ..
5.165.d:
तस्याः संवेशने चैव निष्कामः समपद्यत ..
अथाब्रवीन्निजां भार्यां निष्कामः संस्थितो मुनिः .. 5 ..
5.165.m: became free from desire even at the time of cohabiting with her. / Remaining free from passion, the sage then spoke to his wife: // 5

5.165.s:
ahaṃ yāsyāmi suśroṇi kānanaṃ tapasaḥ kṛte ..
tvaṃ prārthaya varaṃ kaṃcidyenābhīṣṭaṃ dadāmi te .. 6 ..
5.165.d:
अहं यास्यामि सुश्रोणि काननं तपसः कृते ..
त्वं प्रार्थय वरं कंचिद्येनाभीष्टं ददामि ते .. 6 ..
5.165.m: "O lady of beautiful hips, I shall go to the forest for the sake of austerity. / Ask for some boon, so that I may grant your desire." // 6

5.165.s:
sā śrutvā tasya tadvākyaṃ niṣkāmasya prajalpitam ..
vāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā jagāma jananīṃ prati .. 7 ..
5.165.d:
सा श्रुत्वा तस्य तद्वाक्यं निष्कामस्य प्रजल्पितम् ..
वाष्पपूर्णेक्षणा दीना जगाम जननीं प्रति .. 7 ..
5.165.m: Hearing those words of his, uttered as one free from desire, / she, wretched and with eyes filled with tears, went to her mother. // 7

5.165.s:
provāca vacanaṃ tasya sā niṣkāmapate stadā ..
varadānaṃ tathā tena yathoktaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 8 ..
5.165.d:
प्रोवाच वचनं तस्य सा निष्कामपते स्तदा ..
वरदानं तथा तेन यथोक्तं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 8 ..
5.165.m: Then, O best of the twice-born, she related the words of her desireless husband / and how the granting of a boon had been offered by him. // 8

5.165.s:
atha śrutvaiva sā mātā yathā tajjalpitaṃ tayā ..
sutayā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāstato vacanamabravīt .. 9 ..
5.165.d:
अथ श्रुत्वैव सा माता यथा तज्जल्पितं तया ..
सुतया ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठास्ततो वचनमब्रवीत् .. 9 ..
5.165.m: Then, upon hearing what had been spoken by her daughter, / that mother spoke these words, O best of brahmins: // 9

5.165.s:
yadyayaṃ putri te bhartā varaṃ yacchati vāṃchitam ..
tatprārthaya sutaṃ tasmādbrāhmaṇyena samanvitam .. 6.166.10 ..
5.165.d:
यद्ययं पुत्रि ते भर्ता वरं यच्छति वांछितम् ..
