तत्प्रार्थय सुतं तस्माद्ब्राह्मण्येन समन्वितम् .. 6.166.10 ..
5.165.m: "If this husband of yours, O daughter, grants a desired boon, / then ask him for a son endowed with brahminhood; // 10

5.165.s:
madarthaṃ caikaputraṃ ca niḥśeṣakṣāttratejasā ..
saṃyuktaṃ yācaya śubhe viputrā'haṃ yataḥ sthitā .. 11 ..
5.165.d:
मदर्थं चैकपुत्रं च निःशेषक्षात्त्रतेजसा ..
संयुक्तं याचय शुभे विपुत्राऽहं यतः स्थिता .. 11 ..
5.165.m: and for my sake, ask for an only son endowed with the complete / splendor of a kṣatriya, O auspicious one, since I am left without a son." // 11

5.165.s:
sā śrutvā jananīvākyamṛcīkaṃ prāpya suvratā ..
abravījjananī vākyaṃ sarvaṃ vistarato dvijāḥ .. 12 ..
5.165.d:
सा श्रुत्वा जननीवाक्यमृचीकं प्राप्य सुव्रता ..
अब्रवीज्जननी वाक्यं सर्वं विस्तरतो द्विजाः .. 12 ..
5.165.m: Hearing the mother's words, that woman of good vows approached Ṛcīka / and related everything her mother had said in full detail, O twice-born ones. // 12

5.165.s:
sa tasyāśca vacaḥ śrutvā cakārātha carudvayam ..
putreṣṭiṃ vidhivatkṛtvā namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuvam .. 13 ..
5.165.d:
स तस्याश्च वचः श्रुत्वा चकाराथ चरुद्वयम् ..
पुत्रेष्टिं विधिवत्कृत्वा नमस्कृत्य स्वयंभुवम् .. 13 ..
5.165.m: Hearing her words, he then prepared two offerings of boiled rice, / having duly performed a sacrifice for obtaining a son and bowing to the self-manifest one. // 13

5.165.s:
ekasminyojayāmāsa brāhmyaṃ tejo'khilaṃ ca saḥ ..
kṣātraṃ tejastathānyasminsakalaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 14 ..
5.165.d:
एकस्मिन्योजयामास ब्राह्म्यं तेजोऽखिलं च सः ..
क्षात्रं तेजस्तथान्यस्मिन्सकलं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 14 ..
5.165.m: In one he infused all the splendor of a brahmin, / and into the other all the splendor of a kṣatriya, O best of the twice-born. // 14

5.165.s:
bhāryāyai pradadau pūrvaṃ brāhmyaṃ ca carumutta mam..
abravītprāśayitvainamaśvatthāliṃganaṃ kuru .. 15 ..
5.165.d:
भार्यायै प्रददौ पूर्वं ब्राह्म्यं च चरुमुत्त मम्..
अब्रवीत्प्राशयित्वैनमश्वत्थालिंगनं कुरु .. 15 ..
5.165.m: First he gave to his wife the excellent caru imbued with brahminic [power]; / having made her eat it, he said, "Embrace the aśvattha tree. // 15

5.165.s:
tataḥ prāpsyasi satputraṃ brāhmyatejaḥsamanvitam ..
dvitīyaścaruko yaśca taṃ tvaṃ mātre nive daya .. 16 ..
5.165.d:
ततः प्राप्स्यसि सत्पुत्रं ब्राह्म्यतेजःसमन्वितम् ..
द्वितीयश्चरुको यश्च तं त्वं मात्रे निवे दय .. 16 ..
5.165.m: Then you will obtain a virtuous son endowed with the splendor of a brahmin. / And the second caru, that you must present to your mother." // 16

5.165.s:
abravīcca tatastāṃ tu ṛcīko munisattamaḥ ..
tvamenaṃ carukaṃ prāśya nyagrodhāliṃganaṃ kuru .. 17 ..
5.165.d:
अब्रवीच्च ततस्तां तु ऋचीको मुनिसत्तमः ..
त्वमेनं चरुकं प्राश्य न्यग्रोधालिंगनं कुरु .. 17 ..
5.165.m: And Ṛcīka, the best of sages, then said to her: / "Having eaten this caru, let her embrace a nyagrodha tree. // 17

5.165.s:
tataḥ prāpsyasi satputraṃ saṃyuktaṃ kṣātratejasā ..
niḥśeṣeṇa mahābhāge na me syādvacanaṃ vṛthā .. 18 ..
5.165.d:
ततः प्राप्स्यसि सत्पुत्रं संयुक्तं क्षात्रतेजसा ..
निःशेषेण महाभागे न मे स्याद्वचनं वृथा .. 18 ..
5.165.m: Then she will obtain a virtuous son endowed with the entire / splendor of a kṣatriya, O highly fortunate one; my words will not be in vain." // 18

5.165.s:
evamuktvā ṛcīkastu sa visṛjya ca tejasī ..
suhṛṣṭo brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ svayaṃ ca mahito'bhavat ..19..
5.165.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ऋचीकस्तु स विसृज्य च तेजसी ..
सुहृष्टो ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठः स्वयं च महितोऽभवत् ..19..
5.165.m: Having spoken thus, Ṛcīka, having infused the two energies, / that best of brahmins became highly delighted and self-satisfied. // 19

5.165.s:
te caiva tu gṛhe gatvā prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ..
ūcatuśca mithaste ca satyametadbhaviṣyati .. 6.166.20 ..
5.165.d:
ते चैव तु गृहे गत्वा प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना ..
ऊचतुश्च मिथस्ते च सत्यमेतद्भविष्यति .. 6.166.20 ..
5.165.m: They, having gone to their house with delighted inner self, / spoke to one another: "This will indeed come true." // 20

5.165.s:
tato mātā sutāṃ prāha ātmārthe sakalo janaḥ ..
viśeṣaṃ kurute kṛtye sāmānye ca vyavasthite .. 21 ..
5.165.d:
ततो माता सुतां प्राह आत्मार्थे सकलो जनः ..
विशेषं कुरुते कृत्ये सामान्ये च व्यवस्थिते .. 21 ..
5.165.m: Then the mother said to the daughter: "Every person acts with special care / for their own sake in an action, even when it is arranged in common. // 21

5.165.s:
tattavārthaṃ kṛto'nena yaścaruścārulocane ..
yastasminvihito'nena mantragrāmo bhaviṣyati ..
viśeṣeṇa mahābhāge satyametanmayoditam .. 22 ..
5.165.d:
तत्तवार्थं कृतोऽनेन यश्चरुश्चारुलोचने ..
यस्तस्मिन्विहितोऽनेन मन्त्रग्रामो भविष्यति ..
विशेषेण महाभागे सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 22 ..
5.165.m: Therefore, the caru that was prepared by him for your sake, O fair-eyed one, / the collection of mantras applied by him in that [must be] / of a superior nature, O highly fortunate one; this that I say is true. // 22

5.165.s:
tasmācca carukaṃ mahyaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa śucismite ..
ātmīyaṃ mama yacchasva vṛkṣābhyāṃ ca viparyayaḥ ..
kriyatāṃ ca mahābhāge yena me syātsutottamaḥ .. 23 ..
5.165.d:
तस्माच्च चरुकं मह्यं त्वं गृहाण शुचिस्मिते ..
आत्मीयं मम यच्छस्व वृक्षाभ्यां च विपर्ययः ..
क्रियतां च महाभागे येन मे स्यात्सुतोत्तमः .. 23 ..
5.165.m: Therefore, take the caru [meant] for me, O sweet-smiling one, / and give yours to me; and let an exchange / of the two trees be made, O highly fortunate one, so that I may have an excellent son, // 23

5.165.s:
rājyakarmaṇi dakṣaśca śūraḥ parabalārdanaḥ ..
tvadīyo dvijamātro'pi tava tuṣṭiṃ kariṣyati .. 24 ..
5.165.d:
राज्यकर्मणि दक्षश्च शूरः परबलार्दनः ..
त्वदीयो द्विजमात्रोऽपि तव तुष्टिं करिष्यति .. 24 ..
5.165.m: skilled in the duties of kingship, a hero, a crusher of enemy forces. / Yours, even as a mere twice-born, will bring you satisfaction." // 24

5.165.s:
atha sā vijane proktā tayā mātrā yaśasvinī ..
akarodvyatyayaṃ vṛkṣe carau ca dvijasattamāḥ .. 25 ..
5.165.d:
अथ सा विजने प्रोक्ता तया मात्रा यशस्विनी ..
अकरोद्व्यत्ययं वृक्षे चरौ च द्विजसत्तमाः .. 25 ..
5.165.m: Then that illustrious woman, addressed in secret by her mother, / made an exchange of the tree and of the caru, O best of the twice-born. // 25

5.165.s:
tataḥ puṃsa vane snāte te śubhe cārulocane ..
dadhāte garbhamevātha bhartuḥ saṃyogataḥ kṣaṇāt .. 26 ..
5.165.d:
ततः पुंस वने स्नाते ते शुभे चारुलोचने ..
दधाते गर्भमेवाथ भर्तुः संयोगतः क्षणात् .. 26 ..
5.165.m: Then, having bathed after the rite of puṃsavana, those two auspicious, fair-eyed women / instantly conceived a pregnancy through union with their husbands. // 26

5.165.s:
tatastu garbhamāsādya sā ca trailokyasundarī ..
kṣāttreṇa tejasā yuktā tatkṣaṇātsamapadyata ..
mano rājye tataścakre hastyaśvārohaṇodbhave .. 27 ..
5.165.d:
ततस्तु गर्भमासाद्य सा च त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी ..
क्षात्त्रेण तेजसा युक्ता तत्क्षणात्समपद्यत ..
मनो राज्ये ततश्चक्रे हस्त्यश्वारोहणोद्भवे .. 27 ..
5.165.m: Then, having conceived that embryo, that woman of three-world-surpassing beauty / was instantly endowed with kṣatriya splendour. / She then set her mind on royal power arising from mounting elephants and horses.

5.165.s:
yuddhavārttāstathā cakre devāsuragaṇodbhavāḥ ..
śṛṇoti ca tathā nityaṃ vilāseṣu mano dadhe ..
anuṣṭhānaṃ tataścakre manorājyasamudbhavam .. 28 ..
piturgṛhātsamānīya jātyānaśvāṃstathā gajān ..
raktāni caiva vastrāṇi kāśmīrādyaṃ vilepanam .. 29 .1
5.165.d:
युद्धवार्त्तास्तथा चक्रे देवासुरगणोद्भवाः ..
शृणोति च तथा नित्यं विलासेषु मनो दधे ..
अनुष्ठानं ततश्चक्रे मनोराज्यसमुद्भवम् .. 28 ..
पितुर्गृहात्समानीय जात्यानश्वांस्तथा गजान् ..
रक्तानि चैव वस्त्राणि काश्मीराद्यं विलेपनम् .. 29 .1
5.165.m:
She similarly initiated talks of battles arising among the hosts of gods and asuras, / and constantly listened [to them], and set her mind on royal diversions. / She then carried out activities born of a desire for sovereignty.
She brought thoroughbred horses and elephants from her father's house, / as well as red garments and unguents such as saffron.

5.165.s:
taddṛṣṭvā ceṣṭitaṃ tasyā rājyārhaṃ bahubhogadhṛk ..
brāhmaṇārhaiḥ parityaktaṃ samācāraiśca kṛtsnaśaḥ . 6.166.30 ..
5.165.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा चेष्टितं तस्या राज्यार्हं बहुभोगधृक् ..
ब्राह्मणार्हैः परित्यक्तं समाचारैश्च कृत्स्नशः . 6.166.30 ..
5.165.m: Seeing her conduct, fit for royalty, involving many luxuries, / and completely devoid of conduct appropriate for brahmins,

5.165.s:
abravīcca tataḥ kruddho dhikpāpe kimidaṃ kṛtam ..
vyatyayo vihito nūnaṃ carukasya nagasya ca .. 31 ..
tvayā pāpe prapaśyāmi yenedṛktava ceṣṭitam .1
5.165.d:
अब्रवीच्च ततः क्रुद्धो धिक्पापे किमिदं कृतम् ..
व्यत्ययो विहितो नूनं चरुकस्य नगस्य च .. 31 ..
त्वया पापे प्रपश्यामि येनेदृक्तव चेष्टितम् .1
5.165.m:
he then spoke angrily: 'Fie, sinful woman! What is this you have done? / Surely an exchange of the caru and the tree was made
by you, sinful woman! I see [it], since your conduct is of such a kind:

5.165.s: kṣatriyārhaṃ dvijācāraiḥ sakalaiḥ parivarjitam .. 32 ..
5.165.d: क्षत्रियार्हं द्विजाचारैः सकलैः परिवर्जितम् .. 32 ..
5.165.m: suited to a kṣatriya, completely devoid of all brahmin customs,

5.165.s:
cīravalkalasaṃtyaktaṃ snānajāpyavivarjitam ..
saṃyuktaṃ vividhairgandhairmṛganābhipuraḥsaraiḥ . 33 ..
5.165.d:
चीरवल्कलसंत्यक्तं स्नानजाप्यविवर्जितम् ..
संयुक्तं विविधैर्गन्धैर्मृगनाभिपुरःसरैः . 33 ..
5.165.m: abandoning bark garments and rags, devoid of ritual ablutions and prayer-recitations, / and accompanied by various perfumes headed by musk.

5.165.s:
tava mātā śamasthā sā japahomaparāyaṇā ..
tīrthayātrāparā caiva vedaśravaṇalālasā .. 34 ..
5.165.d:
तव माता शमस्था सा जपहोमपरायणा ..
तीर्थयात्रापरा चैव वेदश्रवणलालसा .. 34 ..
5.165.m: Your mother, on the other hand, is established in tranquillity, devoted to prayer-recitation and homa, / intent upon pilgrimage to sacred fords, and eager to hear the Veda.

5.165.s: tasmātte kṣatriyaḥ putro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 35 ..
5.165.d: तस्मात्ते क्षत्रियः पुत्रो भविष्यति न संशयः .. 35 ..
5.165.m: Therefore, your son will be a kṣatriya, there is no doubt.

5.165.s:
mātuśca brāhmaṇaśreṣṭho brahmacaryakathāparaḥ ..
bhaviṣyati sutaścihnairgarbhalakṣaṇasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 36 ..
5.165.d:
मातुश्च ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठो ब्रह्मचर्यकथापरः ..
भविष्यति सुतश्चिह्नैर्गर्भलक्षणसंभवैः .. 36 ..
5.165.m: And your mother's son will be the best of brahmins, devoted to discourses on celibate study, / as shown by the signs arising from the characteristics of pregnancy.

5.165.s:
yasmādudīritaḥ pūrvaṃ śloko'yaṃ śāstracintakaiḥ ..
yādṛśā dohadāḥ santi sagarbhāṇāṃ ca yoṣitām .. 37 ..
5.165.d:
यस्मादुदीरितः पूर्वं श्लोकोऽयं शास्त्रचिन्तकैः ..
यादृशा दोहदाः सन्ति सगर्भाणां च योषिताम् .. 37 ..
5.165.m: For this verse was previously spoken by thinkers on the scriptures: / "Whatever longings of pregnancy women bearing embryos have,

5.165.s:
tādṛgeva svabhāvena tāsāṃ putro'tra jāyate ..
saivamuktā bhayatrastā vepamānā kṛtāṃjaliḥ .. .. 38 ..
5.165.d:
तादृगेव स्वभावेन तासां पुत्रोऽत्र जायते ..
सैवमुक्ता भयत्रस्ता वेपमाना कृतांजलिः .. .. 38 ..
5.165.m: such indeed by nature is the son born to them here."' / Thus addressed, terrified by fear, trembling, with joined palms,

5.165.s:
bāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā vākyametaduvāca ha ..
satyametatprabho vākyaṃ yattvayā samudāhṛtam .. 39 ..
5.165.d:
बाष्पपूर्णेक्षणा दीना वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..
सत्यमेतत्प्रभो वाक्यं यत्त्वया समुदाहृतम् .. 39 ..
5.165.m: with eyes full of tears, miserable, she indeed spoke this word: / 'True is this word, O lord, which has been uttered by you.

5.165.s:
atītānāgataṃ vetti vinā liṃgairbhavāniha ..
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yathā syādbrāhmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ..
kṣatriyasya tu putrasya bhavānnārhaḥ kathaṃcana .. 6.166.40 ..
5.165.d:
अतीतानागतं वेत्ति विना लिंगैर्भवानिह ..
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे यथा स्याद्ब्राह्मणः सुतः ..
क्षत्रियस्य तु पुत्रस्य भवान्नार्हः कथंचन .. 6.166.40 ..
5.165.m: You know the past and the future without external signs here. / Therefore, grant me grace, so that my son may be a brahmin; / for a kṣatriya son is by no means fit for you.'

5.165.s:
.. ṛcīka uvāca .. ..
yatkiṃcidbrahmatejaḥ syāttannyastaṃ te carau mayā ..
kṣāttraṃ tejaśca te māturvyatyayaṃ ca kathaṃcana ..
karomi vādhamo loke śāstra sya ca vyatikramam .. 41 ..
5.165.d:
.. ऋचीक उवाच .. ..
यत्किंचिद्ब्रह्मतेजः स्यात्तन्न्यस्तं ते चरौ मया ..
क्षात्त्रं तेजश्च ते मातुर्व्यत्ययं च कथंचन ..
करोमि वाधमो लोके शास्त्र स्य च व्यतिक्रमम् .. 41 ..
5.165.m: Ṛcīka said: / 'Whatever brahmin splendour there might be, that was placed by me in your caru, / and kṣatriya splendour in your mother's. How could I, / the lowest in the world, make an alteration and a transgression of scripture?'

5.165.s:
.. patnyuvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ bhṛguśārdūla mama pautro'tra yo bhavet ..
kṣāttraṃ tejo'khilaṃ tasya gātre bhūyā ttvayā''hṛtam .. 42 ..
5.165.d:
.. पत्न्युवाच .. ..
यद्येवं भृगुशार्दूल मम पौत्रोऽत्र यो भवेत् ..
क्षात्त्रं तेजोऽखिलं तस्य गात्रे भूया त्त्वया'ऽहृतम् .. 42 ..
5.165.m: The wife said: / 'If it is so, O tiger among the Bhṛgus, whoever may be my grandson here— / let all that kṣatriya splendour brought by you be in his body.

5.165.s: putrastu brāhmaṇaśreṣṭho bhūyādabhyadhikastava .. 43 ..
5.165.d: पुत्रस्तु ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठो भूयादभ्यधिकस्तव .. 43 ..
5.165.m: Let the son, however, be the best of brahmins, even superior to you.'

5.165.s:
.. ṛcīka uvāca .. ..
evaṃ bhavatu madvākyātputraste brāhmaṇaḥ śubhe ..
pautraḥ sudurddharaḥ saṃkhye saṃyuktaḥ kṣāttratejasā .. 44 ..
5.165.d:
.. ऋचीक उवाच .. ..
एवं भवतु मद्वाक्यात्पुत्रस्ते ब्राह्मणः शुभे ..
पौत्रः सुदुर्द्धरः संख्ये संयुक्तः क्षात्त्रतेजसा .. 44 ..
5.165.m: Ṛcīka said: / 'Let it be so by my word, O auspicious one: your son shall be a brahmin, / [and your] grandson, exceedingly invincible in battle, shall be endowed with kṣatriya splendour.'

5.165.s:
tataḥ satyaṃ varaṃ labdhvā prasannavadanā satī ..
māturnivedayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ kāṃta jalpitam .. 45 ..
5.165.d:
ततः सत्यं वरं लब्ध्वा प्रसन्नवदना सती ..
मातुर्निवेदयामास तत्सर्वं कांत जल्पितम् .. 45 ..
5.165.m: Then, having obtained the true boon, the virtuous woman, with a pleased face, / reported to her mother all that had been spoken by her husband.

5.165.s:
tataḥ sā daśame māsi saṃprāpte gurudaivate ..
nakṣatre janayāmāsa putraṃ bālārkasannibham .. 46 ..
5.165.d:
ततः सा दशमे मासि संप्राप्ते गुरुदैवते ..
नक्षत्रे जनयामास पुत्रं बालार्कसन्निभम् .. 46 ..
5.165.m: Then, when the tenth month had arrived, under an asterism presided over by Bṛhaspati, / she gave birth to a son resembling the rising sun,

5.165.s:
brāhmyā lakṣmyā samopetaṃ nidhānaṃ tapasāṃ śuci ..
jamadagniriti khyāto yo'sau trailokyaviśrutaḥ ..
tasya putrobhavatkhyāto rāmonāma mahāyaśāḥ .. 47 ..
5.165.d:
ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या समोपेतं निधानं तपसां शुचि ..
जमदग्निरिति ख्यातो योऽसौ त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतः ..
तस्य पुत्रोभवत्ख्यातो रामोनाम महायशाः .. 47 ..
5.165.m: endowed with brahmin splendour, a pure treasure of austerities, / known as Jamadagni, who is celebrated throughout the three worlds. / His son was the famous Rāma, of great renown,

5.165.s:
ekaviṃśatidā yena dharā niḥkṣatriyā kṛtā ..
kṣāttratejaḥprabhāvena pitāmahaprasādataḥ .. 48 ..
5.165.d:
एकविंशतिदा येन धरा निःक्षत्रिया कृता ..
क्षात्त्रतेजःप्रभावेन पितामहप्रसादतः .. 48 ..
5.165.m: by whom the earth was made devoid of kṣatriyas twenty-one times, / by the power of kṣatriya splendour, through the grace of his grandfather.

5.165.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye paraśurāmotpattivarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 166 ..
5.165.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्या संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये परशुरामोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम षट्षष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 166 ..
5.165.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Birth of Paraśurāma', in the māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.166.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
gādhestu yā'tha patnī ca prāśanāccaru kasya vai ..
sāpi garbhaṃ dadhe tatra vāsare mantrataḥ śubhā .. 1 ..
5.166.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
गाधेस्तु याऽथ पत्नी च प्राशनाच्चरु कस्य वै ..
सापि गर्भं दधे तत्र वासरे मन्त्रतः शुभा .. 1 ..
5.166.m: Sūta said: / Now the wife of Gādhi, from consuming the caru, / also conceived an embryo on that day, through the mantra, auspiciously.

5.166.s:
sā ca garbhasamopetā yadā jātā dvijottamāḥ ..
tīrthayātrāparā sādhvī jātā vrataparāyaṇā .. 2 ..
5.166.d:
सा च गर्भसमोपेता यदा जाता द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तीर्थयात्रापरा साध्वी जाता व्रतपरायणा .. 2 ..
5.166.m: When that virtuous woman became endowed with the embryo, O best of brahmins, / she became devoted to pilgrimages to sacred fords, intent upon vows.

5.166.s:
vedadhvanirbhavedyatra tatra harṣasamanvitā ..
pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgī sā śuśrāva ca sarvadā ..
tyaktvā rājyocitānsarvānalaṃkārānsukhāni ca .. .. 3 ..
5.166.d:
वेदध्वनिर्भवेद्यत्र तत्र हर्षसमन्विता ..
पुलकांचितसर्वांगी सा शुश्राव च सर्वदा ..
त्यक्त्वा राज्योचितान्सर्वानलंकारान्सुखानि च .. .. 3 ..
5.166.m: Wherever the sound of the Veda arose, filled with joy there, / her limbs thrilled with horripilation, she constantly listened, / having abandoned all ornaments and pleasures suited to royalty.

5.166.s:
atha sāpi dvijaśreṣṭhā daśame māsi saṃsthite ..
suṣuve suprabhaṃ putraṃ brāhmyā lakṣmyā samāvṛtam .. 4 ..
5.166.d:
अथ सापि द्विजश्रेष्ठा दशमे मासि संस्थिते ..
सुषुवे सुप्रभं पुत्रं ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या समावृतम् .. 4 ..
5.166.m: Then, O best of brahmins, when the tenth month arrived, / she too gave birth to a son of great lustre, surrounded by brahmin splendour,

5.166.s:
viśvāmitrastathā khyātastrailokye sacarā care ..
vavṛdhe sa mahābhāgo nityamevādhikaṃ nṛṇām .. 5 ..
5.166.d:
विश्वामित्रस्तथा ख्यातस्त्रैलोक्ये सचरा चरे ..
ववृधे स महाभागो नित्यमेवाधिकं नृणाम् .. 5 ..
5.166.m: known as Viśvāmitra in the three worlds of moving and unmoving beings. / That illustrious one grew daily, surpassing other men,

5.166.s:
śuklapakṣaṃ samāsādya tārāpatirivāṃbare ..
yadāsau yauvanopetaḥ saṃjāto dvijasattamāḥ .. 6 ..
5.166.d:
शुक्लपक्षं समासाद्य तारापतिरिवांबरे ..
यदासौ यौवनोपेतः संजातो द्विजसत्तमाः .. 6 ..
5.166.m: like the lord of the stars in the sky entering the bright fortnight. / When he grew up and reached youth, O best of brahmins,

5.166.s:
rājyakṣamastadā rājye gādhinā sa niyojitaḥ ..
anicchamānaḥ svaṃ rājyaṃ pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat .. 7 ..
5.166.d:
राज्यक्षमस्तदा राज्ये गाधिना स नियोजितः ..
अनिच्छमानः स्वं राज्यं पितृपैतामहं महत् .. 7 ..
5.166.m: capable of ruling, he was installed in the kingdom by Gādhi, / though he was unwilling [to take] his great ancestral kingdom.

5.166.s:
vedādhyayanasaṃpanno nityaṃ ca paṭhate hi saḥ ..
brāhmaṇocitamārgeṇa gacchamāno divāniśam .. 8 ..
5.166.d:
वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नो नित्यं च पठते हि सः ..
ब्राह्मणोचितमार्गेण गच्छमानो दिवानिशम् .. 8 ..
5.166.m: Accomplished in the study of the Veda, he recited it constantly, / walking day and night along the path appropriate for a brahmin.

5.166.s:
saṃsthāpyātha sutaṃ rājye babhūva vanagocaraḥ ..
sakalatro mahābhāgo vānaprasthāśrame rataḥ .. 9 ..
5.166.d:
संस्थाप्याथ सुतं राज्ये बभूव वनगोचरः ..
सकलत्रो महाभागो वानप्रस्थाश्रमे रतः .. 9 ..
5.166.m: Then, having established his son in the kingdom, the illustrious one became a dweller of the forest / with his wife, devoted to the forest-dwelling stage of life.

5.166.s:
viśvāmitro'pi rājyastho dvijasaṃpūjane rataḥ ..
dvijaiḥ sarvaiścacārātha snānajāpyaparāyaṇaḥ .. 6.167.10 ..
5.166.d:
विश्वामित्रोऽपि राज्यस्थो द्विजसंपूजने रतः ..
द्विजैः सर्वैश्चचाराथ स्नानजाप्यपरायणः .. 6.167.10 ..
5.166.m: Viśvāmitra too, situated in the kingdom, remained devoted to worshipping brahmins, / and lived among all the brahmins, intent upon ritual ablution and prayer-recitation.

5.166.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya pāparddhiṃ samupāgataḥ ..
praviveśa vanaṃ raudraṃ nānāmṛgasamākulam .. 11 ..
5.166.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य पापर्द्धिं समुपागतः ..
प्रविवेश वनं रौद्रं नानामृगसमाकुलम् .. 11 ..
5.166.m: Then, at some time, having gone out on a hunt, / he entered a fierce forest filled with various wild beasts.

5.166.s:
jaghāna sa vane tatra varāhānsaṃbarāngajān ..
tarakṣāṃśca rurūnkhaḍgānāraṇyānmahiṣāṃstathā .. 12 ..
5.166.d:
जघान स वने तत्र वराहान्संबरान्गजान् ..
तरक्षांश्च रुरून्खड्गानारण्यान्महिषांस्तथा .. 12 ..
5.166.m: In that forest he slew boars, sambar deer, elephants, / hyenas, ruru deer, rhinoceroses, and wild buffaloes,

5.166.s:
siṃhānvyāghrānmahāsarpāñcharabhāṃśca dvijottamāḥ ..
mṛgayāsaktacittaḥ sa bhramamāṇo mahāvane .. 13 ..
5.166.d:
सिंहान्व्याघ्रान्महासर्पाञ्छरभांश्च द्विजोत्तमाः ..
मृगयासक्तचित्तः स भ्रममाणो महावने .. 13 ..
5.166.m: lions, tigers, great serpents, and śarabhas, O best of brahmins. / His mind intent on the hunt, as he roamed in the great forest,

5.166.s:
madhyāhnasamaye prāpte vṛṣasthe ca divākare ..
kṣutpipāsāpariśrāṃto viśvāmitro dvijottamāḥ .. 14 ..
5.166.d:
मध्याह्नसमये प्राप्ते वृषस्थे च दिवाकरे ..
क्षुत्पिपासापरिश्रांतो विश्वामित्रो द्विजोत्तमाः .. 14 ..
5.166.m: when midday arrived and the sun stood in Taurus, / Viśvāmitra, exhausted with hunger and thirst, O best of brahmins,

5.166.s:
āsasādāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ..
vasiṣṭho'pi samālokya viśvāmitraṃ nṛpo ttamam .. 15 ..
5.166.d:
आससादाश्रमं पुण्यं वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः ..
वसिष्ठोऽपि समालोक्य विश्वामित्रं नृपो त्तमम् .. 15 ..
5.166.m: reached the holy hermitage of the great-souled Vasiṣṭha. / Vasiṣṭha also, seeing Viśvāmitra, the best of kings,

5.166.s:
nijāśrame tu saṃprāptaṃ sānandaṃ sammukho yayau ..
dattvā tasmai tadārghyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca bhūbhuje .. 16 ..
5.166.d:
निजाश्रमे तु संप्राप्तं सानन्दं सम्मुखो ययौ ..
दत्त्वा तस्मै तदार्घ्यं च मधुपर्कं च भूभुजे .. 16 ..
5.166.m: arrived at his own hermitage, went forward to meet him with joy. / Having given the water offering and the honey-mixture to that king,

5.166.s:
abravīcca tato vākyaṃ svāgataṃ te mahīpate ..
vada kṛtyaṃ karomyeva gṛhāyātasya yacca te .. 17 ..
5.166.d:
अब्रवीच्च ततो वाक्यं स्वागतं ते महीपते ..
वद कृत्यं करोम्येव गृहायातस्य यच्च ते .. 17 ..
5.166.m: he then spoke these words: 'Welcome to you, O lord of the earth! / Speak what duty there is, and I shall certainly do it for you who have come to my home.'

5.166.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
mṛgayāyāṃ pariśrāṃtaḥ pipāsāvyākulendriyaḥ ..
pānārthamiha saṃprāpta āśrame te munīśvara .. 18 ..
5.166.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
मृगयायां परिश्रांतः पिपासाव्याकुलेन्द्रियः ..
पानार्थमिह संप्राप्त आश्रमे ते मुनीश्वर .. 18 ..
5.166.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Exhausted from hunting, my senses overcome with thirst, / I have arrived here at your hermitage, O lord of sages, in search of a drink.

5.166.s:
tatpītaṃ śītalaṃ toyaṃ vitṛṣṇo'haṃ vyavasthitaḥ ..
anujñāṃ dehi me brahmanyena gacchāmi maṃdiram .. .. 19 ..
5.166.d:
तत्पीतं शीतलं तोयं वितृष्णोऽहं व्यवस्थितः ..
अनुज्ञां देहि मे ब्रह्मन्येन गच्छामि मंदिरम् .. .. 19 ..
5.166.m: I have drunk that cool water and my thirst is quenched. / Give me leave, O brahmin, so that I may return to my abode.

5.166.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
madhyāhna samayo raudraḥ sūryo'tīva sutāpadaḥ ..
tatkṛtvā bhojanaṃ rājannaparāhṇe vyavasthite ..
gantāsi nijamāvāsaṃ bhuktvānnaṃ mama cāśrame .. 6.167.20 ..
5.166.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
मध्याह्न समयो रौद्रः सूर्योऽतीव सुतापदः ..
तत्कृत्वा भोजनं राजन्नपराह्णे व्यवस्थिते ..
गन्तासि निजमावासं भुक्त्वान्नं मम चाश्रमे .. 6.167.20 ..
5.166.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / The midday hour is fierce; the sun causes extreme distress. / Therefore, having taken food, O king, when the afternoon has set in, / after eating a meal in my hermitage, you may go to your own dwelling.

5.166.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
caturaṃgeṇa sainyena mṛgayāmahamāgataḥ .. 21 ..
5.166.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
चतुरंगेण सैन्येन मृगयामहमागतः .. 21 ..
5.166.m: The king said: / I came hunting with a fourfold army.

5.166.s:
tavāśramasya dvārasthaṃ mama sainyaṃ vyavasthitam..
bubhukṣiteṣu bhṛtyeṣu yaḥ svāmī kurute'śanam ..22..
5.166.d:
तवाश्रमस्य द्वारस्थं मम सैन्यं व्यवस्थितम्..
बुभुक्षितेषु भृत्येषु यः स्वामी कुरुतेऽशनम् ..22..
5.166.m: My army stands waiting at the entrance to your hermitage. / When servants are hungry, a master who eats food [alone]

5.166.s:
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tyajyate ca guṇairdrutam ..
tasmādājñāpaya kṣipraṃ māṃ mune svagṛhāya bhoḥ ..23.. ..
5.166.d:
स याति नरकं घोरं त्यज्यते च गुणैर्द्रुतम् ..
तस्मादाज्ञापय क्षिप्रं मां मुने स्वगृहाय भोः ..23.. ..
5.166.m: goes to a terrible hell and is quickly abandoned by good qualities. / Therefore, O sage, quickly grant me leave to go to my own house.

5.166.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
yadi te sevakāḥ saṃti dvāradeśe bubhukṣitāḥ ..
sarvānihānaya kṣipraṃ tṛptiṃ neṣyāmyahaṃ param .. 24 ..
5.166.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
यदि ते सेवकाः संति द्वारदेशे बुभुक्षिताः ..
सर्वानिहानय क्षिप्रं तृप्तिं नेष्याम्यहं परम् .. 24 ..
5.166.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / If your attendants are hungry at the gate, / bring them all here at once; I shall completely satisfy them.

5.166.s:
asti me nandinīnāma kāmadhenuḥ suśobhanā ..
vāṃchitaṃ yacchate sarvaṃ tapasā pārthivottama .. 25 ..
5.166.d:
अस्ति मे नन्दिनीनाम कामधेनुः सुशोभना ..
वांछितं यच्छते सर्वं तपसा पार्थिवोत्तम .. 25 ..
5.166.m: I have a wish-granting cow named Nandinī, exceedingly splendid, / who grants every desired thing through austerity, O best of earthly rulers.

5.166.s:
tṛptiṃ neṣyati te sarvaṃ sainyaṃ pārthivasattama ..
tasmādānīyatāṃ kṣipraṃ paśya me dhenujaṃ phalam .. 26 ..
5.166.d:
तृप्तिं नेष्यति ते सर्वं सैन्यं पार्थिवसत्तम ..
तस्मादानीयतां क्षिप्रं पश्य मे धेनुजं फलम् .. 26 ..
5.166.m: She will fully satisfy your entire army, O best of earthly rulers. / Therefore, let it be brought at once; behold the fruit born of my cow.

5.166.s:
tacchrutvā cānayāmāsa sarvaṃ sainyaṃ mahīpatiḥ ..
snātaśca kṛtajapyaśca santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..27..
5.166.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा चानयामास सर्वं सैन्यं महीपतिः ..
स्नातश्च कृतजप्यश्च सन्तर्प्य पितृदेवताः ..27..
5.166.m: Hearing that, the king brought in his entire army. / Having bathed, performed his prayers, and offered libations to the ancestors and gods,

5.166.s:
brāhmaṇānvācayitvā ca siṃhāsanasamāśritaḥ ..
etasminnaṃtare dhenuḥ samāhūtā ca naṃdinī .. 28 ..
5.166.d:
ब्राह्मणान्वाचयित्वा च सिंहासनसमाश्रितः ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे धेनुः समाहूता च नंदिनी .. 28 ..
5.166.m: and having had the brahmins chant blessings, he sat upon a throne. / Meanwhile, the cow Nandinī was called.

5.166.s:
vasiṣṭhena samāhūtā viśvāmitrapuraḥsthitā ..
abravīcca tatā vākyaṃ vasiṣṭhamṛṣi sattamam .. 29 ..
5.166.d:
वसिष्ठेन समाहूता विश्वामित्रपुरःस्थिता ..
अब्रवीच्च तता वाक्यं वसिष्ठमृषि सत्तमम् .. 29 ..
5.166.m: Summoned by Vasiṣṭha, standing before Viśvāmitra, / she then addressed these words to Vasiṣṭha, the best of seers:

5.166.s: ādeśo dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām .. 6.167.30 ..
5.166.d: आदेशो दीयतां मह्यं किं करोमि प्रशाधि माम् .. 6.167.30 ..
5.166.m: Give the command to me. What shall I do? Instruct me.

5.166.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
pādaprakṣālanādyaṃ tu kuruṣva vacanānmama ..
viśvāmitrasya rājarṣeryāvadbhojanasaṃsthitim .. 31 ..
5.166.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
पादप्रक्षालनाद्यं तु कुरुष्व वचनान्मम ..
विश्वामित्रस्य राजर्षेर्यावद्भोजनसंस्थितिम् .. 31 ..
5.166.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / At my word, perform all hospitality, beginning with washing the feet, / for royal seer Viśvāmitra, right up to the serving of a meal,

5.166.s:
khādyaiḥ sarvaistathā lehyaiścoṣyaiḥ peyaiḥ pṛthavidhaiḥ ..
kuruṣva tṛptiparyantaṃ sasainyasya mahīpateḥ ..
aśvānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca ghāsādibhiryathākramam .. 32 ..
5.166.d:
खाद्यैः सर्वैस्तथा लेह्यैश्चोष्यैः पेयैः पृथविधैः ..
कुरुष्व तृप्तिपर्यन्तं ससैन्यस्य महीपतेः ..
अश्वानां च गजानां च घासादिभिर्यथाक्रमम् .. 32 ..
5.166.m: with all kinds of foods to chew, to lick, to suck, and to drink, / so as to bring complete satisfaction to the king together with his army, / and for his horses and elephants with fodder and the like in due order.

5.166.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bāḍhamityeva sāpyuktvā tatastatsasṛje kṣaṇāt..
yatproktaṃ tena muninā bhṛtyānāṃ cāyutaṃ tathā .. 33 ..
5.166.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
बाढमित्येव साप्युक्त्वा ततस्तत्ससृजे क्षणात्..
यत्प्रोक्तं तेन मुनिना भृत्यानां चायुतं तथा .. 33 ..
5.166.m: Sūta said: / Saying "So be it," she immediately produced all that / which was spoken by that sage, as well as ten thousand attendants.

5.166.s:
tataste sarvamādāya bhṛtyā bhojyaṃ dadustathā ..
ekaikasya pṛthaktvena pratipattipuraḥsaram .. 34 ..
5.166.d:
ततस्ते सर्वमादाय भृत्या भोज्यं ददुस्तथा ..
एकैकस्य पृथक्त्वेन प्रतिपत्तिपुरःसरम् .. 34 ..
5.166.m: Then those attendants, taking everything, served the food, / individually to each person with due respect.

5.166.s:
evaṃ tayā kṣaṇenaiva tṛptiṃ nīto mahīpatiḥ ..
sasainyaḥ saparīvāro gajoṣṭrāśvairvṛṣaiḥ saha .. 35 ..
5.166.d:
एवं तया क्षणेनैव तृप्तिं नीतो महीपतिः ..
ससैन्यः सपरीवारो गजोष्ट्राश्वैर्वृषैः सह .. 35 ..
5.166.m: In this way, in an instant, the king was fully satisfied by her, / together with his army, his retinue, along with his elephants, camels, horses, and oxen.

5.166.s:
tatastu kautukaṃ dṛṣṭvā viśvāmitro mahīpatiḥ ..
sāmātyo visma yāviṣṭo mantrayāmāsa ca dvijāḥ .. 36 ..
5.166.d:
ततस्तु कौतुकं दृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रो महीपतिः ..
सामात्यो विस्म याविष्टो मन्त्रयामास च द्विजाः .. 36 ..
5.166.m: Then, having seen that marvel, King Viśvāmitra, / together with his ministers, was filled with astonishment and consulted, O twice-born ones:

5.166.s:
aho citramaho citraṃ yayā'kasmādvarūthinī ..
tṛptiṃ nīteyamasmākaṃ kṣutpipāsāsamākulā .. 37 ..
5.166.d:
अहो चित्रमहो चित्रं ययाऽकस्माद्वरूथिनी ..
तृप्तिं नीतेयमस्माकं क्षुत्पिपासासमाकुला .. 37 ..
5.166.m: Ah, what a wonder! Ah, what a wonder! By whom our entire army, / afflicted with hunger and thirst, has been satisfied all at once!

5.166.s:
tasmātsaṃnīyatāmeṣā svagṛhaṃ dhenuruttamā ..
kiṃ kariṣyati vipro'yaṃ nirbhṛtyo vanasaṃsthitaḥ ..38..
5.166.d:
तस्मात्संनीयतामेषा स्वगृहं धेनुरुत्तमा ..
किं करिष्यति विप्रोऽयं निर्भृत्यो वनसंस्थितः ..38..
5.166.m: Therefore, let this excellent cow be taken to my own house. / What will this brahmin do with her, living in the forest without any servants?

5.166.s:
tato vasiṣṭhamāhūya vākyametaduvāca saḥ ..
naṃdinī dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ kiṃ kariṣyasi cānayā .. 39 ..
5.166.d:
ततो वसिष्ठमाहूय वाक्यमेतदुवाच सः ..
नंदिनी दीयतां मह्यं किं करिष्यसि चानया .. 39 ..
5.166.m: Then, summoning Vasiṣṭha, he spoke these words: / Let Nandinī be given to me. What will you do with her?

5.166.s:
tvameko vanasaṃsthastu nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ ..
athavā tava dāsyāmi vyayārthe munisattama ..
varāngrāmāṃśca hastyaśvānanyāṃścāpi yathepsitān .. 6.167.40 ..
5.166.d:
त्वमेको वनसंस्थस्तु निर्द्वन्द्वो निष्परिग्रहः ..
अथवा तव दास्यामि व्ययार्थे मुनिसत्तम ..
वरान्ग्रामांश्च हस्त्यश्वानन्यांश्चापि यथेप्सितान् .. 6.167.40 ..
5.166.m: You dwell alone in the forest, free from dualities and devoid of possessions. / Otherwise, I will give you, for your expenses, O best of sages, / excellent villages, elephants, horses, and other things as you desire.

5.166.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
homadhenuriyaṃ rājannasmākaṃ kāmadohinī ..
adeyā gaurmahārāja sāmānyāpi dvijanmanām.. 41 ..
5.166.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
होमधेनुरियं राजन्नस्माकं कामदोहिनी ..
अदेया गौर्महाराज सामान्यापि द्विजन्मनाम्.. 41 ..
5.166.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / This is my sacrificial cow, O king, which yields whatever is desired. / A cow is not to be given away, O great king, even an ordinary one belonging to twice-born men;

5.166.s:
kiṃ punarnaṃdinī yaiṣā sarvakāmapradāyinī ..
aparaṃ śṛṇu rājeṃdra smṛtivākyamanuttamam .. 42 ..
5.166.d:
किं पुनर्नंदिनी यैषा सर्वकामप्रदायिनी ..
अपरं शृणु राजेंद्र स्मृतिवाक्यमनुत्तमम् .. 42 ..
5.166.m: how much less Nandinī, who bestows all desires! / Hear another supreme statement from the Smṛti, O Indra among kings:

5.166.s:
gavāṃ hi vikrayārthe ca yaduktaṃ manunā svayam ..
gavāṃ vikrayajaṃ vittaṃ yo gṛhṇāti dvijottamaḥ .. 43 ..
5.166.d:
गवां हि विक्रयार्थे च यदुक्तं मनुना स्वयम् ..
गवां विक्रयजं वित्तं यो गृह्णाति द्विजोत्तमः .. 43 ..
5.166.m: regarding the sale of cows, which was spoken by Manu himself: / "The best of twice-born men who accepts wealth born from the sale of cows

5.166.s:
antyajaḥ sa parijñeyo mātṛvikrayakārakaḥ ..
tasmānnāhaṃ pradāsyāmi nandinīṃ tāṃ mahīpate .. 44 ..
5.166.d:
अन्त्यजः स परिज्ञेयो मातृविक्रयकारकः ..
तस्मान्नाहं प्रदास्यामि नन्दिनीं तां महीपते .. 44 ..
5.166.m: is to be regarded as an outcaste, a seller of his own mother." / Therefore I will not give away that Nandinī, O king,

5.166.s:
na sāmnā naiva bhedena na dānena kathaṃcana ..
na daṇḍena mahārāja tasmādgaccha nijālayam .. 45 .. ..
5.166.d:
न साम्ना नैव भेदेन न दानेन कथंचन ..
न दण्डेन महाराज तस्माद्गच्छ निजालयम् .. 45 .. ..
5.166.m: neither by conciliation, nor by division, nor by gifts of any kind, / nor by force, O great king. Therefore, go to your own abode.

5.166.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
yatkiṃcidvidyate ratnaṃ pārthivasya kṣitau dvija ..
tatsarvaṃ rājakīyaṃ syāditi vittavido viduḥ .. 46 ..
5.166.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
यत्किंचिद्विद्यते रत्नं पार्थिवस्य क्षितौ द्विज ..
तत्सर्वं राजकीयं स्यादिति वित्तविदो विदुः .. 46 ..
5.166.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Whatever jewel exists on earth belongs to the king, O twice-born one; / all that is royal property—so say those who know about wealth.

5.166.s:
ratnabhūtā tato dhenurmameyaṃ naṃdinī sthitā ..
daṇḍenāpi grahīṣyāmi sāmnā yacchasi no yadi .. 47 ..
5.166.d:
रत्नभूता ततो धेनुर्ममेयं नंदिनी स्थिता ..
दण्डेनापि ग्रहीष्यामि साम्ना यच्छसि नो यदि .. 47 ..
5.166.m: Therefore this cow Nandinī, being a jewel, is mine. / I will take her even by force if you do not give her by conciliation.

5.166.s:
evamuktvā vasiṣṭhaṃ sa viśvāmitro mahīpatiḥ ..
ādideśa tato bhṛtyānnadinīyaṃ pragṛhyatām .. 48 ..
5.166.d:
एवमुक्त्वा वसिष्ठं स विश्वामित्रो महीपतिः ..
आदिदेश ततो भृत्यान्नदिनीयं प्रगृह्यताम् .. 48 ..
5.166.m: Having spoken thus to Vasiṣṭha, King Viśvāmitra / then ordered his servants: "Let this Nandinī be seized!"

5.166.s:
atha sā bhṛtyavargeṇa nīyamānā ca naṃdinī ..
hanyamānā prahāraiśca pāṣāṇairlakuṭairapi .. 49 ..
5.166.d:
अथ सा भृत्यवर्गेण नीयमाना च नंदिनी ..
हन्यमाना प्रहारैश्च पाषाणैर्लकुटैरपि .. 49 ..
5.166.m: Then, being dragged away by the troop of servants, / struck with blows, stones, and clubs,

5.166.s:
aśrupūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā prahārairjarjarīkṛtā ..
kṛcchrādupetya taṃ prāha vasiṣṭhaṃ munisattamam .. 6.167.50 ..
5.166.d:
अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणा दीना प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृता ..
कृच्छ्रादुपेत्य तं प्राह वसिष्ठं मुनिसत्तमम् .. 6.167.50 ..
5.166.m: her eyes filled with tears, miserable, battered by blows, / approaching with difficulty, she spoke to Vasiṣṭha, the best of sages:

5.166.s:
kiṃ dattāsmi muniśreṣṭha tvayāhaṃ cāsya bhūpateḥ ..
yena māṃ kālayaṃtyasya puruṣāḥ svāmino yathā .. 51 ..
5.166.d:
किं दत्तास्मि मुनिश्रेष्ठ त्वयाहं चास्य भूपतेः ..
येन मां कालयंत्यस्य पुरुषाः स्वामिनो यथा .. 51 ..
5.166.m: Have I been given away by you, O best of sages, to this king, / that his men drive me away as if they were my masters?

5.166.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
na tvāṃ yacchāmyahaṃ dheno prāṇatyāge'pi saṃsthite ..
tadrakṣasva svayaṃ dheno ātmānaṃ matprabhāvataḥ .. 52 ..
5.166.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
न त्वां यच्छाम्यहं धेनो प्राणत्यागेऽपि संस्थिते ..
तद्रक्षस्व स्वयं धेनो आत्मानं मत्प्रभावतः .. 52 ..
5.166.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / I do not give you away, O cow, even if it costs my life! / Therefore protect yourself, O cow, through my spiritual power.

5.166.s:
evamuktā tadā dhenurvasiṣṭhena mahātmanā ..
kopāviṣṭā tataścakre huṃkārāndāruṇāṃstathā .. 53 ..
5.166.d:
एवमुक्ता तदा धेनुर्वसिष्ठेन महात्मना ..
कोपाविष्टा ततश्चक्रे हुंकारान्दारुणांस्तथा .. 53 ..
5.166.m: Spoken to in this way by the great-souled Vasiṣṭha, / the cow, seized by anger, then let out terrible roars of rage.

5.166.s:
tasyā huṃkāraśabdaiśca niṣkrāṃtāḥ sāyudhā narāḥ ..
śabarāśca puliṃdāśca mlecchāḥ saṃkhyāvivarjitāḥ .. 54 ..
5.166.d:
तस्या हुंकारशब्दैश्च निष्क्रांताः सायुधा नराः ..
शबराश्च पुलिंदाश्च म्लेच्छाः संख्याविवर्जिताः .. 54 ..
5.166.m: And from the sounds of her roars came forth armed men: / Śabaras, Pulindas, and Mlecchas beyond count.

5.166.s:
taiśca bhṛtyā hatāḥ sarve viśvāmitrasyabhūpateḥ ..
tataḥ kopābhibhūto'sau viśvāmitro mahīpatiḥ.. 55 ..
5.166.d:
तैश्च भृत्या हताः सर्वे विश्वामित्रस्यभूपतेः ..
ततः कोपाभिभूतोऽसौ विश्वामित्रो महीपतिः.. 55 ..
5.166.m: And by them all the servants of King Viśvāmitra were slain. / Then, overcome with rage, King Viśvāmitra,

5.166.s:
sajjaṃ kṛtvā svasainyaṃ tu caturaṃgaṃ prakopataḥ..
yuddhaṃ cakre ca taiḥ sārdhaṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ .. 56 ..
5.166.d:
सज्जं कृत्वा स्वसैन्यं तु चतुरंगं प्रकोपतः..
युद्धं चक्रे च तैः सार्धं मरणे कृतनिश्चयः .. 56 ..
5.166.m: marshaling his fourfold army in fury, / fought with them, determined to die [or conquer].

5.166.s:
atha te sainikā stasya te gajāste ca vājinaḥ..
paśyato nihatāḥ sarve puruṣairdhenusaṃbhavaiḥ..57..
5.166.d:
अथ ते सैनिका स्तस्य ते गजास्ते च वाजिनः..
पश्यतो निहताः सर्वे पुरुषैर्धेनुसंभवैः..57..
5.166.m: Then his soldiers, his elephants, and his horses / were all slain before his eyes by the men born of the cow.

5.166.s:
viśvāmitraṃ parityajya śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ nipātitam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā veṣṭitaṃ mlecchairyu dhyamānaṃ mahīpatim .. 58 ..
5.166.d:
विश्वामित्रं परित्यज्य शेषं सर्वं निपातितम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा वेष्टितं म्लेच्छैर्यु ध्यमानं महीपतिम् .. 58 ..
5.166.m: Leaving aside Viśvāmitra, everyone else was struck down. / Seeing that king surrounded by Mlecchas and continuing to fight,

5.166.s:
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vasiṣṭhastu nandinīmidamabravīt ..
rakṣa naṃdini bhūpālaṃ mlecchairetaiḥ samāvṛtam .. 59 ..
5.166.d:
कृपां कृत्वा वसिष्ठस्तु नन्दिनीमिदमब्रवीत् ..
रक्ष नंदिनि भूपालं म्लेच्छैरेतैः समावृतम् .. 59 ..
5.166.m:
Taking pity, Vasiṣṭha said to Nandinī:
“Protect, O Nandinī, the king surrounded by these mlecchas!

5.166.s:
rājā hi yatnato rakṣyo yatprasādādidaṃ jagat ..
sanmārge vartate sarvaṃ na cāmārge pravartate .. 6.167.60 ..
5.166.d:
राजा हि यत्नतो रक्ष्यो यत्प्रसादादिदं जगत् ..
सन्मार्गे वर्तते सर्वं न चामार्गे प्रवर्तते .. 6.167.60 ..
5.166.m:
For a king must be protected with diligence, by whose grace this entire world
walks upon the right path and does not turn to an evil way.”

5.166.s:
tatastu naṃdinīṃ yāvanniṣedhayitumāgatām ..
viśvāmitro'simudyamya prahartumupacakrame .. 61 ..
5.166.d:
ततस्तु नंदिनीं यावन्निषेधयितुमागताम् ..
विश्वामित्रोऽसिमुद्यम्य प्रहर्तुमुपचक्रमे .. 61 ..
5.166.m:
Then, as Nandinī approached to restrain [the mlecchas],
Viśvāmitra raised his sword and prepared to strike [her].

5.166.s:
vasiṣṭho'pi samālokya vadhyamānāṃ ca tāṃ tadā ..
bāhuṃ saṃstaṃbhayāmāsa khaḍgaṃ tasya ca bhūpateḥ .. 62 ..
5.166.d:
वसिष्ठोऽपि समालोक्य वध्यमानां च तां तदा ..
बाहुं संस्तंभयामास खड्गं तस्य च भूपतेः .. 62 ..
5.166.m:
Vasiṣṭha, seeing her about to be struck down at that moment,
paralyzed the king’s arm and his sword.

5.166.s:
atha vailakṣyamāpanno viśvāmitro mahīpatiḥ ..
provāca vrīḍayā yukto vasiṣṭhaṃ munisattamam.. 63 ..
5.166.d:
अथ वैलक्ष्यमापन्नो विश्वामित्रो महीपतिः ..
प्रोवाच व्रीडया युक्तो वसिष्ठं मुनिसत्तमम्.. 63 ..
5.166.m:
Then King Viśvāmitra, overcome with shame,
and filled with embarrassment, said to Vasiṣṭha, best of munis:

5.166.s:
rakṣa māṃ tvaṃ muniśreṣṭha vadhyamānaṃ sudāruṇaiḥ ..
mlecchaiḥ kuruṣva me bāhuṃ stambhena tu vivarjitam .. 64 ..
5.166.d:
रक्ष मां त्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठ वध्यमानं सुदारुणैः ..
म्लेच्छैः कुरुष्व मे बाहुं स्तम्भेन तु विवर्जितम् .. 64 ..
5.166.m:
“Save me, O best of munis, being slain by these most dreadful
mlecchas! Free my arm from this paralysis!

5.166.s:
mamāparādhātsaṃnaṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ sainyamanantakam..
tasmādyāsyāmyahaṃ harmyaṃ na yuddhena prayojanam .. 65 ..
5.166.d:
ममापराधात्संनष्टं सर्वं सैन्यमनन्तकम्..
तस्माद्यास्याम्यहं हर्म्यं न युद्धेन प्रयोजनम् .. 65 ..
5.166.m:
By my own fault my entire vast army has perished;
therefore I will go to my palace—there is no purpose in fighting.

5.166.s:
durvinītaḥ śriyaṃ prāpya vidyāmaiśvaryameva ca ..
na tiṣṭhati ciraṃ yuddhe yathāhaṃ madagarvitaḥ .. 66 ..
5.166.d:
दुर्विनीतः श्रियं प्राप्य विद्यामैश्वर्यमेव च ..
न तिष्ठति चिरं युद्धे यथाहं मदगर्वितः .. 66 ..
5.166.m:
One ill-disciplined, even having attained fortune, learning, and sovereignty,
does not stand long in battle, just as I, proud with intoxication, [could not].”

5.166.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamukto vasiṣṭhastu viśvāmitreṇa bhūbhujā ..
cakāra taṃ bhujaṃ tasya staṃbhadoṣavivarjitam .. 67 ..
5.166.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तो वसिष्ठस्तु विश्वामित्रेण भूभुजा ..
चकार तं भुजं तस्य स्तंभदोषविवर्जितम् .. 67 ..
5.166.m:
Sūta said:
Thus addressed by King Viśvāmitra, Vasiṣṭha
freed his arm from the affliction of paralysis.

5.166.s:
abravītprahasanvākyaṃ vidhāya sa śubhaṃ karam..
gaccha rājanvimukto'si staṃbhadoṣeṇa vai mayā .. 68 ..
5.166.d:
अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्वाक्यं विधाय स शुभं करम्..
गच्छ राजन्विमुक्तोऽसि स्तंभदोषेण वै मया .. 68 ..
5.166.m:
Having made his hand whole again, he said, smiling:
“Go, O king; you are released by me from the affliction of paralysis.

5.166.s:
mākārśīrbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ virodhaṃ bhūya eva hi ..
anujñātaḥ sa tenātha viśvāmitro mahīpatiḥ .. 69 ..
savrīḍaṃ prayayau harmyaṃ padbhyāmeva dvijottamāḥ..
svapuradvāramāsādya sugupte rajanīmukhe ..6.167.7...
5.166.d:
माकार्शीर्ब्राह्मणैः सार्धं विरोधं भूय एव हि ..
अनुज्ञातः स तेनाथ विश्वामित्रो महीपतिः .. 69 ..
सव्रीडं प्रययौ हर्म्यं पद्भ्यामेव द्विजोत्तमाः..
स्वपुरद्वारमासाद्य सुगुप्ते रजनीमुखे ..6.167.7...
5.166.m:
Never again enter into enmity with brāhmaṇas!”
Thus permitted by him, King Viśvāmitra,
ashamed, went on foot to his palace, O best of dvijas,
reaching the gate of his city in the deep secrecy of nightfall.

5.166.s:
pralāpamakarottatra bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ ...
dhigbalaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca dhigvīryaṃ dhikprajīvitam .. .. 71 ..
5.166.d:
प्रलापमकरोत्तत्र बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः ...
धिग्बलं क्षत्रियाणां च धिग्वीर्यं धिक्प्रजीवितम् .. .. 71 ..
5.166.m:
There he lamented, his eyes filled with tears:
“Cursed is the strength of kṣatriyas! Cursed is their valour! Cursed is their way of living!

5.166.s: ślāghyaṃ brahmabalaṃ caikaṃ brāhmyaṃ tejaśca kevalam ..72 ..
5.166.d: श्लाघ्यं ब्रह्मबलं चैकं ब्राह्म्यं तेजश्च केवलम् ..72 ..
5.166.m: Praiseworthy alone is the strength of a brāhmaṇa, and solely the power of a brāhmaṇa.

5.166.s:
etatkarma mayā kāryaṃ yathā syādbrahmajaṃ balam ..
tyaktvā caiva nijaṃ rājyaṃ cariṣyāmi mahattapaḥ.
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā rājye saṃsthāpya vai sutam..
nāmnā viśvasahaṃ khyātaṃ prajagāma tapovanam..74..
5.166.d:
एतत्कर्म मया कार्यं यथा स्याद्ब्रह्मजं बलम् ..
त्यक्त्वा चैव निजं राज्यं चरिष्यामि महत्तपः.
एवं स निश्चयं कृत्वा राज्ये संस्थाप्य वै सुतम्..
नाम्ना विश्वसहं ख्यातं प्रजगाम तपोवनम्..74..
5.166.m:
I must do this work so that strength born of a brāhmaṇa may be mine;
and giving up my own kingdom, I shall perform great austerity.”
Having made this resolution and established his son,
renowned by the name of Viśvasaha, upon the throne, he went to the penance grove.

5.166.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye viśvāmitrarājyaparityāgavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..167..
5.166.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विश्वामित्रराज्यपरित्यागवर्णनं नाम सप्तषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः..167..
5.166.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-seventh chapter, entitled “Description of Viśvāmitra’s Renunciation of the Kingdom,” in the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya of the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.167.s:
.. .. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ rājyaṃ parityajya viśvāmitro dvijottamāḥ ..
himavantaṃ nagaṃ prāpya tapaścakre sudāruṇam .. 1 ..
varṣāsvākāśaśāyī ca hemaṃte salilāśayaḥ ..
pañcāgnisādhako grīṣme sthito varṣaśatatrayam .. 2 ..
5.167.d:
.. .. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं राज्यं परित्यज्य विश्वामित्रो द्विजोत्तमाः ..
हिमवन्तं नगं प्राप्य तपश्चक्रे सुदारुणम् .. 1 ..
वर्षास्वाकाशशायी च हेमंते सलिलाशयः ..
पञ्चाग्निसाधको ग्रीष्मे स्थितो वर्षशतत्रयम् .. 2 ..
5.167.m:
Sūta said:
Having thus renounced his kingdom, O best of dvijas,
Viśvāmitra reached Mount Himavat and performed most dreadful austerity:
sleeping under the open sky during the rainy seasons, standing in water in winter,
and practicing the five fires in summer, he remained for three hundred years.

5.167.s:
phalamūlakṛtāhārastato varṣaśatatrayam ..
dhyāyamānaḥ paraṃ brahma sthito brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
śīrṇaparṇāśanaḥ paścāttāvatkālaṃ vyavasthitaḥ .. 3 ..
5.167.d:
फलमूलकृताहारस्ततो वर्षशतत्रयम् ..
ध्यायमानः परं ब्रह्म स्थितो ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..
शीर्णपर्णाशनः पश्चात्तावत्कालं व्यवस्थितः .. 3 ..

5.167.s:
tataścaiva jalāhārastāvanmātraṃ vyavasthitaḥ ..
kālaṃ sa vāyubhakṣaśca tataścaivāyutaṃ samāḥ.. sūta uvāca..
atha dṛṣṭvā tapaḥśaktiṃ tasya tāṃ tridaśādhipaḥ.
pātāyaṣyati māṃ nūnameṣa sthānānnṛpottamaḥ... .. 5 ..
5.167.d:
ततश्चैव जलाहारस्तावन्मात्रं व्यवस्थितः ..
कालं स वायुभक्षश्च ततश्चैवायुतं समाः.. सूत उवाच..
अथ दृष्ट्वा तपःशक्तिं तस्य तां त्रिदशाधिपः.
पातायष्यति मां नूनमेष स्थानान्नृपोत्तमः... .. 5 ..
5.167.m:
And then he remained for just as long subsisting on water alone;
and then for ten thousand years consuming only air.
Sūta said:
Then, seeing that power of his austerity, Indra thought:
“Surely this best of kings will cast me down from my station!”

5.167.s:
tataḥ provāca saṃgatya sāmnā paramavalgunā ..
viśvāmitraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ bhayena mahatā'nvitaḥ .. 6 ..
5.167.d:
ततः प्रोवाच संगत्य साम्ना परमवल्गुना ..
विश्वामित्रं नृपश्रेष्ठं भयेन महताऽन्वितः .. 6 ..
5.167.m:
Then, having approached, he addressed King Viśvāmitra
with exceedingly pleasant and soothing words, filled with great fear.

5.167.s:
.. iṃdra uvāca .. ..
viśvāmitra pratuṣṭo'smi tapasānena pārthiva ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yadabhīṣṭaṃ hṛdisthitam.. 7 ..
5.167.d:
.. इंद्र उवाच .. ..
विश्वामित्र प्रतुष्टोऽस्मि तपसानेन पार्थिव ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते यदभीष्टं हृदिस्थितम्.. 7 ..
5.167.m:
Indra said:
“O Viśvāmitra! I am well pleased with this austerity, O king.
Choose a boon—may it be well with you—whatever desired thing is in your heart.”

5.167.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
brāhmaṇyaṃ dehi me śakra yadi tuṣṭo'si sāṃpratam ..
tadarthaṃ tapasaścaryāṃ jānīhi tvaṃ puraṃdara ..9..
.. iṃdra uvāca .. ..
anenaiva śarīreṇa kṣatriyaḥ syātkathaṃ dvijaḥ ..
caturviṃśatisaṃskārairdviguṇairyaḥprajāyate ..
tadanyatprārthaya kṣipraṃ yatte'bhīṣṭataraṃ sthitam .. 9 ..
5.167.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
ब्राह्मण्यं देहि मे शक्र यदि तुष्टोऽसि सांप्रतम् ..
तदर्थं तपसश्चर्यां जानीहि त्वं पुरंदर ..9..
.. इंद्र उवाच .. ..
अनेनैव शरीरेण क्षत्रियः स्यात्कथं द्विजः ..
चतुर्विंशतिसंस्कारैर्द्विगुणैर्यःप्रजायते ..
तदन्यत्प्रार्थय क्षिप्रं यत्तेऽभीष्टतरं स्थितम् .. 9 ..
5.167.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
“Grant me the status of a brāhmaṇa, O Śakra, if you are now pleased [with me].
Know, O Puraṃdara, that it is for this purpose that I have performed this austerity.”
Indra said:
“How can a kṣatriya become a dvija in this very body,
[a status] which is born through twice twenty-four sacraments?
Therefore, request something else quickly, whatever remains most desired by you.”

5.167.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
na brāhmaṇyātparaṃ kiṃcitprārthayāmi sureśvara.. 6.168.10 ..
5.167.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
न ब्राह्मण्यात्परं किंचित्प्रार्थयामि सुरेश्वर.. 6.168.10 ..
5.167.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
“I ask for nothing higher than the status of a brāhmaṇa, O Lord of the gods!

5.167.s:
api trailokyarājyaṃ te vastuṣvanyeṣu kā kathā ..
tasmādgaccha suraśreṣṭha svarājyaṃ paripālaya .. 11 ..
5.167.d:
अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यं ते वस्तुष्वन्येषु का कथा ..
तस्माद्गच्छ सुरश्रेष्ठ स्वराज्यं परिपालय .. 11 ..
5.167.m:
Even the kingship of the three worlds [is nothing to me], what then to speak of other things?
Therefore go, O best of gods, and protect your own kingdom!

5.167.s:
parityakṣyāmyahaṃ dehaṃ yāsye vā'haṃ dvijanmatām ..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya devarājo divaṃ gataḥ .. 12 ..
5.167.d:
परित्यक्ष्याम्यहं देहं यास्ये वाऽहं द्विजन्मताम् ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य देवराजो दिवं गतः .. 12 ..
5.167.m:
I will cast off my body, or I will attain the state of twice-born.”
Having heard those words of his, the king of gods departed for heaven,

5.167.s:
tasya taṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā sarvadevasamāvṛtaḥ..
viśvāmitro'pi tadrūpaṃ cakāra duścaraṃ tapaḥ.. 13 ..
5.167.d:
तस्य तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा सर्वदेवसमावृतः..
विश्वामित्रोऽपि तद्रूपं चकार दुश्चरं तपः.. 13 ..
5.167.m:
surrounded by all the gods, knowing his firm resolve.
Viśvāmitra too performed severe austerity in that same manner.

5.167.s:
atha varṣasahasre tu vyatikrānte dvijottamāḥ ..
anyasminvāyubhakṣasya viśvāmitrasya bhūpateḥ .. 14 ..
5.167.d:
अथ वर्षसहस्रे तु व्यतिक्रान्ते द्विजोत्तमाः ..
अन्यस्मिन्वायुभक्षस्य विश्वामित्रस्य भूपतेः .. 14 ..
5.167.m:
Then, when a thousand years had passed, O best of dvijas,
for King Viśvāmitra who was consuming only air,

5.167.s:
ājagāma svayaṃ brahmā puṇyairdevarṣibhiḥ saha ..
abravīttaṃ mahīpālaṃ tapasā dagdhakilbiṣam .. 15 ..
5.167.d:
आजगाम स्वयं ब्रह्मा पुण्यैर्देवर्षिभिः सह ..
अब्रवीत्तं महीपालं तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषम् .. 15 ..
5.167.m:
Brahmā himself came, together with holy celestial seers,
and spoke to that ruler of the earth whose sins had been burned away by austerity.

5.167.s:
.. śrībrahmovāca .. ..
viśvāmitra pratuṣṭo'smi tapasānena sattama ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te pradāsyāmyapi durlabham .. 16 ..
5.167.d:
.. श्रीब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
विश्वामित्र प्रतुष्टोऽस्मि तपसानेन सत्तम ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते प्रदास्याम्यपि दुर्लभम् .. 16 ..
5.167.m:
Glorious Brahmā said:
“O Viśvāmitra, I am well pleased with this austerity, O best of men!
Choose a boon—may it be well with you—I shall grant it even if hard to attain.”

5.167.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama ..
brāhmaṇyaṃ dehi me deva nānyadiṣṭatamaṃ mahat .. 17 .. ..
5.167.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम ..
ब्राह्मण्यं देहि मे देव नान्यदिष्टतमं महत् .. 17 .. ..
5.167.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
“If you are pleased with me, O god, if a boon is to be given to me,
grant me the status of a brāhmaṇa, O god; nothing else is most dear [to me].”

5.167.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
kṣatriyeṇa prajātasya dvijatvaṃ jāyate katham ..
śrutismṛtiviruddhaṃ hi kimevaṃ vadasīpsitam .. 189 ..
yanna jātaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhe na bhaviṣyati karhicit .. 19 ..
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
gaccha tvaṃ devadeveśa brahmalokamanuttamam..
ahaṃ tyakṣyāmi vā prāṇānsaṃprāpsye vā dvijanmatām .. 6.168.20 ..
atha devarṣimadhyastha ṛcīko vākyamabravīt ..
asya janmakṛte deva brāhmyairmaṃtrairmayā caruḥ .. 21 ..
abhito brahmasarvasvaṃ tatra sayojitaṃ mayā .
tenaiva kṣatrajanmā'yaṃ brāhmaṇaścaturānana..22..
brahmarṣikīrtayasvainaṃ tasmāttvaṃ prapitāmaha..
rājyastho'pi dvijārhāṇi satkṛtyānya karodasau .. 23 ..
brāhmamantraprabhāvena tasmādbrahmarṣimāhvaya ..
yena kīrtāmahe sarve viśvāmitraṃ dvijottamam.. 24 .
5.167.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
क्षत्रियेण प्रजातस्य द्विजत्वं जायते कथम् ..
श्रुतिस्मृतिविरुद्धं हि किमेवं वदसीप्सितम् .. 189 ..
यन्न जातं धरापृष्ठे न भविष्यति कर्हिचित् .. 19 ..
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
गच्छ त्वं देवदेवेश ब्रह्मलोकमनुत्तमम्..
अहं त्यक्ष्यामि वा प्राणान्संप्राप्स्ये वा द्विजन्मताम् .. 6.168.20 ..
अथ देवर्षिमध्यस्थ ऋचीको वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
अस्य जन्मकृते देव ब्राह्म्यैर्मंत्रैर्मया चरुः .. 21 ..
अभितो ब्रह्मसर्वस्वं तत्र सयोजितं मया .
तेनैव क्षत्रजन्माऽयं ब्राह्मणश्चतुरानन..22..
ब्रह्मर्षिकीर्तयस्वैनं तस्मात्त्वं प्रपितामह..
राज्यस्थोऽपि द्विजार्हाणि सत्कृत्यान्य करोदसौ .. 23 ..
ब्राह्ममन्त्रप्रभावेन तस्माद्ब्रह्मर्षिमाह्वय ..
येन कीर्तामहे सर्वे विश्वामित्रं द्विजोत्तमम्.. 24 .
5.167.m:
Brahmā said:
“How can the status of a twice-born belong to one born of a kṣatriya?
Indeed, it is contrary to Śruti and Smṛti; why do you speak of such a desire,
which has never happened on the face of the earth, nor will ever happen?”
Viśvāmitra said:
“Go to your peerless Brahmaloka, O Lord of the gods of gods!
I shall either surrender my life, or attain the status of a twice-born.”
Then Ṛcīka, standing among the celestial seers, spoke these words:
“For his birth, O god, a sacrificial pot of caru was [prepared] by me with Vedic mantras.
The entire essence of a brāhmaṇa was infused therein by me entirely;
therefore, though born a kṣatriya, he is indeed a brāhmaṇa, O Four-faced One.
Therefore, O Great-grandfather, proclaim him a brahmarṣi!
Even while on the throne, he performed deeds worthy of a twice-born.
Therefore, by the power of the Vedic mantras, address him as a brahmarṣi,
whereby all of us may proclaim Viśvāmitra the best of dvijas!”

5.167.s:
atha brahmā ciraṃ dhyātvā brāhmyai rmaṃtraiśca tejasā ..
samutpannaṃ tataḥ prāha brāhmaṇastvaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ .. 25 ..
tyajedaṃ duṣkaraṃ ghoraṃ tapo madvacanāddrutam ..
sa yadā brahmaṇā prokto brahmarṣi stvamasaṃśayam.. 26 ..

so'bravītkopasaṃyukto nāhaṃ vakṣyāmi karhicit.. 28 ..
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyājjātaṃ jānannapi pitāmaha ..
ṛcīkasya ca dākṣiṇyāttathā tvaṃ vadasi prabho .. 29 ..
procyamāno 'pi bahudhā vasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ ..
pitāmahena munibhirnāradādyairanekadhā ..
jagāmātha parityajya tānsarvāndvijasattamān .. 6.168.30 ..
sa cāgatya muni śreṣṭho deśaṃ cānartasaṃjñitam ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre śaṃkhatīrthasamīpataḥ .. 31 ..
5.167.d:
अथ ब्रह्मा चिरं ध्यात्वा ब्राह्म्यै र्मंत्रैश्च तेजसा ..
समुत्पन्नं ततः प्राह ब्राह्मणस्त्वं मया कृतः .. 25 ..
त्यजेदं दुष्करं घोरं तपो मद्वचनाद्द्रुतम् ..
स यदा ब्रह्मणा प्रोक्तो ब्रह्मर्षि स्त्वमसंशयम्.. 26 ..
ऋचीकाद्यैस्ततः सर्वैः प्रोक्तो देवर्षिभिस्तथा .. 27 ..
अथ तेषां मध्यगतो वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः ..
सोऽब्रवीत्कोपसंयुक्तो नाहं वक्ष्यामि कर्हिचित्.. 28 ..
ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियाज्जातं जानन्नपि पितामह ..
ऋचीकस्य च दाक्षिण्यात्तथा त्वं वदसि प्रभो .. 29 ..
प्रोच्यमानो ऽपि बहुधा वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः ..
पितामहेन मुनिभिर्नारदाद्यैरनेकधा ..
जगामाथ परित्यज्य तान्सर्वान्द्विजसत्तमान् .. 6.168.30 ..

5.167.m:
Then Brahmā, having meditated for a long time, said to him who had arisen through mantras sacred to Brahmā and through brilliance: "You have been made a brahmin by me. / 25
Abandon quickly at my word this terrible austerity that is hard to perform." / When he was addressed by Brahmā: "You are a brahmarṣi without doubt," / 26
and then spoken to likewise by all the celestial seers, beginning with Ṛcīka, / 27
then Vasiṣṭha, best among sages, standing in their midst, / filled with anger, spoke: "I shall never say it! / 28
Knowing that he was born of a kṣatriya, yet [calling him] a brahmin, O Grandfather, / you speak thus, O Lord, out of courtesy to Ṛcīka." / 29
Though spoken to in various ways by the Grandfather / and in many ways by the sages, beginning with Nārada, Vasiṣṭha, best among sages, / then departed, abandoning all those best of twice-born. / 30
And that best of sages, having come to the country named Ānarta, / in the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara, near the Śaṅkhatīrtha, / 31

5.167.s:

कृत्वाश्रमपदं तत्र तस्य च्छिद्राणि चिन्तयन् .. 34 ..
संस्थितः सुचिरं कालं न च पश्यति किंचन ..
अथाभिचारिकं तेन प्रारब्धं तस्य चोपरि..35..

तस्य तैर्दारुणैर्मंत्रैर्जुह्वतो जातवेदसम्..36..

5.167.m:
where the sacred Brahmaśilā is, joined with Śvetadvīpa, / where the auspicious river Sarasvatī, which removes sin, flows— / 32
having established a hermitage there, he performed great austerity. / Viśvāmitra too, filled with indignation, arrived to kill him. / 33
Stationed far from his hermitage in the southern direction, / having made a hermitage there, he kept looking for his weaknesses. / 34
He remained for a very long time, but did not see any. / Then a destructive rite was begun by him against him, / 35
which is described in the Sāmaveda according to the rule of the Sāman, aimed at slaying. / As he was offering oblations into the fire with those terrible mantras, / 36
a dread female power emerged, terrifying, with disheveled hair, / mounted on the shoulder of a monkey, making a shrieking sound, / 37
equipped with various weapons, like another tongue of Yama. / She said: "Speak, O prince of brahmins, what act shall I perform for you? / 38
At your command, I will destroy even all the three worlds." / 39

durnimittāni jātāni prabhūtāni mahāṃti ca..42..

tathā rudhiravṛṣṭiśca asthimiśrā vyajāyata..43..
dīptāṃ diśaṃ samāsādya ruroda ca tathā śivā.
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sumahotpātānvasiṣṭho munipuṃgavaḥ..44..

tataḥ samyakparijñāya sarvaṃ divyena cakṣuṣā..45..

5.167.d:
विश्वामित्र उवाच..
मम शत्रुर्मान्यो त्र वसिष्ठः कुमुनिः स्थितः.
तं त्वं जहि द्रुतं गत्वा तदर्थं च मया कृता..6.168.40..
एवमुक्ता तु सा तेन विश्वामित्रेण धीमता.
वसिष्ठाश्रममुद्दिश्य प्रस्थिता चोत्तरामुखी..41..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वसिष्ठस्याश्रमे द्विजाः.
दुर्निमित्तानि जातानि प्रभूतानि महांति च..42..
पपात महती चोल्का निहत्य रविमण्डलम्..
तथा रुधिरवृष्टिश्च अस्थिमिश्रा व्यजायत..43..
दीप्तां दिशं समासाद्य रुरोद च तथा शिवा.
तां दृष्ट्वा सुमहोत्पातान्वसिष्ठो मुनिपुंगवः..44..
यावदालोकते रूपं ज्वालामालासमाकुलम्..
ततः सम्यक्परिज्ञाय सर्वं दिव्येन चक्षुषा..45..
विश्वामित्रप्रयुक्तेयं शक्तिर्मम वधाय च..
कृत्या रूपा सुमंत्रैश्च सामवेदसमुद्भवैः..46..
तिष्ठतिष्ठेति तेनोक्ता ततः सा निश्चलाभवत्..
निजमंत्रैश्च सा तेन स्तंभिताथर्वणोद्भवैः..47..
5.167.m:
Viśvāmitra said: / "My enemy, the wicked sage Vasiṣṭha, who thinks himself venerable, is stationed here. / Slay him quickly, having gone [there]; you were created by me for that purpose." / 40
Thus addressed by that wise Viśvāmitra, / she set out toward Vasiṣṭha's hermitage, facing north. / 41
At that very time, O twice-born, in Vasiṣṭha's hermitage, / abundant and great ill omens arose. / 42
A great meteor fell, striking the disc of the sun; / likewise, a shower of blood mixed with bones occurred. / 43
A jackal, having turned toward the blazing quarter, wailed. / Having seen those very great portents, Vasiṣṭha, the bull among sages, / 44
just as he beheld a form surrounded by garlands of flames, / then, knowing everything accurately by his divine vision, [realized]: / 45
"This is a female power dispatched by Viśvāmitra to kill me, / having the form of a kṛtyā [produced] by powerful mantras arising from the Sāmaveda." / 46
Told by him, "Halt, halt!", she then became motionless; / and she was paralyzed by him with his own mantras originating from the Atharvaveda. / 47

5.167.s:
tataḥ strīrūpamādāya provāca munipuṃgavam..
sāmavedastu vedānāṃ prādhānyena vyavasthitaḥ..48..

mā kurutvapramāṇaṃtu prahāraṃ saha me mune ..
rakṣayiṣyāmi te
prāṇānsvalpasparśena te mune .. 49 ..
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ kuru me sparśaṃ na marma sparśanaṃ śubhe ..
mayā cātharvaṇā maṃtrāḥ saṃhṛtāḥ kṛpayā tava .. 6.168.50 ..
tataḥ sā dāruṇā śaktirviśvāmitraprayojitā ..
tasyāṃgadeśaṃ spṛṣṭvātha nipapāta dharātale .. 51 ..
tatastuṣṭo vasiṣṭhastu tāmāha madhuraṃ vacaḥ ..
adyaprabhṛti te pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti samāhitāḥ ..
janāḥ sarve mahābhāge bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ .. 52 ..
caitramāse site pakṣe aṣṭamīdivase sthite ..
ye te pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ .. 53 ..

ततः स्त्रीरूपमादाय प्रोवाच मुनिपुंगवम्..
सामवेदस्तु वेदानां प्राधान्येन व्यवस्थितः..48..
विधिना तेन संसृष्टा विश्वामित्रेण धीमता..
मा कुरुत्वप्रमाणंतु प्रहारं सह मे मुने ..
रक्षयिष्यामि ते
प्राणान्स्वल्पस्पर्शेन ते मुने .. 49 ..
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
यद्येवं कुरु मे स्पर्शं न मर्म स्पर्शनं शुभे ..
मया चाथर्वणा मंत्राः संहृताः कृपया तव .. 6.168.50 ..
ततः सा दारुणा शक्तिर्विश्वामित्रप्रयोजिता ..
तस्यांगदेशं स्पृष्ट्वाथ निपपात धरातले .. 51 ..
ततस्तुष्टो वसिष्ठस्तु तामाह मधुरं वचः ..
अद्यप्रभृति ते पूजां करिष्यंति समाहिताः ..
जनाः सर्वे महाभागे भक्त्या परमया युताः .. 52 ..
चैत्रमासे सिते पक्षे अष्टमीदिवसे स्थिते ..
ये ते पूजां करिष्यंति श्रद्धया परया युताः .. 53 ..
5.167.m:
Then, assuming the form of a woman, she spoke to the bull among sages: / "The Sāmaveda stands as foremost among the Vedas; / I was created according to its rite by the wise Viśvāmitra. / Do not make [it] of no authority; endure my strike, O sage! / I will spare your life with a light touch, O sage." / 48–49
Vasiṣṭha said: / "If it is so, touch me, but do not touch my vital spots, O auspicious one! / And the Atharvan mantras have been withdrawn by me out of pity for you." / 50
Then that dreadful female power dispatched by Viśvāmitra, / having touched a part of his body, fell onto the ground. / 51
Then Vasiṣṭha, pleased, spoke sweet words to her: / "From this day forward, all people, composed / and endowed with supreme devotion, shall perform worship for you, O fortunate one! / 52
In the month of Caitra, during the bright fortnight, on the eighth day, / those who perform your worship endowed with supreme faith, / 53

5.167.s:
te sarve vatsaraṃyāvadbhavi ṣyaṃti nirāmayāḥ ..
tasmādatraiva sthātavyaṃ sadaiva mama vākyataḥ .. 54 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktā ca sā tena vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā ..
sthitā tatraiva sā devī tasya vākyena tatkṣaṇāt .. 55 ..

dhārānāmeti vikhyātā bhaktalokasukha pradā .. 56 ..

5.167.d:
ते सर्वे वत्सरंयावद्भवि ष्यंति निरामयाः ..
तस्मादत्रैव स्थातव्यं सदैव मम वाक्यतः .. 54 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ता च सा तेन वसिष्ठेन महात्मना ..
स्थिता तत्रैव सा देवी तस्य वाक्येन तत्क्षणात् .. 55 ..
प्राप्नोति परमां पूजां विशेषान्नागरैः कृताम् ..
धारानामेति विख्याता भक्तलोकसुख प्रदा .. 56 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये धारोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्ट षष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 168 ..
5.167.m:
all of them shall remain free from disease for a year. / Therefore, you must remain right here forever, according to my word." / 54
Sūta said: / Thus addressed by that high-souled Vasiṣṭha, / that goddess remained right there at that very moment, according to his word. / 55
She receives supreme worship, performed particularly by the Nāgaras; / renowned by the name Dhārā, she bestows happiness upon devotees. / 56
Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-eighth chapter, named the Description of the Origin and Greatness of Dhārā, in the Greatness of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa. / 168

5.168.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kasmātsā tuṣṭidā proktā nāgarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
dhārānāmeti vikhyātā kasmātsā dharaṇītale .. 1 ..

.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..

धारानामेति विख्याता कस्मात्सा धरणीतले .. 1 ..
5.168.m: The seers said: / Why is she said to give satisfaction especially to the Nāgaras? / Why is she renowned on the surface of the earth by the name Dhārā? / 1

5.168.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
camatkārapure pūrvaṃ dhārānāmeti viśrutā ..
āsīttapasvinī sādhvī nāgarī brāhmaṇottamā ..

.. सूत उवाच .. ..
चमत्कारपुरे पूर्वं धारानामेति विश्रुता ..
आसीत्तपस्विनी साध्वी नागरी ब्राह्मणोत्तमा ..
तस्याः सख्यमरुन्धत्या आसीत्पूर्वं सुमेधया .. 2 ..
5.168.m: Sūta said: / Formerly, in Camatkārapura, there was a virtuous ascetic woman / renowned by the name Dhārā, an excellent Nāgara brahmin lady; / previously, she had a friendship with the very wise Arundhatī. / 2

5.168.s:
arundhatī yadā prāptā camatkārapure śubhe ..
snānārthaṃ śaṃkhatīrthaṃ tu vasiṣṭhena samāgatā .. 3 ..

स्नानार्थं शंखतीर्थं तु वसिष्ठेन समागता .. 3 ..
5.168.m: When Arundhatī arrived in auspicious Camatkārapura / for the purpose of a ritual ablution at the Śaṅkhatīrtha, having come with Vasiṣṭha, / 3

5.168.s:
tayā dṛṣṭātha sā tatra aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa saṃsthitā ..
vāyubhakṣā nirāhārā divyena vapuṣānvitā .. 4 ..

वायुभक्षा निराहारा दिव्येन वपुषान्विता .. 4 ..

tayā pṛṣṭā ca sā sādhvī kā tvaṃ kasya sutā śubhe ..

किमर्थं तु स्थिता चोग्रे तपसि ब्रूहि मे शुभे .. 5 ..
5.168.m: And that virtuous woman was questioned by her: "Who are you? Whose daughter are you, O auspicious one? / For what purpose do you stand in severe austerity? Tell me, O auspicious one!" / 5

5.168.s:
.. dhārovāca .. ..
devaśarmākhyaviprasya sutāhaṃ nāgarasya ca ..
bālatve vartamānāyā vaidhavyaṃ me vyavasthitam .. 6 ..

बालत्वे वर्तमानाया वैधव्यं मे व्यवस्थितम् .. 6 ..
5.168.m: Dhārā said: / "I am the daughter of the Nāgara brahmin named Devaśarman. / While I was in my childhood, widowhood befell me. / 6

5.168.s:
śaṃkhatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śrutvā śaṃkheśvarasya ca ..
tato'haṃ saṃsthitā hyatra tasyaivārādhane sthitā .. 7 .. ..

ततोऽहं संस्थिता ह्यत्र तस्यैवाराधने स्थिता .. 7 .. ..
5.168.m: Having heard the greatness of Śaṅkhatīrtha and of Śaṅkheśvara, / I have stayed right here, devoted to his worship alone." / 7

5.168.s:
.. arundhatyuvāca .. ..
tavopari mahānsneho darśanātte vyavasthitaḥ ..
tasmādāgaccha gacchāvo mamāśramapadaṃ śubham .. 8 ..

.. अरुन्धत्युवाच .. ..
तवोपरि महान्स्नेहो दर्शनात्ते व्यवस्थितः ..
तस्मादागच्छ गच्छावो ममाश्रमपदं शुभम् .. 8 ..
5.168.m: Arundhatī said: / "A great affection toward you has arisen in me from seeing you. / Therefore, come; let us both go to my auspicious hermitage. / 8

5.168.s:
sarasvatyā staṭe śubhre sarvapātakanāśane ..

शास्त्रगोष्ठीरता नित्यं तत्र तिष्ठ मया सह .. 9 ..
5.168.m: On the pure bank of the Sarasvatī, which destroys all sins, / constantly delighting in discourses on the sacred scriptures, stay there with me." / 9

5.168.s:
tataḥ saṃprasthitā sā tu tayā sārdhaṃ tapasvinī ..
anujñātā svapitrā tu jananyā bāṃdhavaistathā .. 6.169.10 ..
5.168.d:
ततः संप्रस्थिता सा तु तया सार्धं तपस्विनी ..
अनुज्ञाता स्वपित्रा तु जनन्या बांधवैस्तथा .. 6.169.10 ..
5.168.m: Then that ascetic woman departed along with her, / having been permitted by her father, her mother, and her relatives.

5.168.s:
tasyāḥ sakhyaṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ tayā saha babhūva ha ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya sā śaktistatra cāgatā .. .. 11 ..
5.168.d:
तस्याः सख्यं चिरं कालं तया सह बभूव ह ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य सा शक्तिस्तत्र चागता .. .. 11 ..
5.168.m: Her friendship with her lasted for a long time. / Then, after some time, that spear arrived there,

5.168.s:
viśvāmitreṇa saṃsṛṣṭā vasiṣṭhasya vadhāya ca ..
sā staṃbhitā vasiṣṭhena kṛtā devīsvarūpiṇī ..
saṃpūjyā devamartyānāṃ sarvarakṣāpradā śubhā .. 12 ..
5.168.d:
विश्वामित्रेण संसृष्टा वसिष्ठस्य वधाय च ..
सा स्तंभिता वसिष्ठेन कृता देवीस्वरूपिणी ..
संपूज्या देवमर्त्यानां सर्वरक्षाप्रदा शुभा .. 12 ..
5.168.m: created by Viśvāmitra for the slaying of Vasiṣṭha. / Paralyzed by Vasiṣṭha, she was turned into a goddess, / worthy of worship by gods and mortals, giving protection to all, auspicious.

5.168.s:
tatastu dhārayā tasyāḥ kailāsaśikharopamaḥ ..
prāsādo nirmito viprā nānāratnavicitritaḥ .. 13 ..
5.168.d:
ततस्तु धारया तस्याः कैलासशिखरोपमः ..
प्रासादो निर्मितो विप्रा नानारत्नविचित्रितः .. 13 ..
5.168.m: Then, O brahmins, a temple resembling the peak of Kailāsa, / adorned with various jewels, was built for her by Dhārā.

5.168.s: cakārātha tataḥ stotraṃ tasyāḥ sā ca tapasvinī .. 14 ..
5.168.d: चकाराथ ततः स्तोत्रं तस्याः सा च तपस्विनी .. 14 ..
5.168.m: Then that female ascetic offered praise to her:

5.168.s:
namaste parame brāhmi dhārayoge namonamaḥ ..
ardhamātre pare śūnye tasyārdhārdhe namostu te ..- .. 15 ..
5.168.d:
नमस्ते परमे ब्राह्मि धारयोगे नमोनमः ..
अर्धमात्रे परे शून्ये तस्यार्धार्धे नमोस्तु ते ..- .. 15 ..
5.168.m: "Salutations to you, supreme Brāhmī! Salutations, salutations to Dhārayogā! / Salutations to you, the half-mātrā, the supreme void, and half of its half!

5.168.s:
namaste jagadādhāre namaste bhūtadhāriṇi ..
namaste padmapatrākṣi namaste kāṃcanadyute .. 16 ..
5.168.d:
नमस्ते जगदाधारे नमस्ते भूतधारिणि ..
नमस्ते पद्मपत्राक्षि नमस्ते कांचनद्युते .. 16 ..
5.168.m: Salutations to you, support of the universe! Salutations to you, bearer of beings! / Salutations to you, whose eyes are like lotus petals! Salutations to you, possessing the luster of gold!

5.168.s:
namaste siṃhayānāḍhye namaste'stumahābhuje ..
namaste devatābhīṣṭe namaste daityasūdini .. 17 ..
5.168.d:
नमस्ते सिंहयानाढ्ये नमस्तेऽस्तुमहाभुजे ..
नमस्ते देवताभीष्टे नमस्ते दैत्यसूदिनि .. 17 ..
5.168.m: Salutations to you, splendid on a lion mount! Salutations to you, great-armed goddess! / Salutations to you, cherished by the deities! Salutations to you, slayer of Daityas!

5.168.s:
namaste mahiṣākrāṃtaśarīracchinnamastake ..
namaste viṃdhyanirate surāmāṃsabalipriye .. 18 ..
5.168.d:
नमस्ते महिषाक्रांतशरीरच्छिन्नमस्तके ..
नमस्ते विंध्यनिरते सुरामांसबलिप्रिये .. 18 ..
5.168.m: Salutations to you, who severed the head from Mahiṣa's overpowered body! / Salutations to you, fond of the Vindhya mountains, delighting in offerings of wine and meat!

5.168.s:
tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ śacī gaurī tvaṃ siddhistvaṃ vibhāvarī ..
tvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhā tuṣṭistvaṃ puṣṭistvaṃ sureśvarī .. 19 ..
5.168.d:
त्वं लक्ष्मीस्त्वं शची गौरी त्वं सिद्धिस्त्वं विभावरी ..
त्वं स्वाहा त्वं स्वधा तुष्टिस्त्वं पुष्टिस्त्वं सुरेश्वरी .. 19 ..
5.168.m: You are Lakṣmī, you are Śacī, Gaurī; you are Siddhi, you are Vibhāvarī; / you are Svāhā, you are Svadhā, contentment; you are nourishment, you are the sovereign goddess.

5.168.s:
śaktirūpāsi devi tvaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakā riṇī ..
tvayi dṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 6.169.20 ..
5.168.d:
शक्तिरूपासि देवि त्वं सृष्टिसंहारका रिणी ..
त्वयि दृष्टमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 6.169.20 ..
5.168.m: You are of the nature of Śakti, O goddess, the cause of creation and dissolution. / All this threefold world, with the moving and the unmoving, is seen in you.

5.168.s:
yathā tilesthitaṃ tailaṃ dadhisaṃsthaṃ yathā ghṛtam ..
havirbhujaśca kāṣṭhasthaḥ suguptaṃ labhyate na hi .. 21 ..
5.168.d:
यथा तिलेस्थितं तैलं दधिसंस्थं यथा घृतम् ..
हविर्भुजश्च काष्ठस्थः सुगुप्तं लभ्यते न हि .. 21 ..
5.168.m: Just as oil resides in sesame seeds, just as ghee resides in curds, / and the fire-eater in wood, well hidden and not easily found,

5.168.s: tathā tvamapi deveśi sarvagāpi na lakṣyase .. 22 ..
5.168.d: तथा त्वमपि देवेशि सर्वगापि न लक्ष्यसे .. 22 ..
5.168.m: so also you, O sovereign of deities, although omnipresent, are not perceived."

5.168.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etena stotramukhyena smṛtā sā parameśvarī ..
bahūni varṣa pūgāni pūjayaṃtyā dinedine .. 23 ..
5.168.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतेन स्तोत्रमुख्येन स्मृता सा परमेश्वरी ..
बहूनि वर्ष पूगानि पूजयंत्या दिनेदिने .. 23 ..
5.168.m: Sūta said: / Remembered by this supreme hymn of praise, that supreme goddess / was worshipped day after day for many collections of years.

5.168.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya caitraśuklāṣṭamī sitā ..
tasminnahani devī sā nadyāṃ saṃsnāpya pūjitā .. 24 ..
5.168.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य चैत्रशुक्लाष्टमी सिता ..
तस्मिन्नहनि देवी सा नद्यां संस्नाप्य पूजिता .. 24 ..
5.168.m: Then, after some time, on the bright eighth lunar day of Caitra, / on that day that goddess, having been bathed in the river, was worshipped.

5.168.s:
bali pūjāṃ tato dattvā stotreṇānena ca stutā ..
tataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gatvā tāmuvāca tapasvinīm ..25..
5.168.d:
बलि पूजां ततो दत्त्वा स्तोत्रेणानेन च स्तुता ..
ततः प्रत्यक्षतां गत्वा तामुवाच तपस्विनीम् ..25..
5.168.m: Then, having given the bali offering and worship, she was praised with this hymn. / Thereupon, manifesting visibly, she spoke to that ascetic woman:

5.168.s:
putri tuṣṭāsmi bhadraṃ te stotreṇānena cānaghe ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te tava dāsyāmi vāṃchitam .. 26 ..
5.168.d:
पुत्रि तुष्टास्मि भद्रं ते स्तोत्रेणानेन चानघे ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते तव दास्यामि वांछितम् .. 26 ..
5.168.m: "Daughter, I am pleased with this hymn of praise, O sinless one; blessings to you! / Choose a boon, blessings to you! I shall grant what you desire."

5.168.s:
.. dhārovāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭāsi me devi yadi deyo varo mama ..
tanme nāma tavāpyastu prāsāde'tra hi kevalam.. 27 ..
5.168.d:
.. धारोवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टासि मे देवि यदि देयो वरो मम ..
तन्मे नाम तवाप्यस्तु प्रासादेऽत्र हि केवलम्.. 27 ..
5.168.m: Dhārā said: / "If you are pleased with me, O goddess, if a boon is to be granted to me, / then let this temple bear solely my name as well as yours.

5.168.s:
aparaṃ nāgaro yo'tra tvasminnahani saṃsthite ..
pradakṣiṇātrayaṃ kṛtvā tava dattvā phalatrayam .. 28 ..
5.168.d:
अपरं नागरो योऽत्र त्वस्मिन्नहनि संस्थिते ..
प्रदक्षिणात्रयं कृत्वा तव दत्त्वा फलत्रयम् .. 28 ..
5.168.m: Furthermore, whatever Nāgara here, on this day arriving, / makes three circumambulations and offers three fruits to you,

5.168.s:
stotreṇānena bhavatīṃ stutvā ca kurute natim..
tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadrogo rakṣyastvayā'khilaḥ ..29..
yā ca vaṃdhyā bhavennārī sā bhūyātputrasaṃyutā ..
durbhagā ca sasaubhāgyā kurūpā rūpasaṃbhavā ..
rogiṇī roganirmuktā sarvasaukhyasamanvitā .. 6.169.30 ..
5.168.d:
स्तोत्रेणानेन भवतीं स्तुत्वा च कुरुते नतिम्..
तस्य संवत्सरं यावद्रोगो रक्ष्यस्त्वयाऽखिलः ..29..
या च वंध्या भवेन्नारी सा भूयात्पुत्रसंयुता ..
दुर्भगा च ससौभाग्या कुरूपा रूपसंभवा ..
रोगिणी रोगनिर्मुक्ता सर्वसौख्यसमन्विता .. 6.169.30 ..
5.168.m: and praising you with this hymn makes a bow, / from all disease he must be protected by you for a full year. / And whatever woman may be barren, she must become endowed with sons; / an unfortunate woman must obtain good fortune; an ugly woman must obtain beauty; / a sick woman must be freed from sickness and endowed with all happiness."

5.168.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
ahaṃ dhāreti vikhyātā prāsāde'tra tvayā kṛte..
bhaviṣyāmi na sandehastava kīrtikṛte sadā .. 31 ..
5.168.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
अहं धारेति विख्याता प्रासादेऽत्र त्वया कृते..
भविष्यामि न सन्देहस्तव कीर्तिकृते सदा .. 31 ..
5.168.m: The goddess said: / "Known as Dhārā in this temple built by you / I shall be, without doubt, for the sake of your fame forever.

5.168.s:
atra yo nāgaro bhaktyā samāgatya tapasvini ..
pradakṣiṇātrayaṃ kuryāddattvā mama phalatrayam .. 32 ..
5.168.d:
अत्र यो नागरो भक्त्या समागत्य तपस्विनि ..
प्रदक्षिणात्रयं कुर्याद्दत्त्वा मम फलत्रयम् .. 32 ..
5.168.m: Whatever Nāgara here, having come with devotion, O ascetic woman, / makes three circumambulations after offering me three fruits,

5.168.s:
so'pi saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadbhavitā rogavarjitaḥ ..
evamuktā tu sā devītataścādarśanaṃ gatā .. 33 ..
5.168.d:
सोऽपि संवत्सरं यावद्भविता रोगवर्जितः ..
एवमुक्ता तु सा देवीततश्चादर्शनं गता .. 33 ..
5.168.m: he too shall be free from disease for a full year." / Having spoken thus, that goddess then vanished from sight.

5.168.s:
dhārāpi saṃsthitā tatra arundhatyā samanvitā ..
adyāpi dṛśyate vyomni tasyāścāpi samīpagā .. 34 ..
5.168.d:
धारापि संस्थिता तत्र अरुन्धत्या समन्विता ..
अद्यापि दृश्यते व्योम्नि तस्याश्चापि समीपगा .. 34 ..
5.168.m: Dhārā also remained there together with Arundhatī; / even today she is seen in the sky, positioned near her.

5.168.s:
etaddhārodbhavaṃ yo'tra vṛttāṃtaṃ kīrtayiṣyati ..
śṛṇuyādvā dvijaśreṣṭhā mucyetpāpāddinodbhavāt .. 35 ..
5.168.d:
एतद्धारोद्भवं योऽत्र वृत्तांतं कीर्तयिष्यति ..
शृणुयाद्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठा मुच्येत्पापाद्दिनोद्भवात् .. 35 ..
5.168.m: Whoever recounts this story of the origin of Dhārā / or listens to it, O best of brahmins, is freed from the sin born of the day.

5.168.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena paṭhanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
śrotavyaṃ ca prabhaktyedaṃ nāgaraiśca viśeṣataḥ .. 36 ..
5.168.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पठनीयं विशेषतः ..
श्रोतव्यं च प्रभक्त्येदं नागरैश्च विशेषतः .. 36 ..
5.168.m: Therefore, it should be recited especially with every effort, / and it should be heard with devotion, especially by the Nāgaras.

5.168.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dhārānāmotpattivṛttāṃta dhārādevīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..169..
5.168.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये धारानामोत्पत्तिवृत्तांत धारादेवीमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..169..
5.168.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-ninth chapter, named "Account of the Origin of the Name of Dhārā and the Description of the Māhātmya of Goddess Dhārā," in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa in eighty-one thousand verses.

5.169.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyadapi saṃjātamāścaryaṃ yadabhūddvijāḥ ..
viśvāmitreṇa sā śaktirvasiṣṭhāya visarjitā .. 1 ..
5.169.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्यदपि संजातमाश्चर्यं यदभूद्द्विजाः ..
विश्वामित्रेण सा शक्तिर्वसिष्ठाय विसर्जिता .. 1 ..
5.169.m: Sūta said: / O brahmins, another wonder also occurred: / that spear was dispatched by Viśvāmitra against Vasiṣṭha

5.169.s:
vadhārthaṃ tasya viprarṣervasiṣṭhena ca dhīmatā ..
staṃbhitā'tharvaṇairmantraiḥ prasvedaḥ samajāyata..2..
5.169.d:
वधार्थं तस्य विप्रर्षेर्वसिष्ठेन च धीमता ..
स्तंभिताऽथर्वणैर्मन्त्रैः प्रस्वेदः समजायत..2..
5.169.m: for the slaying of that brahmin-seer; and by the wise Vasiṣṭha / it was immobilized with Atharvan mantras, and perspiration arose [from it].

5.169.s:
svedātsamabhavattoyaṃ śītalaṃ tadajāyata..
pādābhyāṃ nirgataṃ toyamatra dṛśyamajāyata ..3..
5.169.d:
स्वेदात्समभवत्तोयं शीतलं तदजायत..
पादाभ्यां निर्गतं तोयमत्र दृश्यमजायत ..3..
5.169.m: From the perspiration water arose, and it became cool. / Water issuing from her two feet became visible here.

5.169.s:
vidārya bhūmiṃ saṃjātā jaladhārā suśītalā ..
nirmalaṃ pāvanaṃ svacchaṃ gaṃgāṃbha iva niḥsṛtam .. 4 .. gaṃ
5.169.d:
विदार्य भूमिं संजाता जलधारा सुशीतला ..
निर्मलं पावनं स्वच्छं गंगांभ इव निःसृतम् .. 4 .. गं
5.169.m: Tearing through the earth, a very cool stream of water arose; / pure, sanctifying, clear, it issued forth like the water of the Gaṅgā.

5.169.s:
gā pratyakṣatāṃ yātā tīrthaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitā..
pūritaṃ vāriṇā kuṇḍaṃ nirmalaṃ śītalaṃ śivam .. 5 ..
5.169.d:
गा प्रत्यक्षतां याता तीर्थैः सर्वैः समन्विता..
पूरितं वारिणा कुण्डं निर्मलं शीतलं शिवम् .. 5 ..
5.169.m: Gaṅgā became manifest, accompanied by all the sacred fords; / the pool was filled with clear, cool, auspicious water.

5.169.s:
tasyāṃ yā kurute snānaṃ nārī vaṃdhyā dvijottamāḥ ..
sadyaḥ putravatī sā syādraudre kaliyuge dvijāḥ .. 6 ..
5.169.d:
तस्यां या कुरुते स्नानं नारी वंध्या द्विजोत्तमाः ..
सद्यः पुत्रवती सा स्याद्रौद्रे कलियुगे द्विजाः .. 6 ..
5.169.m: A barren woman who performs a ritual ablution in it, O best of brahmins, / quickly becomes endowed with a son, O brahmins, in the dreadful Kali age.
Another person who performs a ritual ablution obtains the fruit of all sacred fords.

5.169.s:
snātvā tatra tu yo devīṃ paśyecca vidhinā naraḥ ..
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā putrānrājyotthaṃ ca sukhaṃ labhet .. ..8..
5.169.d:
स्नात्वा तत्र तु यो देवीं पश्येच्च विधिना नरः ..
धनं धान्यं तथा पुत्रान्राज्योत्थं च सुखं लभेत् .. ..8..
5.169.m: Having bathed there, whatever man sees the goddess according to rule / obtains wealth, grain, sons, and the happiness born of kingship.

5.169.s:
yā nārī durbhagā vandhyā sā'pi putravatī bhavet ..
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ bhaktiyogasamanvitā ..
mahāniśāyāṃ tatraiva naivedyabalipiṃḍikām..9..
5.169.d:
या नारी दुर्भगा वन्ध्या साऽपि पुत्रवती भवेत् ..
चैत्रे मासि सिताष्टम्यां भक्तियोगसमन्विता ..
महानिशायां तत्रैव नैवेद्यबलिपिंडिकाम्..9..
5.169.m: A woman who is unfortunate or barren also becomes endowed with sons. / In the month of Caitra, on the bright eighth lunar day, endowed with the yoga of devotion, / at midnight right there, whatever woman

5.169.s:
prasannayā kumāryā tu svayaṃ cā'tha karoti yā ..
gṛhṇāti yā ca vai nārī piṃḍikāṃ balisaṃyutām .. 6.170.10 ..
5.169.d:
प्रसन्नया कुमार्या तु स्वयं चाऽथ करोति या ..
गृह्णाति या च वै नारी पिंडिकां बलिसंयुताम् .. 6.170.10 ..
5.169.m: by means of a pleased virgin makes herself a cake for food offering and oblation, / and whatever woman takes that lump accompanied by the offering—

5.169.s:
śatavarṣā tu yā nārī piṃḍikāṃ bhakṣayeddvijāḥ ..
sā'pi putravatī ca syādyadi vṛddhatamā bhavet .. 11 ..
5.169.d:
शतवर्षा तु या नारी पिंडिकां भक्षयेद्द्विजाः ..
साऽपि पुत्रवती च स्याद्यदि वृद्धतमा भवेत् .. 11 ..
5.169.m: even a woman of a hundred years who eats that cake, O brahmins, / she too would become endowed with a son, even if she be extremely old;

5.169.s:
kiṃ punaryauvanopetā saubhāgyena samanvitā ..
putrasaukhyavatī nārī devyā vai darśanena ca .. .. 12 ..
5.169.d:
किं पुनर्यौवनोपेता सौभाग्येन समन्विता ..
पुत्रसौख्यवती नारी देव्या वै दर्शनेन च .. .. 12 ..
5.169.m: what to say then of a woman endowed with youth, endowed with good fortune? / Endowed with the joy of sons a woman becomes, indeed by the darśana of the goddess.

5.169.s:
sarveṣāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ tu bhāvajā devatā smṛtā ..
sā sārdhāṣṭadvipaṃcāśadgotrāṇāṃ kuladevatā .. 13 ..
5.169.d:
सर्वेषां नागराणां तु भावजा देवता स्मृता ..
सा सार्धाष्टद्विपंचाशद्गोत्राणां कुलदेवता .. 13 ..
5.169.m: For all Nāgaras, she is remembered as their deity born of devotion; / she is the family deity of fifty-two and a half gotras.

5.169.s:
etasmātkāraṇādyātrā nāgaraiḥ sukṛtā bhavet ..
na vinā nāgarairyātrāṃ tuṣṭiṃ yāti sureśvarī .. 14 ..
5.169.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्यात्रा नागरैः सुकृता भवेत् ..
न विना नागरैर्यात्रां तुष्टिं याति सुरेश्वरी .. 14 ..
5.169.m: For this reason, a pilgrimage by the Nāgaras will be virtuous; / without the pilgrimage by the Nāgaras, the sovereign goddess is not pleased.

5.169.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭake śvarakṣetramāhātmye dhārātīrthotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ 170 .. ..
