5.169.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटके श्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये धारातीर्थोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः 170 .. ..
5.169.m: Thus ends the one hundred seventieth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of the Origin of Dhārātīrtha,” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.170.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminneva kāle tu viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ..
tāṃ śaktiṃ vyarthatāṃ prāptāṃ jñātvā kopasamanvitaḥ .. 1 ..
5.170.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ..
तां शक्तिं व्यर्थतां प्राप्तां ज्ञात्वा कोपसमन्वितः .. 1 ..
5.170.m: Sūta said: / At that very time, the great sage Viśvāmitra, / seeing that his spear was rendered futile, was overcome with wrath. 1

5.170.s:
mumoca tadvadhārthāya brahmāstraṃ so'bhimaṃtritam ..
tasya saṃhitamātrasya prasvanaḥ samajāyata .. 2 ..
5.170.d:
मुमोच तद्वधार्थाय ब्रह्मास्त्रं सोऽभिमंत्रितम् ..
तस्य संहितमात्रस्य प्रस्वनः समजायत .. 2 ..
5.170.m: He discharged a Brahmā weapon charged with mantras to slay him. / As soon as it was fitted [to the bow], a loud sound arose. 2

5.170.s:
tataścolkāḥ prabhūtāśca prayāṃti ca nabhastalāt ..
tataḥ kuntāḥ śaktayaśca tomarāḥ parighāstathā .. 3 ..
5.170.d:
ततश्चोल्काः प्रभूताश्च प्रयांति च नभस्तलात् ..
ततः कुन्ताः शक्तयश्च तोमराः परिघास्तथा .. 3 ..
5.170.m: Then abundant meteors shot forth from the sky; / then lances, spears, clubs, and iron maces, 3

5.170.s:
bhiṃḍipālā gadāścaiva khaḍgāścaiva paraśvadhāḥ ..
bāṇāḥ prāsāḥ śataghnyaśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ..4..
5.170.d:
भिंडिपाला गदाश्चैव खड्गाश्चैव परश्वधाः ..
बाणाः प्रासाः शतघ्न्यश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ..4..
5.170.m: slings, maces, swords, battleaxes, / arrows, darts, and śataghnis by the hundreds and thousands [rained down]. 4

5.170.s:
vasiṣṭho'pi parijñāya preṣitaṃ gādhisūnunā ..
brahmāstraṃ mṛtyave tena śucirbhūtvā tataḥ param .. 5 ..
5.170.d:
वसिष्ठोऽपि परिज्ञाय प्रेषितं गाधिसूनुना ..
ब्रह्मास्त्रं मृत्यवे तेन शुचिर्भूत्वा ततः परम् .. 5 ..
5.170.m: Vasiṣṭha too, recognizing that the Brahmā weapon had been dispatched / by Gādhi's son for his death, purified himself thereafter, 5

5.170.s:
iṣīkāṃ ca samādāya brahmāstraṃ tatra yojayan ..
abravīdgādhiputrāya svastyastu tava pārśvataḥ .. 6 ..
5.170.d:
इषीकां च समादाय ब्रह्मास्त्रं तत्र योजयन् ..
अब्रवीद्गाधिपुत्राय स्वस्त्यस्तु तव पार्श्वतः .. 6 ..
5.170.m: and taking a blade of reed-grass, directed the Brahmā weapon into it. / He said to Gādhi's son: “May welfare be upon your side! 6

5.170.s:
hanyatāmastrametaddhimama vākyādasaṃśayam..
tatastena hataṃ tacca brahmāstraṃ tatsamudbhavam .. 7 ..
5.170.d:
हन्यतामस्त्रमेतद्धिमम वाक्यादसंशयम्..
ततस्तेन हतं तच्च ब्रह्मास्त्रं तत्समुद्भवम् .. 7 ..
5.170.m: Let this weapon be struck down by my command, without doubt!” / Then by that [blade of grass], the Brahmā weapon dispatched by him was neutralized. 7

5.170.s:
vajrāstraṃ ca tato muktaṃ vajrāstreṇa vināśitam ..
yadyadastraṃ kṣipatyeṣa viśvāmitraḥ prakopitaḥ .. 8 ..
5.170.d:
वज्रास्त्रं च ततो मुक्तं वज्रास्त्रेण विनाशितम् ..
यद्यदस्त्रं क्षिपत्येष विश्वामित्रः प्रकोपितः .. 8 ..
5.170.m: Then a thunderbolt weapon was released, and it was destroyed by a thunderbolt weapon. / Whatever weapon the enraged Viśvāmitra hurled, 8

5.170.s:
tattaddhaṃti vasiṣṭhastu maṃtrasya ca prabhāvataḥ ..
etasminneva kāle tu kṣubhito makarālayaḥ .. 9 ..
5.170.d:
तत्तद्धंति वसिष्ठस्तु मंत्रस्य च प्रभावतः ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु क्षुभितो मकरालयः .. 9 ..
5.170.m: that very weapon Vasiṣṭha countered through the power of his mantra. / At that very time, the ocean was agitated, 9

5.170.s:
śīryaṃte giriśṛṃgāṇi raktavṛṣṭiḥ parā sthitā ..
pralayasyeva cihnāni saṃjātāni dharātale ..
kimakāle mahāneṣa pralayaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati .. 6.171.10 ..
5.170.d:
शीर्यंते गिरिशृंगाणि रक्तवृष्टिः परा स्थिता ..
प्रलयस्येव चिह्नानि संजातानि धरातले ..
किमकाले महानेष प्रलयः संभविष्यति .. 6.171.10 ..
5.170.m: mountain peaks shattered, a great rain of blood fell, / and portents of cosmic dissolution appeared upon the earth's surface. / “Will this great dissolution take place out of its proper time?” 10

5.170.s:
tataḥ pitāmahaṃ jagmuḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
procuḥ pralayacihnāni yāni saṃti dharātale .. 11 ..
5.170.d:
ततः पितामहं जग्मुः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ..
प्रोचुः प्रलयचिह्नानि यानि संति धरातले .. 11 ..
5.170.m: Then all the gods, accompanied by Indra, went to the Grandfather, / and spoke of the signs of dissolution that were on the earth's surface. 11

5.170.s:
tato brahmā ciraṃ dhyātvā tānuvāca divaukasaḥ ..
viśvāmitra vasiṣṭhābhyāṃ yuddhametadvyavasthitam .. 12 ..
5.170.d:
ततो ब्रह्मा चिरं ध्यात्वा तानुवाच दिवौकसः ..
विश्वामित्र वसिष्ठाभ्यां युद्धमेतद्व्यवस्थितम् .. 12 ..
5.170.m: Then Brahmā, having meditated for a long time, spoke to the gods: / “This battle has broken out between Viśvāmitra and Vasiṣṭha, 12

5.170.s: divyāstrasaṃbhavaṃ devāstenaitadvyākulaṃ jagat .. 13 ..
5.170.d: दिव्यास्त्रसंभवं देवास्तेनैतद्व्याकुलं जगत् .. 13 ..
5.170.m: arising from divine weapons, O gods! By it the world is thrown into turmoil. 13

5.170.s:
tasmādgacchāmahe tatra yāvanno jāyate kṣayaḥ ..
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ divyāstrāṇāṃ prabhāvataḥ .. 14 ..
5.170.d:
तस्माद्गच्छामहे तत्र यावन्नो जायते क्षयः ..
सर्वेषामेव भूतानां दिव्यास्त्राणां प्रभावतः .. 14 ..
5.170.m: Therefore let us go there before the destruction occurs / of all living beings through the power of the divine weapons.” 14

5.170.s:
tato'bhigamya te deśaṃ yatra tau munisattamau ..
vicāmitravasiṣṭhau tau yudhyamānau parasparam ..15..
5.170.d:
ततोऽभिगम्य ते देशं यत्र तौ मुनिसत्तमौ ..
विचामित्रवसिष्ठौ तौ युध्यमानौ परस्परम् ..15..
5.170.m: Then they reached the place where those two best of sages, / Viśvāmitra and Vasiṣṭha, were fighting with one another. 15

5.170.s:
tataḥ provāca tau brahmā sāmnā paramavalgunā ..
nivartyatāmidaṃ yuddhametaddivyāstrasaṃbhavam ..
yāvanna pralayo bhāvi samaste dharaṇītale .. 16 .. ..
5.170.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तौ ब्रह्मा साम्ना परमवल्गुना ..
निवर्त्यतामिदं युद्धमेतद्दिव्यास्त्रसंभवम् ..
यावन्न प्रलयो भावि समस्ते धरणीतले .. 16 .. ..
5.170.m: Then Brahmā spoke to them both with exceedingly soothing words: / “Let this battle arising from divine weapons be stopped, / before dissolution occurs over the entire surface of the earth.” 16

5.170.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
nāhamastraṃ prayuṃjāmi viśvāmitravadhecchayā ..
ātmarakṣākṛte deva astramastreṇa śāmayan .. 17 ..
5.170.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
नाहमस्त्रं प्रयुंजामि विश्वामित्रवधेच्छया ..
आत्मरक्षाकृते देव अस्त्रमस्त्रेण शामयन् .. 17 ..
5.170.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / “I do not employ a weapon out of a desire to kill Viśvāmitra; / for the sake of self-defense, O god, I pacify weapon with weapon. 17

5.170.s:
ayaṃ mama vināśāya kevalaṃ cāstramokṣaṇam..
kurute nirdayo brahmaṃstaṃ nivāraya sāṃpratam .. 18 ..
5.170.d:
अयं मम विनाशाय केवलं चास्त्रमोक्षणम्..
कुरुते निर्दयो ब्रह्मंस्तं निवारय सांप्रतम् .. 18 ..
5.170.m: He alone discharges weapons for my destruction. / The pitiless one does so, O Brahmā; restrain him now!” 18

5.170.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
viśvāmitra muniśreṣṭha vasiṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇottamam ..
tvaṃ rakṣa mama vākyena tathā sarvamidaṃ jagat .. 19 ..
5.170.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
विश्वामित्र मुनिश्रेष्ठ वसिष्ठं ब्राह्मणोत्तमम् ..
त्वं रक्ष मम वाक्येन तथा सर्वमिदं जगत् .. 19 ..
5.170.m: Brahmā said: / “O Viśvāmitra, best of sages, spare Vasiṣṭha, the best of brahmins, / at my word, and likewise protect this entire world! 19

5.170.s: astramokṣavirāmaṃ tvaṃ brahmarṣe kuru satvaram .. 6.171.20 ..
5.170.d: अस्त्रमोक्षविरामं त्वं ब्रह्मर्षे कुरु सत्वरम् .. 6.171.20 ..
5.170.m: Quickly cease the discharging of weapons, O brahmin-seer!” 20

5.170.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
na māmeṣa dvijaṃ brūte kathaṃcitprapitāmaha ..
tasmādeṣa prakopo me saṃjāto'sya vadhopari .. 21 ..
5.170.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
न मामेष द्विजं ब्रूते कथंचित्प्रपितामह ..
तस्मादेष प्रकोपो मे संजातोऽस्य वधोपरि .. 21 ..
5.170.m: Viśvāmitra said: / “He does not address me as a twice-born, O Great-Grandfather! / For that reason this wrath of mine arose, bent upon slaying him. 21

5.170.s:
tasmādvadatu deveśa māmeṣa brāhmaṇaṃ drutam ..
nivārayāmi yenāstraṃ yadasyopari saṃdhitam ..22..
5.170.d:
तस्माद्वदतु देवेश मामेष ब्राह्मणं द्रुतम् ..
निवारयामि येनास्त्रं यदस्योपरि संधितम् ..22..
5.170.m: Therefore let him quickly call me a brahmin, O Lord of gods! / Whereby I will restrain the weapon that is aimed at him.” 22

5.170.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
tvaṃ vasiṣṭhādhunā brūhi viśvāmitraṃ mamājñayā ..
brāhmaṇo jāyate tena tava jīvasya rakṣaṇam .. 23 .. ..
5.170.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
त्वं वसिष्ठाधुना ब्रूहि विश्वामित्रं ममाज्ञया ..
ब्राह्मणो जायते तेन तव जीवस्य रक्षणम् .. 23 .. ..
5.170.m: Brahmā said: / “Now at my command, Vasiṣṭha, speak to Viśvāmitra! / By that he will become a brahmin, and your life will be preserved.” 23

5.170.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
nāhaṃ kṣatriyasaṃjātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vacmi padmaja ..
na vadhe mama śakto'yaṃ kathaṃcitkṣatriyodbhavaḥ .. 24 ..
5.170.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
नाहं क्षत्रियसंजातं ब्राह्मणं वच्मि पद्मज ..
न वधे मम शक्तोऽयं कथंचित्क्षत्रियोद्भवः .. 24 ..
5.170.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / “I will not call one born of a kṣatriya a brahmin, O Lotus-born! / One of kṣatriya origin is in no way capable of slaying me. 24

5.170.s:
brāhmyaṃ tejo na kṣā ttreṇa tejasā saṃpraṇaśyati .
evaṃ jñātvā caturvaktra yadyuktaṃ tatsamācara .. 25 ..
5.170.d:
ब्राह्म्यं तेजो न क्षा त्त्रेण तेजसा संप्रणश्यति .
एवं ज्ञात्वा चतुर्वक्त्र यद्युक्तं तत्समाचर .. 25 ..
5.170.m: Brahminic power is not destroyed by kṣatriya power. / Knowing this, O Four-faced One, do what is proper.” 25

5.170.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
viśvāmitra dvijaśreṣṭha tyaktvā divyāstrasaṃbhavam ..
kuru yuddhaṃ vasiṣṭhena no cecchapsyāmahaṃ ca te .. 26 ..
5.170.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
विश्वामित्र द्विजश्रेष्ठ त्यक्त्वा दिव्यास्त्रसंभवम् ..
कुरु युद्धं वसिष्ठेन नो चेच्छप्स्यामहं च ते .. 26 ..
5.170.m: Brahmā said: / “O Viśvāmitra, best of the twice-born, renounce fighting with divine weapons / and fight with Vasiṣṭha [without them], otherwise I will curse you!” 26

5.170.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
divyāstrāṇi ca saṃtyajya mayā vadhyaḥ sudurmatiḥ ..
kiṃcicchidraṃ samāsādya tvaṃ gaccha nijasaṃśrayam .. .. 27 .
5.170.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
दिव्यास्त्राणि च संत्यज्य मया वध्यः सुदुर्मतिः ..
किंचिच्छिद्रं समासाद्य त्वं गच्छ निजसंश्रयम् .. .. 27 .
5.170.m: Viśvāmitra said: / “Relinquishing the divine weapons, that evil-minded one shall be slain by me / once I find some vulnerability. Go to your own abode.” 27

5.170.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bāḍhamityevamuktā ca brahmalokaṃ gato vidhiḥ ..
viśvāmitravasiṣṭhau ca sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitau .. 28 ..
5.170.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
बाढमित्येवमुक्ता च ब्रह्मलोकं गतो विधिः ..
विश्वामित्रवसिष्ठौ च सरस्वत्यास्तटे स्थितौ .. 28 ..
5.170.m: Sūta said: / Saying “So be it,” Brahmā went to Brahmaloka; / and Viśvāmitra and Vasiṣṭha remained on the bank of the Sarasvatī. 28

5.170.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye vasiṣṭhaviśvāmitra yuddhe divyāstranivartanavarṇanaṃnāmaikasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 171 ..
5.170.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वसिष्ठविश्वामित्र युद्धे दिव्यास्त्रनिवर्तनवर्णनंनामैकसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 171 ..
5.170.m: Thus ends the one hundred seventy-first chapter, entitled “Description of the Cessation of Divine Weapons in the Battle between Vasiṣṭha and Viśvāmitra,” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.171.s:
sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥprabhṛti cchidrāṇi viśvāmitro nirīkṣayan ..
vasiṣṭhasya vadhārthāya saṃsthito dvijasattamāḥ .. 1 ..
5.171.d:
सूत उवाच .. ..
ततःप्रभृति च्छिद्राणि विश्वामित्रो निरीक्षयन् ..
वसिष्ठस्य वधार्थाय संस्थितो द्विजसत्तमाः .. 1 ..
5.171.m: Sūta said: / From then on, watching for vulnerabilities, / Viśvāmitra remained waiting to slay Vasiṣṭha, O best of the twice-born, 1

5.171.s:
ātmaśaktiprabhāvena maśakasya yathā gajaḥ ..
anyasminnahani prāpte viśvāmitreṇa sā nadī .. 2 ..
5.171.d:
आत्मशक्तिप्रभावेन मशकस्य यथा गजः ..
अन्यस्मिन्नहनि प्राप्ते विश्वामित्रेण सा नदी .. 2 ..
5.171.m: like an elephant [seeking to crush] a mosquito by the power of his own might. / When another day arrived, that river was summoned 2

5.171.s:
samāhūtā samāyātā drutaṃ sā strīsvarūpiṇī ..
abravītprāṃjalirbhūtvā ādeśo dīyatāṃ mama ..
brahmarṣe yena kāryeṇa samāhūtāsmi sāṃpratam .. 3 ..
5.171.d:
समाहूता समायाता द्रुतं सा स्त्रीस्वरूपिणी ..
अब्रवीत्प्रांजलिर्भूत्वा आदेशो दीयतां मम ..
ब्रह्मर्षे येन कार्येण समाहूतास्मि सांप्रतम् .. 3 ..
5.171.m: by Viśvāmitra; she came swiftly in the form of a woman. / Folding her hands in reverence, she said: “Let an order be given to me, / O brahmin-seer, for what purpose have I been summoned now?” 3

5.171.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
yadā nimajjanaṃ kuryāttava toye mahānadi ..
paramaṃ vegamāsthāya tadā''naya mamāṃtikam .. 4 ..
5.171.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
यदा निमज्जनं कुर्यात्तव तोये महानदि ..
परमं वेगमास्थाय तदा'ऽनय ममांतिकम् .. 4 ..
5.171.m: Viśvāmitra said: / “When he performs his ablution in your water, O great river, / assume the utmost velocity and bring him near me, 4

5.171.s:
pūrṇaśrotraṃ jale naiva vyākulāṃgaṃ vyavasthitam ..
nihanmi yena śīghraṃ ca nānyacchidraṃ pralakṣaye .. 5 ..
5.171.d:
पूर्णश्रोत्रं जले नैव व्याकुलांगं व्यवस्थितम् ..
निहन्मि येन शीघ्रं च नान्यच्छिद्रं प्रलक्षये .. 5 ..
5.171.m: his ears filled with water, his limbs thrown into disorder, / so that I may slay him quickly, for I see no other weakness.” 5

5.171.s:
evamuktā tadā tena viśvāmitreṇa sā nadī ..
vitrastā bhayasaṃyuktā śāpādvākyamuvāca sā .. 6 ..
5.171.d:
एवमुक्ता तदा तेन विश्वामित्रेण सा नदी ..
वित्रस्ता भयसंयुक्ता शापाद्वाक्यमुवाच सा .. 6 ..
5.171.m: Addressed thus by Viśvāmitra, the river, / terrified and filled with fear of a curse, spoke these words: 6

5.171.s:
nāhaṃ drohaṃ kariṣyāmi vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ..
brahmarṣe na ca te yuktaṃ kartuṃ vai brahmaṇo vadham .. 7 ..
5.171.d:
नाहं द्रोहं करिष्यामि वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः ..
ब्रह्मर्षे न च ते युक्तं कर्तुं वै ब्रह्मणो वधम् .. 7 ..
5.171.m: “I will not commit treason against the great-souled Vasiṣṭha. / O brahmin-seer, it is not proper for you to carry out the murder of a brahmin. 7

5.171.s:
yadi tvaṃ brahmaṇā prokto brahmarṣiḥ svayameva tu ..
kāmānnāyaṃ vasiṣṭhastu tasmātkopaṃ parityaja .. 8 ..
5.171.d:
यदि त्वं ब्रह्मणा प्रोक्तो ब्रह्मर्षिः स्वयमेव तु ..
कामान्नायं वसिष्ठस्तु तस्मात्कोपं परित्यज .. 8 ..
5.171.m: If you have been declared a brahmin-seer by Brahmā himself, / yet Vasiṣṭha does not [call you so] out of [self-]will, cast aside your anger! 8

5.171.s:
manasāpi vadhaṃ yastu brāhmaṇasya viciṃtayet ..
taptakṛcchreṇa mucyeta manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt .. 9 ..
5.171.d:
मनसापि वधं यस्तु ब्राह्मणस्य विचिंतयेत् ..
तप्तकृच्छ्रेण मुच्येत मनुः स्वायंभुवोऽब्रवीत् .. 9 ..
5.171.m: He who even in thought contemplates the slaying of a brahmin / is purified only through a taptakṛcchra penance, so said Svāyambhuva Manu.” 9

5.171.s:
vācayā pravadedyastu brāhmaṇasya vadhaṃ naraḥ ..
cāṃdrāyaṇena śuddhiḥ syāttasya devo'bravīdidam .. 6.172.10 ..
5.171.d:
वाचया प्रवदेद्यस्तु ब्राह्मणस्य वधं नरः ..
चांद्रायणेन शुद्धिः स्यात्तस्य देवोऽब्रवीदिदम् .. 6.172.10 ..
5.171.m: And the man who speaks aloud of killing a brahmin / would be purified by the Cāndrāyaṇa penance; this the god has said.

5.171.s:
tasmānnāhaṃ kariṣyāmi tava vākyaṃ kathaṃcana ..
vasiṣṭhārthaṃ tu yatproktaṃ kuru yattava rocate .. 11 ..
5.171.d:
तस्मान्नाहं करिष्यामि तव वाक्यं कथंचन ..
वसिष्ठार्थं तु यत्प्रोक्तं कुरु यत्तव रोचते .. 11 ..
5.171.m: Therefore, I will never carry out your word / that you spoke concerning Vasiṣṭha. Do as you please!"

5.171.s:
tacchrutvā kupitastasyā viśvāmitro dvijottamāḥ ..
śaśāpa tāṃ nadīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ yattadvakṣyāmi śrūyatām .. 12 ..
5.171.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा कुपितस्तस्या विश्वामित्रो द्विजोत्तमाः ..
शशाप तां नदीं श्रेष्ठां यत्तद्वक्ष्यामि श्रूयताम् .. 12 ..
5.171.m: Hearing that, Viśvāmitra was enraged at her, O best of brahmins, / and cursed that foremost of rivers. Listen to what he said:

5.171.s:
yasmātpāpe vaco mahyaṃ na kṛtaṃ kunadi tvayā ..
tasmādraktapravāhaste jalajo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 13 ..
5.171.d:
यस्मात्पापे वचो मह्यं न कृतं कुनदि त्वया ..
तस्माद्रक्तप्रवाहस्ते जलजोऽयं भविष्यति .. 13 ..
5.171.m: "Since, O wicked one, you have not obeyed my word, O vile river, / therefore your aquatic current shall become a stream of blood!"

5.171.s:
evamuktvā karāttoyaṃ saptavārābhimaṃtritam ..
cikṣepātha jale tasyāḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ .. 14 ..
5.171.d:
एवमुक्त्वा करात्तोयं सप्तवाराभिमंत्रितम् ..
चिक्षेपाथ जले तस्याः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः .. 14 ..
5.171.m: Having spoken thus, his eyes red with anger, / he then threw water from his hand, consecrated seven times with mantras, into her waters.

5.171.s:
tataśca tatkṣaṇājjātaṃ tattoyaṃ rudhiraṃ dvijāḥ ..
sārasvataṃ supuṇyaṃ ca yadāsīcchaṃkhasaṃnibham .. 15 ..
5.171.d:
ततश्च तत्क्षणाज्जातं तत्तोयं रुधिरं द्विजाः ..
सारस्वतं सुपुण्यं च यदासीच्छंखसंनिभम् .. 15 ..
5.171.m: And then at that very moment, O brahmins, that water of Sarasvatī, / which had been very holy and resembled a conch, turned into blood.

5.171.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptā bhūtapretaniśācarāḥ ..
pītvāpītvā pranṛtyaṃti gāyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca .. 16 ..
5.171.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ता भूतप्रेतनिशाचराः ..
पीत्वापीत्वा प्रनृत्यंति गायंति च हसंति च .. 16 ..
5.171.m: In the meantime, ghosts, spirits, and night-roaming demons arrived; / drinking repeatedly, they danced, sang, and laughed.

5.171.s:
ye tatra tāpasāḥ kecittaṭe tasyā vyavasthitāḥ ..
te sarve'pi ca tāṃ tyaktā dūradeśaṃ samāśritāḥ .. 17 ..
5.171.d:
ये तत्र तापसाः केचित्तटे तस्या व्यवस्थिताः ..
ते सर्वेऽपि च तां त्यक्ता दूरदेशं समाश्रिताः .. 17 ..
5.171.m: Whatever ascetics resided there upon her bank, / all of them left her and sought a distant country.

5.171.s:
bahirvāsāśca ye tatra nāgarāḥ samavasthitāḥ ..
caṇḍaśarma prabhṛtayaste'pi yātāḥ sudūrataḥ .. 18 ..
5.171.d:
बहिर्वासाश्च ये तत्र नागराः समवस्थिताः ..
चण्डशर्म प्रभृतयस्तेऽपि याताः सुदूरतः .. 18 ..
5.171.m: And those Nāgaras dwelling outside who were settled there, / Caṇḍaśarman and the others, also went far away.

5.171.s:
vasiṣṭho'pi muniśreṣṭho jagāmārbudaparvatam ..
viśvāmitrastu viprarṣiścamatkārapuraṃ gataḥ .. 19 ..
5.171.d:
वसिष्ठोऽपि मुनिश्रेष्ठो जगामार्बुदपर्वतम् ..
विश्वामित्रस्तु विप्रर्षिश्चमत्कारपुरं गतः .. 19 ..
5.171.m: Vasiṣṭha too, the best of munis, went to Mount Arbuda, / while Viśvāmitra, the brahmin seer, went to Camatkārapura,

5.171.s:
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre yatsthitaṃ viprasaṃkulam ..
tatrāśramapadaṃ kṛtvā tapastepe sudāruṇam ..6.172.20...
5.171.d:
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे यत्स्थितं विप्रसंकुलम् ..
तत्राश्रमपदं कृत्वा तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् ..6.172.20...
5.171.m: which was situated in the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara, filled with brahmins. / Establishing an hermitage there, he performed terrible austerity,

5.171.s:
yena sṛṣṭikṣamo jātaḥ spardhate brahmaṇā saha ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yathā sārasvataṃ jalam .. 21 ..
5.171.d:
येन सृष्टिक्षमो जातः स्पर्धते ब्रह्मणा सह ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यथा सारस्वतं जलम् .. 21 ..
5.171.m: by which he became capable of creation and rivaled Brahmā. / All this has been related to you: how the water of Sarasvatī

5.171.s:
rudhiratvamanuprāptaṃ viśvāmitrasya śāpataḥ ..
caṃḍaśarmādayo viprā yathā deśāṃtaraṃ gatāḥ ..22..
5.171.d:
रुधिरत्वमनुप्राप्तं विश्वामित्रस्य शापतः ..
चंडशर्मादयो विप्रा यथा देशांतरं गताः ..22..
5.171.m: turned to blood by the curse of Viśvāmitra, / and how the brahmins, Caṇḍaśarman and others, went to another land.

5.171.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa kāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sarasvatīśāpavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..172.. cha .. ..
5.171.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण काशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सरस्वतीशापवृत्तांतवर्णनंनाम द्विसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..172.. छ .. ..
5.171.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Curse on Sarasvatī,' in the māhātmya of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.172.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
aho bata mahāścaryaṃ viśvāmitrasya sanmuneḥ ..
maṃtraprabhāvato yena tattoyaṃ rudhirīkṛtam .. 1 ..
5.172.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
अहो बत महाश्चर्यं विश्वामित्रस्य सन्मुनेः ..
मंत्रप्रभावतो येन तत्तोयं रुधिरीकृतम् .. 1 ..
5.172.m: The seers said: / "Ah, indeed, great was the marvel of Viśvāmitra, the true muni, / by whom that water was turned into blood through the power of mantras!

5.172.s:
tataḥprabhṛti saṃprāptaṃ kathaṃ toyaṃ prakīrtaya ..
sarasvatyā mahābhāga sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 2 ..
5.172.d:
ततःप्रभृति संप्राप्तं कथं तोयं प्रकीर्तय ..
सरस्वत्या महाभाग सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 2 ..
5.172.m: Relate how water was restored from that time on / to Sarasvatī, O fortunate one; tell everything in detail."

5.172.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bahukālaṃ pravāhaḥ sa sarasvatyā dvijottamāḥ ..
mahānraktamayo jāto bhūtarākṣasasevitaḥ .. 3 ..
5.172.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
बहुकालं प्रवाहः स सरस्वत्या द्विजोत्तमाः ..
महान्रक्तमयो जातो भूतराक्षससेवितः .. 3 ..
5.172.m: Sūta said: / "For a long time, O best of brahmins, that current of Sarasvatī / remained a great [stream] of blood, frequented by ghosts and rākṣasas.

5.172.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya vasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ ..
arbudasthastayā prokto dīnayā duḥkhayuktayā .. 4 ..
5.172.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः ..
अर्बुदस्थस्तया प्रोक्तो दीनया दुःखयुक्तया .. 4 ..
5.172.m: Then after some time, Vasiṣṭha, the best of munis, / who was dwelling on Arbuda, was addressed by her, wretched and filled with grief:

5.172.s:
tavārthāya mune śaptā viśvāmitreṇa kopataḥ ..
rudhiraughavahājātā tapasvijanavarjitā ..5..
5.172.d:
तवार्थाय मुने शप्ता विश्वामित्रेण कोपतः ..
रुधिरौघवहाजाता तपस्विजनवर्जिता ..5..
5.172.m: 'For your sake, O muni, I was cursed in anger by Viśvāmitra; / I have become a bearer of a torrent of blood, abandoned by ascetics.

5.172.s:
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yathā syātsalilaṃ punaḥ ..
pravāhe mama viprendra prayāti rudhiraṃ kṣayam ..6..
5.172.d:
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे यथा स्यात्सलिलं पुनः ..
प्रवाहे मम विप्रेन्द्र प्रयाति रुधिरं क्षयम् ..6..
5.172.m: Therefore, grant me your grace, O chief of brahmins, so that water may again / flow in my current, and the blood come to an end.

5.172.s:
trailokyakaraṇe vipra saṃkṣaye vā sthitau hi vā ..
nāśaktirvidyate kācittava sarvamunīśvara .. 7 ..
5.172.d:
त्रैलोक्यकरणे विप्र संक्षये वा स्थितौ हि वा ..
नाशक्तिर्विद्यते काचित्तव सर्वमुनीश्वर .. 7 ..
5.172.m: In the creation, destruction, or maintenance of the three worlds, O brahmin, / there is indeed no inability in you, O lord of all munis!'"

5.172.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
tathā bhadre kariṣyāmi yathā syātsalilaṃ punaḥ ..
pravāhe tava niryāti sarvaṃ raktaṃ parikṣayam .. 8 ..
5.172.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
तथा भद्रे करिष्यामि यथा स्यात्सलिलं पुनः ..
प्रवाहे तव निर्याति सर्वं रक्तं परिक्षयम् .. 8 ..
5.172.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / "I shall act in such a way, O auspicious one, that water will again appear / in your current, and all the blood will perish."

5.172.s:
evamuktvā sa viprarṣiravatīrya dharātale ..
gataḥ plakṣataruṃ yasmā davatīrṇā sarasvatī .. 9 ..
5.172.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रर्षिरवतीर्य धरातले ..
गतः प्लक्षतरुं यस्मा दवतीर्णा सरस्वती .. 9 ..
5.172.m: Having spoken thus, that brahmin seer descended to the surface of the earth / and went to the plakṣa tree from which Sarasvatī had descended.

5.172.s:
samādhiṃ tatra saṃdhāya niviṣṭo dharaṇītale ..
saṃbhramaṃ paramaṃ gatvā viśvāmitrasya copari .. 6.173.10 ..
5.172.d:
समाधिं तत्र संधाय निविष्टो धरणीतले ..
संभ्रमं परमं गत्वा विश्वामित्रस्य चोपरि .. 6.173.10 ..
5.172.m: Entering into deep meditation there, he sat on the surface of the earth, / having felt great perplexity on account of Viśvāmitra.

5.172.s:
vāruṇena tu mantreṇa vīkṣa yanvasudhātalam ..
tato nirbhidya vasudhāṃ bhūritoyaṃ vinirgatam 11 ..
5.172.d:
वारुणेन तु मन्त्रेण वीक्ष यन्वसुधातलम् ..
ततो निर्भिद्य वसुधां भूरितोयं विनिर्गतम् 11 ..
5.172.m: Looking at the surface of the earth with a mantra dedicated to Varuṇa, / abundant water broke through the earth and burst forth,

5.172.s:
randhradvayena viprendrā locanābhyāṃ nirīkṣaṇāt ..
ekasya salilaṃ kṣipraṃ yatra jātā sarasvatī .. 12 ..
5.172.d:
रन्ध्रद्वयेन विप्रेन्द्रा लोचनाभ्यां निरीक्षणात् ..
एकस्य सलिलं क्षिप्रं यत्र जाता सरस्वती .. 12 ..
5.172.m: through two openings, O chiefs of brahmins, because of the gaze of his two eyes. / The water of one [opening] swiftly went to where Sarasvatī was born,

5.172.s:
plakṣamūle tatastasya vegenāpahṛtaṃ balāt ..
tadraktaṃ tena saṃpūrṇaṃ tatastena mahānadī .. 13 ..
5.172.d:
प्लक्षमूले ततस्तस्य वेगेनापहृतं बलात् ..
तद्रक्तं तेन संपूर्णं ततस्तेन महानदी .. 13 ..
5.172.m: and then at the root of the plakṣa tree, it carried off by force / that blood with its momentum; then the great river was filled with that [water].

5.172.s:
dvitīyastu pravāho yaḥ saṃbhramā ttasya nirgataḥ ..
sā ca sābhramatī nāma nadī jātā dharātale .. 14 ..
5.172.d:
द्वितीयस्तु प्रवाहो यः संभ्रमा त्तस्य निर्गतः ..
सा च साभ्रमती नाम नदी जाता धरातले .. 14 ..
5.172.m: And the second current, which issued forth from his agitation, / became the river named Sābhramatī on the surface of the earth.

5.172.s:
evaṃ prakṛtimāpannā bhūya eva sarasvatī ..
yatpṛṣṭo'smi mahābhāgāḥ sarasvatyāḥ kṛte dvijāḥ .. 15 ..
5.172.d:
एवं प्रकृतिमापन्ना भूय एव सरस्वती ..
यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि महाभागाः सरस्वत्याः कृते द्विजाः .. 15 ..
5.172.m: Thus Sarasvatī returned to her natural state once again, / concerning which I was questioned by you, O fortunate brahmins, for the sake of Sarasvatī.

5.172.s:
etatsārasvataṃ nāma vyākhyānamatibuddhidam ..
yaḥ paṭhecchraṇuyādvāpi matistasya vivarddhate ..
sarasvatyāḥ prasādena satyametanma yoditam .. 16..
5.172.d:
एतत्सारस्वतं नाम व्याख्यानमतिबुद्धिदम् ..
यः पठेच्छ्रणुयाद्वापि मतिस्तस्य विवर्द्धते ..
सरस्वत्याः प्रसादेन सत्यमेतन्म योदितम् .. 16..
5.172.m: Whoever reads or hears this narrative named after Sarasvatī, / which grants great intellect, their mind increases / by the grace of Sarasvatī; this truth has been spoken by me.

5.172.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sarasvatyupākhyāne sarasvatī śāpamocanasābhramatyutpattivṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma trisaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 173 .. ..
5.172.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्या संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सरस्वत्युपाख्याने सरस्वती शापमोचनसाभ्रमत्युत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम त्रिसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 173 .. ..
5.172.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Deliverance of Sarasvatī from the Curse and the Origin of Sābhramatī,' in the narrative of Sarasvatī in the māhātmya of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.173.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyadapi vo vacmi liṃgaṃ yattatra saṃsthitam ..
sthāpitaṃ pippalādena kaṃsāreśvaramityaho .. 1 ..
5.173.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्यदपि वो वच्मि लिंगं यत्तत्र संस्थितम् ..
स्थापितं पिप्पलादेन कंसारेश्वरमित्यहो .. 1 ..
5.173.m: Sūta said: / "I shall also tell you of another liṅga that is located there, / installed by Pippalāda, called Kaṃsāreśvara—how wonderful!

5.173.s:
yasmindṛṣṭe tu lokānāṃ pāpaṃ yāti dinodbhavam ..
nate ṣāṇmāsikaṃ caiva pūjite varṣasaṃbhavam.. ..
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
pippalādena yalliṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ sūtanandana ..
kaṃsāreśvaramityuktaṃ kasmāttacca bravīhi naḥ .. 3 ..
5.173.d:
यस्मिन्दृष्टे तु लोकानां पापं याति दिनोद्भवम् ..
नते षाण्मासिकं चैव पूजिते वर्षसंभवम्.. ..
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
पिप्पलादेन यल्लिंगं स्थापितं सूतनन्दन ..
कंसारेश्वरमित्युक्तं कस्मात्तच्च ब्रवीहि नः .. 3 ..
5.173.m: Merely by seeing it, the sin of human beings born of a single day departs; / when bowed to, [the sin] of six months; and when worshipped, that born of a whole year." / The seers said: / "Tell us, O son of Sūta, why that liṅga installed by Pippalāda / is called Kaṃsāreśvara.

5.173.s:
ka eṣa pippalādastu kasya putro vadasva naḥ ..
kimarthaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ kṣetre tatra mahātmanā .. 4 ..
5.173.d:
क एष पिप्पलादस्तु कस्य पुत्रो वदस्व नः ..
किमर्थं स्थापितं लिंगं क्षेत्रे तत्र महात्मना .. 4 ..
5.173.m: Who is this Pippalāda, whose son is he? Tell us: / for what reason was the liṅga installed by that great soul in that sacred field?"

5.173.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
praśnabhāro mahāneṣa bhavadbhiḥ samudāhṛtaḥ ..
tathāpi kathayiṣyāmi namaskṛtvā svayaṃbhuvam .. 5 ..
5.173.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
प्रश्नभारो महानेष भवद्भिः समुदाहृतः ..
तथापि कथयिष्यामि नमस्कृत्वा स्वयंभुवम् .. 5 ..
5.173.m: Sūta said: / "This great burden of questions has been raised by you; / nevertheless, I shall tell it, having bowed to the self-manifest one.

5.173.s:
yājñavalkyasyabhaginī kaṃsārīti ca viśrutā ..
kumārabrahmacaryeṇa tapa stepe sudāruṇam.. 6 ..
5.173.d:
याज्ञवल्क्यस्यभगिनी कंसारीति च विश्रुता ..
कुमारब्रह्मचर्येण तप स्तेपे सुदारुणम्.. 6 ..
5.173.m: The sister of Yājñavalkya, known as Kaṃsārī, / performed terrible austerity with lifelong celibacy,

5.173.s:
yājñavalkyāśrame puṇye bāṃdhavena samanvitā ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya yājñavalkyasya bho dvijāḥ ..7..
5.173.d:
याज्ञवल्क्याश्रमे पुण्ये बांधवेन समन्विता ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य याज्ञवल्क्यस्य भो द्विजाः ..7..
5.173.m: living together with her kinsman in Yājñavalkya's holy hermitage. / Then after some time, O brahmins, [the semen] of Yājñavalkya,

5.173.s:
caskanda retaḥ svapnāṃte dṛṣṭvā kāṃcidvarāpsarām..
tāruṇyabhāvasaṃsthasya tapoyuktasya saddvijāḥ .. 8 ..
5.173.d:
चस्कन्द रेतः स्वप्नांते दृष्ट्वा कांचिद्वराप्सराम्..
तारुण्यभावसंस्थस्य तपोयुक्तस्य सद्द्विजाः .. 8 ..
5.173.m: who was in the state of youth and endowed with austerity, O noble brahmins, / fell at the end of a dream upon seeing a certain excellent apsaras.

5.173.s:
retasā tasya mahatā paridhānaṃ pariplutam ..
tacca tena parityaktaṃ prabhāte samupasthite .. 9 ..
5.173.d:
रेतसा तस्य महता परिधानं परिप्लुतम् ..
तच्च तेन परित्यक्तं प्रभाते समुपस्थिते .. 9 ..
5.173.m: His garment was drenched with that copious semen, / and it was discarded by him when the morning arrived.

5.173.s:
kaṃsārikā'tha jagrāha snānārthaṃ vasanaṃ ca tat ..
amogharetasā klinnamajānantī dvijottamāḥ .. 6.174.10 ..
5.173.d:
कंसारिकाऽथ जग्राह स्नानार्थं वसनं च तत् ..
अमोघरेतसा क्लिन्नमजानन्ती द्विजोत्तमाः .. 6.174.10 ..
5.173.m: Then Kaṃsārikā took that garment for bathing, / not knowing that it was soaked with the unfailing semen, O best of brahmins.

5.173.s:
kurvantyā yajanaṃ tasyā jalaṃ vīryasamanvitam ..
praviṣṭaṃ bhagamadhye tu ṛtukāla upasthite .. 11 ..
5.173.d:
कुर्वन्त्या यजनं तस्या जलं वीर्यसमन्वितम् ..
प्रविष्टं भगमध्ये तु ऋतुकाल उपस्थिते .. 11 ..
5.173.m: As she performed the rite, the water mixed with semen / entered into the midst of her womb, for the fertile season had arrived.

5.173.s:
tato garbhaḥ samabhavattasyāstūdaramadhyagaḥ ..
vṛddhiṃ cāpyagamannityaṃ śuklapakṣe yathoḍurāṭ .. 12 ..
5.173.d:
ततो गर्भः समभवत्तस्यास्तूदरमध्यगः ..
वृद्धिं चाप्यगमन्नित्यं शुक्लपक्षे यथोडुराट् .. 12 ..
5.173.m: Then an embryo formed inside her belly, / and it grew constantly, like the lord of the stars in the bright fortnight.

5.173.s:
sā'pi taṃ garbhamādāya svodarasthaṃ tapasvinī ..
duḥkhena mahatā yuktā lajjayā'tha tadā''vṛtā .. 13 ..
5.173.d:
साऽपि तं गर्भमादाय स्वोदरस्थं तपस्विनी ..
दुःखेन महता युक्ता लज्जयाऽथ तदा'ऽवृता .. 13 ..
5.173.m: Carrying that embryo situated in her womb, the ascetic woman / was filled with great sorrow and enveloped in shame.

5.173.s:
cintayāmāsa suciraṃ vismayena samanvitā ..
gopāyantī tadā''tmānaṃ darśanaṃ yāti no nṛṇām .. 14 ..
5.173.d:
चिन्तयामास सुचिरं विस्मयेन समन्विता ..
गोपायन्ती तदा'ऽत्मानं दर्शनं याति नो नृणाम् .. 14 ..
5.173.m: She reflected for a long time, seized by wonder; / concealing herself at that time, she did not go into the sight of men.

5.173.s:
vratacaryāmiṣaṃ kṛtvā sadā rahasi saṃsthitā ..
saṃprāpte daśame māsi niśīthe samupasthite ..
tasyāḥ kumārako jāto vālārkasadṛśadyutiḥ .. 15 ..
5.173.d:
व्रतचर्यामिषं कृत्वा सदा रहसि संस्थिता ..
संप्राप्ते दशमे मासि निशीथे समुपस्थिते ..
तस्याः कुमारको जातो वालार्कसदृशद्युतिः .. 15 ..
5.173.m: Using the observance of vows as a pretext, she remained constantly in secret. / When the tenth month arrived and midnight was reached, / a boy was born to her, possessing a radiance like the morning sun.

5.173.s:
atha sā taṃ samā dāya sūkṣmavastreṇa veṣṭitam ..
kṛtvā jagāma cāraṇyaṃ manuṣyaparivarjitam ..
aśrupūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā rudantī guptameva ca .. 16 ..
5.173.d:
अथ सा तं समा दाय सूक्ष्मवस्त्रेण वेष्टितम् ..
कृत्वा जगाम चारण्यं मनुष्यपरिवर्जितम् ..
अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणा दीना रुदन्ती गुप्तमेव च .. 16 ..
5.173.m: Then she took him, wrapped him in a fine cloth, / and went to a forest devoid of human beings, / her eyes full of tears, miserable, weeping in secret.

5.173.s:
tato gatvā ca sā'śvatthaṃ vijane sumahattaram ..
tasyādhastādvimucyātha vākyametaduvāca ha .. 17 ..
5.173.d:
ततो गत्वा च साऽश्वत्थं विजने सुमहत्तरम् ..
तस्याधस्ताद्विमुच्याथ वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 17 ..
5.173.m: Then, having approached a very large peepal tree in that deserted place, / she left him beneath it and spoke these words:

5.173.s:
aśvattha viṣṇurūpo'si tvaṃ deveṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
tasmādrakṣasva me putraṃ sarvatastvaṃ vanaspate .. 18 ..
5.173.d:
अश्वत्थ विष्णुरूपोऽसि त्वं देवेषु प्रतिष्ठितः ..
तस्माद्रक्षस्व मे पुत्रं सर्वतस्त्वं वनस्पते .. 18 ..
5.173.m: “O peepal tree, you are of the form of Viṣṇu, established among the gods. / Therefore, protect my son from every side, O tree!

5.173.s:
eṣa te śaraṇaṃ prāpto mama putrastu bālakaḥ ..
pāpāyā nirdayāyāśca tasmādrakṣāṃ samācara .. 19 ..
5.173.d:
एष ते शरणं प्राप्तो मम पुत्रस्तु बालकः ..
पापाया निर्दयायाश्च तस्माद्रक्षां समाचर .. 19 ..
5.173.m: This child, my son, has sought refuge with you / from a sinful and merciless [mother]; therefore, afford him protection!”

5.173.s:
evamuktvā ruditvā ca suciraṃ sā tapasvinī ..
jagāma svāśramaṃ paścādvāṣpavyākulalocanā .. 6.174.20 ..
5.173.d:
एवमुक्त्वा रुदित्वा च सुचिरं सा तपस्विनी ..
जगाम स्वाश्रमं पश्चाद्वाष्पव्याकुललोचना .. 6.174.20 ..
5.173.m: Having spoken thus and wept for a long time, that ascetic woman / afterwards went to her own hermitage, her eyes agitated with tears.

5.173.s:
yāvadroditi sā mātā tasyādhastādvanaspateḥ ..
tāvadākāśajā vāṇī saṃjātā meghaniḥsvanā .. 21 ..
5.173.d:
यावद्रोदिति सा माता तस्याधस्ताद्वनस्पतेः ..
तावदाकाशजा वाणी संजाता मेघनिःस्वना .. 21 ..
5.173.m: As the mother wept beneath that tree, / just then a voice from the sky arose, sounding like a thundercloud:

5.173.s:
mā tvaṃ śokaṃ kuruṣvāsya bālakasya kṛte śubhe ..
eṣa śāpādutathyasya jyeṣṭhabhrāturbṛhaspatiḥ ..
avatīrṇo dharāpṛṣṭhe yogyatāṃ samavāpsyati .. 22 ..
5.173.d:
मा त्वं शोकं कुरुष्वास्य बालकस्य कृते शुभे ..
एष शापादुतथ्यस्य ज्येष्ठभ्रातुर्बृहस्पतिः ..
अवतीर्णो धरापृष्ठे योग्यतां समवाप्स्यति .. 22 ..
5.173.m: “Do not grieve on account of this child, O auspicious woman! / Through the curse of his elder brother Utathya, this Bṛhaspati / has descended upon the surface of the earth; he will attain high competence.

5.173.s:
eṣa cātharvaṇaṃ vedaṃ śatakalpaṃ suvistaram ..
śatabhedaṃ ca navadhā paṃcakalpaṃ kariṣyati .. 23 ..
5.173.d:
एष चाथर्वणं वेदं शतकल्पं सुविस्तरम् ..
शतभेदं च नवधा पंचकल्पं करिष्यति .. 23 ..
5.173.m: And he will make the Atharva Veda, which has a hundred rituals, is very extensive, / and has a hundred divisions, into nine branches and five rituals.

5.173.s:
pippalasya taroreṣa rasaṃ saṃbhakṣayiṣyati ..
pippalāda iti khyātastato loke bhaviṣyati .. 24 ..
5.173.d:
पिप्पलस्य तरोरेष रसं संभक्षयिष्यति ..
पिप्पलाद इति ख्यातस्ततो लोके भविष्यति .. 24 ..
5.173.m: He will consume the juice of the peepal tree; / therefore he will be known in the world as Pippalāda.

5.173.s:
yā tvaṃ vismayamāpannā puruṣeṇa vinā śiśuḥ..
saṃjāto'yaṃ mama prāṃśustatastatkāraṇaṃ śṛṇu .. 25 ..
5.173.d:
या त्वं विस्मयमापन्ना पुरुषेण विना शिशुः..
संजातोऽयं मम प्रांशुस्ततस्तत्कारणं शृणु .. 25 ..
5.173.m: Since you are astonished, thinking, ‘How was this tall infant / born to me without a man?’, listen therefore to the reason for it.

5.173.s:
snānavastraṃ ca te bhrātū retasā yatpariplutam ..
tattvayā ṛtukāle tu paridhānaṃ kṛtaṃ śubhe .. 26 ..
5.173.d:
स्नानवस्त्रं च ते भ्रातू रेतसा यत्परिप्लुतम् ..
तत्त्वया ऋतुकाले तु परिधानं कृतं शुभे .. 26 ..
5.173.m: The bathing cloth of your brother, which was drenched with semen— / that was worn by you as a garment in your fertile season, O auspicious lady.

5.173.s:
snānakāle tu toyāni retodakamathāspṛśan ..
amogharetasā tena putro'yaṃ tava saṃsthitaḥ .. 27 ..
5.173.d:
स्नानकाले तु तोयानि रेतोदकमथास्पृशन् ..
अमोघरेतसा तेन पुत्रोऽयं तव संस्थितः .. 27 ..
5.173.m: At the time of bathing, the waters touched that water containing semen; / through that unfailing semen, this son of yours was established.

5.173.s: evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāge yadyuktaṃ tatsamācara .. 28 .. ..
5.173.d: एवं ज्ञात्वा महाभागे यद्युक्तं तत्समाचर .. 28 .. ..
5.173.m: Knowing this, O fortunate lady, do what is proper!”

5.173.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā devalokasyavajrapātopamaṃ vacaḥ ..
hāhākāraparā bhūtvā nipapāta dharātale .. 29 ..
5.173.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा देवलोकस्यवज्रपातोपमं वचः ..
हाहाकारपरा भूत्वा निपपात धरातले .. 29 ..
5.173.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of the world of the gods, resembling a thunderbolt strike, / she broke into loud lamentation and fell onto the surface of the earth.

5.173.s: chinnavṛkṣalatā yadvatpatitā sā tapasvinī .. 6.174.30 ..
5.173.d: छिन्नवृक्षलता यद्वत्पतिता सा तपस्विनी .. 6.174.30 ..
5.173.m: Like a creepers cut down from a tree, that ascetic woman fell.

5.173.s:
cirāyantyāṃ tu tasyāṃ sa yājñavalkyo mahāmuniḥ ..
śūnyaṃ tamāśramaṃ dṛṣṭvā papracchānyānmunīśvarān .. 31 ..
5.173.d:
चिरायन्त्यां तु तस्यां स याज्ञवल्क्यो महामुनिः ..
शून्यं तमाश्रमं दृष्ट्वा पप्रच्छान्यान्मुनीश्वरान् .. 31 ..
5.173.m: When she delayed, the great sage Yājñavalkya, / seeing the hermitage empty, asked the other best sages:

5.173.s:
kva ca me bhaginī yātā kaṃsārī sutapasvinī ..
tayā vinā'dya me sarvaṃ śūnyamāśramamaṃḍalam .. 32 ..
5.173.d:
क्व च मे भगिनी याता कंसारी सुतपस्विनी ..
तया विनाऽद्य मे सर्वं शून्यमाश्रममंडलम् .. 32 ..
5.173.m: “Where has my sister Kaṃsārī, the devout ascetic, gone? / Without her today, the entire circle of my hermitage is empty.”

5.173.s:
ācakhyau tāpasaḥ kaścidbhaginī te yavīyasī ..
niśceṣṭā patitā bhūmāvaśvatthasya samīpataḥ .. 33 ..
5.173.d:
आचख्यौ तापसः कश्चिद्भगिनी ते यवीयसी ..
निश्चेष्टा पतिता भूमावश्वत्थस्य समीपतः .. 33 ..
5.173.m: A certain ascetic declared: “Your younger sister, / motionless, has fallen onto the ground near the peepal tree.

5.173.s:
mayā dṛṣṭā muniśreṣṭha tāṃ tvaṃ bhāvaya mā ciram ..
athāsau tvarayā yuktaḥ saṃbhrāṃtastu pradhāvitaḥ .. .. 34 ..
5.173.d:
मया दृष्टा मुनिश्रेष्ठ तां त्वं भावय मा चिरम् ..
अथासौ त्वरया युक्तः संभ्रांतस्तु प्रधावितः .. .. 34 ..
5.173.m: She was seen by me, O best of sages; attend to her without delay!” / Then, filled with haste and agitated, he ran forth,

5.173.s:
yatra sā kathitā tena tāpasena tapasvinī ..
vīkṣate yāvattatrasthā śvasamānā vyavasthitā ..35..
5.173.d:
यत्र सा कथिता तेन तापसेन तपस्विनी ..
वीक्षते यावत्तत्रस्था श्वसमाना व्यवस्थिता ..35..
5.173.m: to where that ascetic woman had been reported by that ascetic; / as he looked, she was lying there, gasping for breath.

5.173.s:
atha toyena śītena secayitvā muhurmuhuḥ..
dattvā bhūyo'pi vātaṃ ca yāvaccakre sacetanām ..
tāvatkātyāyanī prāptā maitreyī ca sasaṃbhramam .. 36 ..
5.173.d:
अथ तोयेन शीतेन सेचयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः..
दत्त्वा भूयोऽपि वातं च यावच्चक्रे सचेतनाम् ..
तावत्कात्यायनी प्राप्ता मैत्रेयी च ससंभ्रमम् .. 36 ..
5.173.m: Then, sprinkling her again and again with cold water / and repeatedly fanning her, just as he brought her back to consciousness, / right then Kātyāyanī and Maitreyī arrived in great agitation:

5.173.s:
kimidaṃ kimidaṃ jātaṃ nanāṃdarvada mā ciram .. 37 ..
kiṃ vā sarpeṇa daṣṭāsi sannipātena dūṣitā .1
5.173.d:
किमिदं किमिदं जातं ननांदर्वद मा चिरम् .. 37 ..
किं वा सर्पेण दष्टासि सन्निपातेन दूषिता .1
5.173.m:
“What is this? What has happened, sister-in-law? Speak without delay!
Have you been bitten by a serpent, or afflicted by a morbid fever?

5.173.s: kiṃ vā bhūtagṛhītā'si māheṃdreṇa jvareṇa vā .. 38 ..
5.173.d: किं वा भूतगृहीताऽसि माहेंद्रेण ज्वरेण वा .. 38 ..
5.173.m: Or have you been possessed by a ghost, or seized by an intense fever?”

5.173.s:
atha sā cetanāṃ labdhvā yājña valkyaṃ puraḥ sthitam ..
bhāryayā sahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vrīḍayā'sūnmumoca ha .. 39 ..
5.173.d:
अथ सा चेतनां लब्ध्वा याज्ञ वल्क्यं पुरः स्थितम् ..
भार्यया सहितं दृष्ट्वा व्रीडयाऽसून्मुमोच ह .. 39 ..
5.173.m: Then, regaining consciousness and seeing Yājñavalkya standing before her / together with his wife, she gave up her life out of shame.

5.173.s:
atha tāṃ ca mṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā ruditvā ca ciraṃ dvijāḥ ..
yājñavalkyaḥ sabhāryastu dattvā vahniṃ ca śokadhṛk [.
jagāma svāśramaṃ paścāddattvā ca salilāñjalim .. 6.174.40 ..
5.173.d:
अथ तां च मृतां दृष्ट्वा रुदित्वा च चिरं द्विजाः ..
याज्ञवल्क्यः सभार्यस्तु दत्त्वा वह्निं च शोकधृक् [.
जगाम स्वाश्रमं पश्चाद्दत्त्वा च सलिलाञ्जलिम् .. 6.174.40 ..
5.173.m: Then, seeing her dead and weeping for a long time, O brahmins, / Yājñavalkya, accompanied by his wife, bearing sorrow, offered fire [for cremation], / and afterwards, having offered a handful of water, went to his own hermitage.

5.173.s:
so'pi bālo'tha vavṛdhe pippalāsvādapuṣṭidhṛk ..
aśvatthasya tale tasya vṛddhiṃ yāti śanaiḥśanaiḥ .. 41 ..
5.173.d:
सोऽपि बालोऽथ ववृधे पिप्पलास्वादपुष्टिधृक् ..
अश्वत्थस्य तले तस्य वृद्धिं याति शनैःशनैः .. 41 ..
5.173.m: That boy too grew, sustained by the taste of peepal berries; / beneath that peepal tree, he gradually attained growth.

5.173.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya nārado munisattamaḥ ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena tena mārgeṇa cāgataḥ .. 42 ..
5.173.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य नारदो मुनिसत्तमः ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन तेन मार्गेण चागतः .. 42 ..
5.173.m: Then, after some time, Nārada, the best of sages, / came along that path in the course of a pilgrimage to sacred fords.

5.173.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā bālakaṃ tatra dvādaśārkasamaprabham ..
ekākinaṃ vane śūnye pippalāsvādatatparam ..
papraccha vismayāviṣṭa ekākī ko bhavāniha .. 43 ..
5.173.d:
स दृष्ट्वा बालकं तत्र द्वादशार्कसमप्रभम् ..
एकाकिनं वने शून्ये पिप्पलास्वादतत्परम् ..
पप्रच्छ विस्मयाविष्ट एकाकी को भवानिह .. 43 ..
5.173.m: Seeing the boy there, radiant as twelve suns, / all alone in the deserted forest, intent on eating peepal berries, / he asked, filled with wonder: “Who are you here, all alone,

5.173.s:
vane śūnye mahāraudre siṃhavyāghrasamākule ..
kva te mātā pitā caiva kimarthaṃ ceha tiṣṭhasi .. 44 ..
5.173.d:
वने शून्ये महारौद्रे सिंहव्याघ्रसमाकुले ..
क्व ते माता पिता चैव किमर्थं चेह तिष्ठसि .. 44 ..
5.173.m: in this deserted, terrifying forest infested with lions and tigers? / Where are your mother and father, and for what purpose do you remain here?

5.173.s: nivasasi kathaṃ caiva sarvaṃ me vistarādvada .. 45 ..
5.173.d: निवससि कथं चैव सर्वं मे विस्तराद्वद .. 45 ..
5.173.m: And how do you live? Tell me everything in detail.”

5.173.s:
.. pippalāda uvāca .. .. ..
nāhaṃ jānāmi pitaraṃ mātaraṃ na ca bāṃdhavam ..
nāpi tvāṃ ko'tra cā yāto mama pārśve tu sāṃpratam .. 46 ..
5.173.d:
.. पिप्पलाद उवाच .. .. ..
नाहं जानामि पितरं मातरं न च बांधवम् ..
नापि त्वां कोऽत्र चा यातो मम पार्श्वे तु सांप्रतम् .. 46 ..
5.173.m: Pippalāda said: / “I do not know my father, nor my mother, nor any relative, / nor even who you are who have now come to my side.”

5.173.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. [.
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā munīśvaraḥ ..
tatastaṃ prahasanprāha jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā .. 47 ..
5.173.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. [.
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चिरं ध्यात्वा मुनीश्वरः ..
ततस्तं प्रहसन्प्राह ज्ञात्वा दिव्येन चक्षुषा .. 47 ..
5.173.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that statement of his, the lord of sages meditated for a long time; / then, having perceived [the truth] with his divine eye, he smiled and said to him:

5.173.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
mayā jñāto'si vatsa tvaṃ yājñavalkyasya retasā ..
daivayogātsamutpanno bhaginyā udare hyṛtau .. 48 ..
5.173.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
मया ज्ञातोऽसि वत्स त्वं याज्ञवल्क्यस्य रेतसा ..
दैवयोगात्समुत्पन्नो भगिन्या उदरे ह्यृतौ .. 48 ..
5.173.m: Nārada said: / “You are known to me, dear boy: you were born from the semen of Yājñavalkya, / by the turn of fate, in the womb of his sister during her fertile season.

5.173.s:
utathyaśāpadoṣeṇa devācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ ..
devakāryasya siddhyarthaṃ tasmāttacchṛṇu kāraṇam .. 49 ..
atharvavedo yaścaiṣa śataśākho vinirmitaḥ ..
śata kalpaśca gūḍhārtho bhūpānāṃ kāryasiddhaye ..6.174.5...
5.173.d:
उतथ्यशापदोषेण देवाचार्यो बृहस्पतिः ..
देवकार्यस्य सिद्ध्यर्थं तस्मात्तच्छृणु कारणम् .. 49 ..
अथर्ववेदो यश्चैष शतशाखो विनिर्मितः ..
शत कल्पश्च गूढार्थो भूपानां कार्यसिद्धये ..6.174.5...
5.173.m:
Through the flaw of Utathya's curse, you are Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods, [born] / for the fulfillment of the task of the gods; therefore listen to the reason for it.
This Atharva Veda, which was composed with a hundred branches / and a hundred rituals, having hidden meaning, for the success of kings' tasks—

5.173.s: navaśākhaḥ paṃcakalpastvayā kāryaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ..51..
5.173.d: नवशाखः पंचकल्पस्त्वया कार्यः सुखावहः ..51..
5.173.m: it must be rendered by you into nine branches and five rituals, bringing happiness.

5.173.s:
tava mātrā mahābhāga retasā ca pariplutam ..
yadvastraṃ yājñavalkyasya paridhānaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat ..52..
5.173.d:
तव मात्रा महाभाग रेतसा च परिप्लुतम् ..
यद्वस्त्रं याज्ञवल्क्यस्य परिधानं कृतं च यत् ..52..
5.173.m: By your mother, O fortunate one, the garment of Yājñavalkya / which was drenched with semen was worn,

5.173.s:
bhaginyā sutapasvinyā snānārthaṃ na ca kāmyayā ..
tadreto jalamiśraṃ tu bhagamadhye vinirgatam ..53..
5.173.d:
भगिन्या सुतपस्विन्या स्नानार्थं न च काम्यया ..
तद्रेतो जलमिश्रं तु भगमध्ये विनिर्गतम् ..53..
5.173.m: by that very ascetic sister, for bathing and not out of desire; / that semen, mixed with water, entered into the midst of her womb.”

5.173.s:
amoghaṃ tena saṃbhūtastvamatra jagatītale ..
mātā vai mṛtyumāpannā jñātvaivaṃ lajjayā tayā .. 54 ..
5.173.d:
अमोघं तेन संभूतस्त्वमत्र जगतीतले ..
माता वै मृत्युमापन्ना ज्ञात्वैवं लज्जया तया .. 54 ..
5.173.m: Being unfailing, by it you were born here on the surface of the earth. / Indeed, having realized this, your mother died out of shame.

5.173.s:
camatkārapure tubhyaṃ mātulo janakastathā ..
saṃtiṣṭhate mahābhāga tatpārśve tvamito vaja .. 55 ..
5.173.d:
चमत्कारपुरे तुभ्यं मातुलो जनकस्तथा ..
संतिष्ठते महाभाग तत्पार्श्वे त्वमितो वज .. 55 ..
5.173.m: In Camatkārapura, your maternal uncle who is also your father / resides, O fortunate one; go from here to his side.

5.173.s:
sāṃprataṃ vratakālaste varṣaṃ caivāṣṭamaṃ sthitam ..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya lajjayā'dhomukhaḥ sthitaḥ .. 56 ..
5.173.d:
सांप्रतं व्रतकालस्ते वर्षं चैवाष्टमं स्थितम् ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य लज्जयाऽधोमुखः स्थितः .. 56 ..
5.173.m: Now is the time for your sacred rite of initiation, and your eighth year has arrived.” / Having heard his words, [the boy] stood with downcast face in shame.

5.173.s:
tataścireṇa dīnaṃ sa vākyametaduvāca tam ..
kiṃ mayā pāpamākhyāhi pūrvadehāṃtare kṛtam .. 57
5.173.d:
ततश्चिरेण दीनं स वाक्यमेतदुवाच तम् ..
किं मया पापमाख्याहि पूर्वदेहांतरे कृतम् .. 57
5.173.m: Then, after a long time, he spoke these wretched words to him: / “Tell me, what sin did I commit in a previous life,

5.173.s:
yenedaṃ garhitaṃ janma viyogo mātṛsaṃbhavaḥ..
parityakṣyāmi jīvaṃ svaṃ duḥkhenānena sanmune ..58..
5.173.d:
येनेदं गर्हितं जन्म वियोगो मातृसंभवः..
परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवं स्वं दुःखेनानेन सन्मुने ..58..
5.173.m: Because of which [I have received] this deplorable birth, and separation from my mother has occurred? / I will abandon my own life out of this sorrow, O good sage!”

5.173.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
na tvayā duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcitpūrvadehāṃtare kṛtam ..
paraṃ yena susaṃjātaṃ tavedaṃ vyasanaṃ śṛṇu .. 59 ..
5.173.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
न त्वया दुष्कृतं किंचित्पूर्वदेहांतरे कृतम् ..
परं येन सुसंजातं तवेदं व्यसनं शृणु .. 59 ..
5.173.m: Nārada said: / “You committed no misdeed in any previous life. / But hear how this misfortune of yours has properly arisen.

5.173.s:
janmasthena bhavāñjātaḥ śaninā nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ..
tenāvasthāmimāṃ prāpto nānyadasti hi kāraṇam .. 6.174.60 ..
5.173.d:
जन्मस्थेन भवाञ्जातः शनिना नाऽत्र संशयः ..
तेनावस्थामिमां प्राप्तो नान्यदस्ति हि कारणम् .. 6.174.60 ..
5.173.m: You were born with Saturn in your ascendant; of this there is no doubt. / Because of that, you have reached this state; indeed there is no other cause.”

5.173.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ ..
ūrdhvamālokayāmāsa samuddiśya śanaiścaram .. 61 ..
tasya dṛṣṭinipātena nyapatatsa tu tatkṣaṇāt ..
vimānātsvādraveḥ putro yayātiriva nāhuṣaḥ ..62 .1
5.173.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य कोपसंरक्तलोचनः ..
ऊर्ध्वमालोकयामास समुद्दिश्य शनैश्चरम् .. 61 ..
तस्य दृष्टिनिपातेन न्यपतत्स तु तत्क्षणात् ..
विमानात्स्वाद्रवेः पुत्रो ययातिरिव नाहुषः ..62 .1
5.173.m:
Having heard his words, with eyes reddened with rage, / he looked upward, aiming at Śanaiścara.
At the fall of his gaze, he instantly fell down / from his aerial chariot, the son of the Sun, like Yayāti the son of Nahuṣa.

5.173.s:
adhovaktro dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ piturādeśamāśritaḥ ..
bālabhāve'pi tenaiva dagdhau pādau tadā raveḥ ..63..
5.173.d:
अधोवक्त्रो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः पितुरादेशमाश्रितः ..
बालभावेऽपि तेनैव दग्धौ पादौ तदा रवेः ..63..
5.173.m: Head downwards, O best of brahmins, abiding by his father’s instruction, / even in his infancy the two feet of the Sun were burnt by him at that time.

5.173.s:
atha taṃ nāradaḥ prāha patamānamadhomukham ..
bālyabhāvādanena tvaṃ pātito'si śanaiścara .. 64 ..
5.173.d:
अथ तं नारदः प्राह पतमानमधोमुखम् ..
बाल्यभावादनेन त्वं पातितोऽसि शनैश्चर .. 64 ..
5.173.m: Then Nārada spoke to him as he fell headlong: / “O Śanaiścara, you have been cast down by this one out of childhood nature.

5.173.s:
tasmānmā vīkṣayasvainaṃ bhaviṣyati prakopabhāk ..
mā patasva tathā bhūmau balānmadvākyasaṃbhavāt .. 65 ..
5.173.d:
तस्मान्मा वीक्षयस्वैनं भविष्यति प्रकोपभाक् ..
मा पतस्व तथा भूमौ बलान्मद्वाक्यसंभवात् .. 65 ..
5.173.m: Therefore do not gaze upon him, [lest] he become full of wrath! / Do not fall onto the earth by the force arising from my word!”

5.173.s:
staṃbhayitvā tathāpyevaṃ gaganasthaṃ śanaiścaram ..
tataḥ provāca taṃ bālaṃ pippalādaṃ munīśvaraḥ .. ..66..
5.173.d:
स्तंभयित्वा तथाप्येवं गगनस्थं शनैश्चरम् ..
ततः प्रोवाच तं बालं पिप्पलादं मुनीश्वरः .. ..66..
5.173.m: Having thus immobilized Śanaiścara remaining in the sky, / the lord of sages then spoke to that boy, Pippalāda:

5.173.s:
mā kopaṃ kuru bāla tvameṣa sūryasuto grahaḥ.
devānāmapi pīḍāṃ ca kurute'ṣṭamarāśigaḥ .. 67 ..
5.173.d:
मा कोपं कुरु बाल त्वमेष सूर्यसुतो ग्रहः.
देवानामपि पीडां च कुरुतेऽष्टमराशिगः .. 67 ..
5.173.m: “Do not be angry, O boy! He is the planet who is the son of the Sun; / he causes distress even to the gods when situated in the eighth zodiacal sign,

5.173.s:
janmasthastu viśeṣeṇa dvitīyastu tathāparaḥ ..
yadyeṣa kupitastvāṃ tu vīkṣayiṣyati karhicit .. 68 ..
5.173.d:
जन्मस्थस्तु विशेषेण द्वितीयस्तु तथापरः ..
यद्येष कुपितस्त्वां तु वीक्षयिष्यति कर्हिचित् .. 68 ..
5.173.m: And especially when situated in the ascendant, and likewise another [time when in] the second. / If he, being enraged, should ever gaze upon you,

5.173.s:
kariṣyati na saṃdeho bhasmarāśiṃ mamāgrataḥ ..
anena vīkṣitau pādau jātamātreṇa sūryakau .. .. 69 ..
5.173.d:
करिष्यति न संदेहो भस्मराशिं ममाग्रतः ..
अनेन वीक्षितौ पादौ जातमात्रेण सूर्यकौ .. .. 69 ..
5.173.m: He will, without doubt, reduce [you] to a heap of ashes before me! / As soon as he was born, the two feet of the Sun were gazed upon by him;

5.173.s:
āyātasya tu tuṣṭasya putradarśanavāñchayā ..
antardhānīkṛte vastre jñātvā taṃ raudracakṣuṣam .. 6.174.70 ..
5.173.d:
आयातस्य तु तुष्टस्य पुत्रदर्शनवाञ्छया ..
अन्तर्धानीकृते वस्त्रे ज्ञात्वा तं रौद्रचक्षुषम् .. 6.174.70 ..
5.173.m: For knowing him to possess terrible eyes, when his garment was made to vanish / as [the Sun] arrived pleased with a desire to see his son,

5.173.s:
tato dagdhāvubhau cāpi tiṣṭhataścarma veṣṭitau ..
dṛśyete'dyāpi mūrttau tau ghaṭitāyāṃ dharātale .. 71 ..
5.173.d:
ततो दग्धावुभौ चापि तिष्ठतश्चर्म वेष्टितौ ..
दृश्येतेऽद्यापि मूर्त्तौ तौ घटितायां धरातले .. 71 ..
5.173.m: Then both [his feet] were burnt, and they remain wrapped in skin; / even today the two are seen in the image fashioned on the surface of the earth.”

5.173.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya nāradasya sa bālakaḥ ..
bhayena mahatā yuktastataḥ papraccha taṃ munim .. 72 ..
5.173.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य नारदस्य स बालकः ..
भयेन महता युक्तस्ततः पप्रच्छ तं मुनिम् .. 72 ..
5.173.m: Sūta said: / Having heard those words of Nārada, that young boy, / filled with great fear, then asked that sage:

5.173.s:
kathaṃ yāsyati me tuṣṭiṃ vadaiṣa mama sanmune ..
ajñānātpātito vyomnaḥ śaktiṃ cāsyāvijānatā .. 73 .. ..
5.173.d:
कथं यास्यति मे तुष्टिं वदैष मम सन्मुने ..
अज्ञानात्पातितो व्योम्नः शक्तिं चास्याविजानता .. 73 .. ..
5.173.m: “Tell me, O good sage, how will he be pleased with me? / Out of ignorance and not knowing his power, I caused him to fall from the sky.”

5.173.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
grahā gāvo nareṃdrāśca brāhmaṇāśca viśeṣataḥ ..
pūjitāḥ pratipūjyaṃte nirdahaṃtyapamānitāḥ .. 74 ..
5.173.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
ग्रहा गावो नरेंद्राश्च ब्राह्मणाश्च विशेषतः ..
पूजिताः प्रतिपूज्यंते निर्दहंत्यपमानिताः .. 74 ..
5.173.m: Nārada said: / “Planets, cows, kings, and especially brahmins: / when honored, they honor in return; when dishonored, they burn down.

5.173.s:
tasmātkuru stutiṃ cāsya svaśaktyā bhāskareḥ prabho..
prasādaṃ gacchate yena kopaṃ tyajati pātajam .. 75 ..
5.173.d:
तस्मात्कुरु स्तुतिं चास्य स्वशक्त्या भास्करेः प्रभो..
प्रसादं गच्छते येन कोपं त्यजति पातजम् .. 75 ..
5.173.m: Therefore, sing a hymn of praise to this son of the Sun to the best of your ability, O noble one, / so that he may grant grace and abandon the anger born of his fall.”

5.173.s:
tataḥ kṛtāṃjalirbhūtvā stutiṃ cakre sa bālakaḥ ..
bhayena mahatā yuktastataḥ saṃpṛcchya taṃ munim .. 76 ..
5.173.d:
ततः कृतांजलिर्भूत्वा स्तुतिं चक्रे स बालकः ..
भयेन महता युक्तस्ततः संपृच्छ्य तं मुनिम् .. 76 ..
5.173.m: Then, having joined his palms, that boy uttered a hymn of praise; / filled with great fear, having then inquired of that sage,

5.173.s:
pippalādo dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ..
namaste krodhasaṃsthāya piṃgalāya namo'stu te .. 77 ..
5.173.d:
पिप्पलादो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः ..
नमस्ते क्रोधसंस्थाय पिंगलाय नमोऽस्तु ते .. 77 ..
5.173.m: Pippalāda, O best of brahmins, bowing down again and again [said]: / ‘Homage to you who are situated in anger! Homage be to you who are tawny!

5.173.s:
namaste vasurūpāya kṛṣṇāya ca namo'stu te ..
namaste raudradehāya namaste cāṃtakāya ca .. 78 ..
5.173.d:
नमस्ते वसुरूपाय कृष्णाय च नमोऽस्तु ते ..
नमस्ते रौद्रदेहाय नमस्ते चांतकाय च .. 78 ..
5.173.m: Homage to you whose form is a Vasu! Homage be to you who are black! / Homage to you of terrible body! Homage to you who are the Ender!

5.173.s:
namaste yamasaṃjñāya namaste sauraye vibho ..
namaste mandasaṃjñāya śanaiścara namo'sstu te .. 79 ..
prasādaṃ kuru deveśa dīnasya praṇatasya ca ..6.174.8...
5.173.d:
नमस्ते यमसंज्ञाय नमस्ते सौरये विभो ..
नमस्ते मन्दसंज्ञाय शनैश्चर नमोऽस्स्तु ते .. 79 ..
प्रसादं कुरु देवेश दीनस्य प्रणतस्य च ..6.174.8...
5.173.m:
Homage to you named Yama! Homage to you, the son of Sūrya, O omnipresent one! / Homage to you named Manda! Homage be to you, Śanaiścara!
Show grace, O lord of the gods, to the wretched one who has bowed down!’

5.173.s:
.. śanaiścara uvāca .. ..
parituṣṭo'smi te vatsa stotreṇānena sāṃpratam..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yena yacchāmi sāṃpratam .. 81 ..
5.173.d:
.. शनैश्चर उवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते वत्स स्तोत्रेणानेन सांप्रतम्..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते येन यच्छामि सांप्रतम् .. 81 ..
5.173.m: Śanaiścara said: / ‘I am thoroughly pleased with you, child, by this praise now. / Choose a boon—may it be well with you—which I shall grant right now.’

5.173.s:
pippalāda uvāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti no pīḍā bālānāṃ sūryanandana ..
tvayā kāryā mahābhāga svakīyā ca kathaṃcana .. 82 ..
5.173.d:
पिप्पलाद उवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति नो पीडा बालानां सूर्यनन्दन ..
त्वया कार्या महाभाग स्वकीया च कथंचन .. 82 ..
5.173.m: Pippalāda said: / ‘From this day forth, O son of the Sun, no affliction of children / should ever be caused by you, O fortunate one, in your own [influence],

5.173.s:
yāvadvarṣāṣṭamaṃ jātaṃ mama vākyena sūryaja ..
stotreṇānena yo'tra tvāṃ stūyātprātaḥ samutthitaḥ .. .. 83 ..
5.173.d:
यावद्वर्षाष्टमं जातं मम वाक्येन सूर्यज ..
स्तोत्रेणानेन योऽत्र त्वां स्तूयात्प्रातः समुत्थितः .. .. 83 ..
5.173.m: Until the eighth year is reached, according to my word, O son of the Sun! / Whoever here praises you with this hymn, having risen early in the morning,

5.173.s:
tasya pīḍā na kartavyā tvayā bhāskaranandana ..
tava vāre ca saṃjāte tailābhyaṃgaṃ karoti yaḥ .. 84 ..
5.173.d:
तस्य पीडा न कर्तव्या त्वया भास्करनन्दन ..
तव वारे च संजाते तैलाभ्यंगं करोति यः .. 84 ..
5.173.m: Affliction should not be caused to him by you, O son of the Sun! / And whoever, on the occurrence of your weekday, performs an oil-massage,

5.173.s:
dināṣṭakaṃ na kartavyā tasya pīḍā kathaṃcana ..
yastvāṃ lohamayaṃ kṛtvā tailamadhye hyadhomukham.. 85 ..
5.173.d:
दिनाष्टकं न कर्तव्या तस्य पीडा कथंचन ..
यस्त्वां लोहमयं कृत्वा तैलमध्ये ह्यधोमुखम्.. 85 ..
5.173.m: For eight days no affliction should ever be caused to him. / And he who, having fashioned you out of iron, faces [the idol] downward in the middle of oil,

5.173.s:
dhārayettena tailena tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ..
tasya pīḍā na kartavyā deyo lābho mahībhujaḥ ..96 ..
5.173.d:
धारयेत्तेन तैलेन ततः स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
तस्य पीडा न कर्तव्या देयो लाभो महीभुजः ..96 ..
5.173.m: Should hold [it] and then perform a bath with that oil— / affliction should not be caused to him, [and] the gain of kings should be bestowed [on him].

5.173.s:
adhyarddhāṣṭamikāyoge tāvake saṃsthite naraḥ ..
tavavāre tu saṃprāpte yastilām̐llohasaṃyutān .. 97 ..
svaśaktyā rāti no tasya pīḍā kāryā tvayā vibho ..
kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ yastu viprāya tavoddeśena yacchati .. 88 ..
5.173.d:
अध्यर्द्धाष्टमिकायोगे तावके संस्थिते नरः ..
तववारे तु संप्राप्ते यस्तिलाम्̐ल्लोहसंयुतान् .. 97 ..
स्वशक्त्या राति नो तस्य पीडा कार्या त्वया विभो ..
कृष्णां गां यस्तु विप्राय तवोद्देशेन यच्छति .. 88 ..
5.173.m:
When a man is under your seven-and-a-half-year transit, / and having arrived on your weekday, who gives sesamum seeds combined with iron,
According to his ability, you must not cause him distress, O lord! / And whoever gives a black cow to a brahmin in your name,

5.173.s:
adhyarddhāṣṭamajā pīḍā nā'sya kāryā tvayā vibho ..
śamī samidbhiryo homaṃ tavoddeśena yacchati .. 99 ..
tathā kṛṣṇatilaiścaiva kṛṣṇapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ..
pūjāṃ karoti yastubhyaṃ dhūpaṃ vai guggulaṃ dahet ..
kṛṣṇavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya tyājyā tasya vyathā tvayā .. 6.174.90 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktaḥ śanistena bāḍhamityeva jalpya ca ..
nāradaṃ samanujñāpya jagāma nijasaṃ śrayam.. 91 ..
nārado'pi tamādāya vālakaṃ kṛpayānvitaḥ ..
camatkārapuraṃ gatvā yājñavalkyāya cārpayat .. 92 ..
kathayāmāsa vṛttāṃtaṃ tasya saṃbhūti saṃbhavam..
yaddṛṣṭaṃ jñānadīpena tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat..93..
eṣa te vīryasaṃbhūto bālako bhaginīsutaḥ ..
mayā'śvatthatale labdhaḥ kānane'śvatthasaṃnidhau .. 94 ..
5.173.d:
अध्यर्द्धाष्टमजा पीडा नाऽस्य कार्या त्वया विभो ..
शमी समिद्भिर्यो होमं तवोद्देशेन यच्छति .. 99 ..
तथा कृष्णतिलैश्चैव कृष्णपुष्पानुलेपनैः ..
पूजां करोति यस्तुभ्यं धूपं वै गुग्गुलं दहेत् ..
कृष्णवस्त्रेण संवेष्ट्य त्याज्या तस्य व्यथा त्वया .. 6.174.90 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तः शनिस्तेन बाढमित्येव जल्प्य च ..
नारदं समनुज्ञाप्य जगाम निजसं श्रयम्.. 91 ..
नारदोऽपि तमादाय वालकं कृपयान्वितः ..
चमत्कारपुरं गत्वा याज्ञवल्क्याय चार्पयत् .. 92 ..
कथयामास वृत्तांतं तस्य संभूति संभवम्..
यद्दृष्टं ज्ञानदीपेन तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयत्..93..
एष ते वीर्यसंभूतो बालको भगिनीसुतः ..
मयाऽश्वत्थतले लब्धः काननेऽश्वत्थसंनिधौ .. 94 ..
5.173.m:
You must not cause him distress born of the seven-and-a-half-year period, O lord! / Whoever offers a fire oblations with śamī wood sticks in your name,
And likewise with black sesamum seeds, black flowers, and ointments, / and performs worship to you, and burns guggulu incense, / having wrapped [the image] in black cloth—his torment must be abandoned by you.’
Sūta said: / Thus addressed by him, Śani, saying ‘So be it!’, / and having taken leave of Nārada, went to his own abode.
Nārada too, taking that boy, filled with compassion, / went to Camatkārapura and delivered him to Yājñavalkya.
He told the whole narrative regarding his birth; / everything that he saw by the lamp of knowledge, he reported to him:
‘This boy, born of your semen, is your sister’s son; / he was found by me at the foot of an aśvattha tree in the forest near the aśvattha tree.

5.173.s:
vratabaṃdha kuruṣvāsya sāṃprataṃ cāṣṭavārṣikaḥ ..
nātra doṣosti vipreṃdra na bhaginyāstathā tava ..
tasmādgṛhāṇa putraṃ svaṃ bhāgineyaṃ viśeṣataḥ .. .. 95 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā sa devarṣistataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
yājñavalkyo'pi tacchrutvā viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 96 ..
pāpaṃ tacciṃtayanneva na śāṃtimadhigacchati ..
ātmānaṃ garhayannityaṃ divānaktaṃ ca śocati .. 97 ..
taṃ ca putraṃ parijñāya taistaiścihnairnijaiḥ sthitaiḥ ..
tatastu poṣayitvā taṃ vratena samayojayat .. 99 ..
5.173.d:
व्रतबंध कुरुष्वास्य सांप्रतं चाष्टवार्षिकः ..
नात्र दोषोस्ति विप्रेंद्र न भगिन्यास्तथा तव ..
तस्माद्गृहाण पुत्रं स्वं भागिनेयं विशेषतः .. .. 95 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा स देवर्षिस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
याज्ञवल्क्योऽपि तच्छ्रुत्वा विषादं परमं गतः .. 96 ..
पापं तच्चिंतयन्नेव न शांतिमधिगच्छति ..
आत्मानं गर्हयन्नित्यं दिवानक्तं च शोचति .. 97 ..
तं च पुत्रं परिज्ञाय तैस्तैश्चिह्नैर्निजैः स्थितैः ..
ततस्तु पोषयित्वा तं व्रतेन समयोजयत् .. 99 ..
5.173.m:
Perform his sacred thread investiture; he is now eight years old. / There is no fault here, O chief of brahmins, neither for your sister nor for you. / Therefore accept your own son, and especially your nephew!’”
Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, that divine seer then vanished from sight. / Hearing that, Yājñavalkya too fell into supreme despondency.
Constantly brooding on that sin, he found no peace. / Continually reproaching himself, he grieved day and night.
And having recognized that son by various distinctive bodily marks of his own, / he then reared him and invested him with the sacred vow.

5.173.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye pippalādotpattiva rṇanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 174 ..
5.173.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्या संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखंडे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पिप्पलादोत्पत्तिव र्णनंनाम चतुःसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 174 ..
5.173.m: Thus ends the one hundred seventy-fourth chapter, entitled "Description of the Birth of Pippalāda," in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.174.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ saṃśocate yāvadātmānaṃ parigarhayan..
tatastu brahmaṇā proktaḥ svayamabhyetya bho dvijāḥ..1..
5.174.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं संशोचते यावदात्मानं परिगर्हयन्..
ततस्तु ब्रह्मणा प्रोक्तः स्वयमभ्येत्य भो द्विजाः..1..
5.174.m: Sūta said: / While he was grieving thus, severely reproaching himself, / Brahmā came in person and spoke to him, O twice-born!

5.174.s:
tvayā śaṃkā na kartavyā sutasyāsya kṛte dvija..
ajñānādeva te jāto daivayogena bālakaḥ..2..
5.174.d:
त्वया शंका न कर्तव्या सुतस्यास्य कृते द्विज..
अज्ञानादेव ते जातो दैवयोगेन बालकः..2..
5.174.m: "You should not have any doubt on account of this son, O twice-born! / Through ignorance alone was this boy born to you, by the working of fate.

5.174.s:
..yājñavalkya uvāca.. ..
tathāpi deva me śuddhirhṛdayasya na jāyate ..
tasmādvada suraśreṣṭha prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye..3..
5.174.d:
..याज्ञवल्क्य उवाच.. ..
तथापि देव मे शुद्धिर्हृदयस्य न जायते ..
तस्माद्वद सुरश्रेष्ठ प्रायश्चित्तं विशुद्धये..3..
5.174.m: Yājñavalkya said: / Even so, O Lord, purification does not arise in my heart. / Therefore, O foremost of gods, declare an expiation for complete purification."

5.174.s:
.. brahmovāca.. ..
yadi te cittaśuddhistu na kathaṃcitpravartate..
tatsthāpaya mahābhāga liṃgaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ .. 4 ..
5.174.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच.. ..
यदि ते चित्तशुद्धिस्तु न कथंचित्प्रवर्तते..
तत्स्थापय महाभाग लिंगं देवस्य शूलिनः .. 4 ..
5.174.m: Brahmā said: / "If purification of your heart does not occur in any way, / then, O highly fortunate one, install a liṅga of the trident-bearing god.

5.174.s:
ajñānājjñānatovāpi yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
brahmahatyādikaṃ cāpi strīvadhādvāpi yadbhavet..5 ..
5.174.d:
अज्ञानाज्ज्ञानतोवापि यत्पापं कुरुते नरः ..
ब्रह्महत्यादिकं चापि स्त्रीवधाद्वापि यद्भवेत्..5 ..
5.174.m: Whatever sin a man commits out of ignorance or even knowingly, / such as the murder of a brahmin, or whatever may arise from killing a woman—

5.174.s:
paṃceṣṭikāmayaṃ vāpi yaḥ kuryāddharamandiram..
tasya tannāśamāyāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā .. 6 ..
5.174.d:
पंचेष्टिकामयं वापि यः कुर्याद्धरमन्दिरम्..
तस्य तन्नाशमायाति तमः सूर्योदये यथा .. 6 ..
5.174.m: whoever builds a temple for Hara, even of five bricks, / that [sin] of his goes to destruction, like darkness at sunrise;

5.174.s:
viśeṣeṇa mahābhāga hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhave ..
kṣetre tatra sumedhye tu sarvapātakanāśane .. 7 ..
5.174.d:
विशेषेण महाभाग हाटकेश्वरसंभवे ..
क्षेत्रे तत्र सुमेध्ये तु सर्वपातकनाशने .. 7 ..
5.174.m: especially, O highly fortunate one, in that very holy sacred field, the source of Hāṭakeśvara, / which destroys all sins.

5.174.s:
kalikāle ca saṃprāpte yatra pāpaṃ na vidyate ..
ahamapyatra vāṃchāmi yajñaṃ kartuṃ dvijottama .. 8 ..
5.174.d:
कलिकाले च संप्राप्ते यत्र पापं न विद्यते ..
अहमप्यत्र वांछामि यज्ञं कर्तुं द्विजोत्तम .. 8 ..
5.174.m: Where no sin exists even when the Kali age has arrived; / I too desire to perform a sacrifice there, O best of the twice-born!

5.174.s:
ānayiṣyāmi tattīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ cātmanaḥ priyam ..
kalikālabhayāccaitadyāvanno vyarthatāṃ vrajet .. 9 ..
5.174.d:
आनयिष्यामि तत्तीर्थं पुष्करं चात्मनः प्रियम् ..
कलिकालभयाच्चैतद्यावन्नो व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् .. 9 ..
5.174.m: I shall bring that sacred ford, Puṣkara, which is dear to me, / lest it go to ruin out of fear of the Kali age.

5.174.s:
kalikāle tu saṃprāpte tīrthāni sakalāni ca ..
yāsyaṃti vyarthatāṃ vipra muktvedaṃ kṣetramuttamam .. 6.175.10 ..
5.174.d:
कलिकाले तु संप्राप्ते तीर्थानि सकलानि च ..
यास्यंति व्यर्थतां विप्र मुक्त्वेदं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् .. 6.175.10 ..
5.174.m: When the Kali age has arrived, all sacred fords / will go to ruin, O brahmin, except for this supreme sacred field."

5.174.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā caturvaktrastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
yājñavalkyo'pi tacchrutvā pitāmahavaco' khilam .. 11 ..
5.174.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा चतुर्वक्त्रस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
याज्ञवल्क्योऽपि तच्छ्रुत्वा पितामहवचो' खिलम् .. 11 ..
5.174.m: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, the four-faced one then vanished from sight. / Yājñavalkya too, hearing all the words of the Grandfather,

5.174.s:
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa jñātvā kṣetramanuttamam..
abravīcca tato vākyaṃ meghagaṃbhīrayā girā .. 12 ..
5.174.d:
लिंगं संस्थापयामास ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रमनुत्तमम्..
अब्रवीच्च ततो वाक्यं मेघगंभीरया गिरा .. 12 ..
5.174.m: installed a liṅga, knowing that unexcelled sacred field, / and then spoke these words with a voice deep as a thundercloud:

5.174.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ yo liṃgaṃ māmakaṃ tvidam ..
snāpayiṣyati sadbhaktyā tasya pāpaṃ prayāsyati .. 13 ..
5.174.d:
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां यो लिंगं मामकं त्विदम् ..
स्नापयिष्यति सद्भक्त्या तस्य पापं प्रयास्यति .. 13 ..
5.174.m: "Whoever bathes this liṅga of mine with true devotion / on the eighth and the fourteenth [lunar day], his sin shall depart.

5.174.s:
paradārakṛtaṃ yacca mātrāpi ca samaṃ kṛtam..
kṣālayiṣyati tatpāpaṃ snāpitaṃ pūjitaṃ paraiḥ .. 14 ..
5.174.d:
परदारकृतं यच्च मात्रापि च समं कृतम्..
क्षालयिष्यति तत्पापं स्नापितं पूजितं परैः .. 14 ..
5.174.m: Whatever [sin] was committed with another's wife, or even committed with one's mother, / [this liṅga,] bathed and worshipped by others, shall wash away that sin.

5.174.s:
asminnahani saṃprāpte tasya pakṣasamudbhavam ..
prayāsyati kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yadajñānādvinirmitam .. 15 ..
5.174.d:
अस्मिन्नहनि संप्राप्ते तस्य पक्षसमुद्भवम् ..
प्रयास्यति कृतं पापं यदज्ञानाद्विनिर्मितम् .. 15 ..
5.174.m: When this day arrives, the sin born of that fortnight / which was committed out of ignorance shall depart from him."

5.174.s:
tataḥprabhṛti vikhyāto yājñava lkyeśvaraḥ śubhaḥ ..
tasminkṣetre dvijaśreṣṭhā hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñake .. 16 ..
5.174.d:
ततःप्रभृति विख्यातो याज्ञव ल्क्येश्वरः शुभः ..
तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे द्विजश्रेष्ठा हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञके .. 16 ..
5.174.m: From then on, O best of the twice-born, the auspicious Yājñavalkyeśvara / became famous in that sacred field named Hāṭakeśvara.

5.174.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye yājñavalkyeśvarotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 175 ..
5.174.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये याज्ञवल्क्येश्वरोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 175 ..
5.174.m: Thus ends the one hundred seventy-fifth chapter, entitled "Description of the Origin and Māhātmya of Yājñavalkyeśvara," in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.175.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dṛṣṭvā pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ yājñavalkyena dhīmatā ..
svamātuḥ śuddhihetoḥ sa tannāmnā liṃgamuttamam .. 1 ..
5.175.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
दृष्ट्वा प्रतिष्ठितं लिंगं याज्ञवल्क्येन धीमता ..
स्वमातुः शुद्धिहेतोः स तन्नाम्ना लिंगमुत्तमम् .. 1 ..
5.175.m: Sūta said: / Having seen the liṅga consecrated by the wise Yājñavalkya, / he, for the sake of his mother's purification, [installed] an excellent liṅga in her name.

5.175.s:
sthāpayāmāsa vipreṃdrāḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ..
tataścānīya vipreṃdraṃ madhyagaṃ nāgarodbhavam .. ..
gartātīrthasamudbhūtamāhitāgniṃ prayājinam ..
yathaitannagarasthānaṃ tathā tvamapi dīkṣitaḥ .. 3 ..
5.175.d:
स्थापयामास विप्रेंद्राः श्रद्धया परया युतः ..
ततश्चानीय विप्रेंद्रं मध्यगं नागरोद्भवम् .. ..
गर्तातीर्थसमुद्भूतमाहिताग्निं प्रयाजिनम् ..
यथैतन्नगरस्थानं तथा त्वमपि दीक्षितः .. 3 ..
5.175.m: Filled with supreme faith, he installed [it], O best of brahmins! / And then, having brought a leader of brahmins, an inhabitant of the middle region, born among the Nāgaras, / born at Gartātīrtha, an Āhitāgni, an officiating priest, [he said:] / 'Just as this is a city-settlement, so you too are an initiated [priest].

5.175.s:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu gotrāṇāṃ nāyakatve vyavasthitaḥ ..
tava vākyena sarvāṇi gotrāṇi dvijasattama .. 4 ..
5.175.d:
अष्टषष्टिषु गोत्राणां नायकत्वे व्यवस्थितः ..
तव वाक्येन सर्वाणि गोत्राणि द्विजसत्तम .. 4 ..
5.175.m: Established in the leadership among the sixty-eight gotras, / by your word, O best of the twice-born, all gotras

5.175.s:
vartayiṣyaṃti kṛtyeṣu yāvaccandrārkatārakāḥ ..
govardhana tvayā ciṃtā kāryā cāsya samudbhavā .. 5 ..
5.175.d:
वर्तयिष्यंति कृत्येषु यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकाः ..
गोवर्धन त्वया चिंता कार्या चास्य समुद्भवा .. 5 ..
5.175.m: shall carry out their rites as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure. / O Govardhana, care regarding this must be taken by you.

5.175.s:
liṃgasya pūjanārthāya preraṇīyāśca nāgarāḥ..
pūjayā tasya liṃgasya vṛddhiṃ yāsyati te'nvayaḥ .. 6 ..
5.175.d:
लिंगस्य पूजनार्थाय प्रेरणीयाश्च नागराः..
पूजया तस्य लिंगस्य वृद्धिं यास्यति तेऽन्वयः .. 6 ..
5.175.m: The Nāgaras are to be prompted to worship the liṅga. / Through worship of that liṅga your lineage will increase.

5.175.s:
apūjayā vināśaṃ ca yāsyatyatra na saṃśayaḥ ..
tava vaṃśodbhavā ye ca pūjayitvā prabhaktitaḥ .. 7 ..
5.175.d:
अपूजया विनाशं च यास्यत्यत्र न संशयः ..
तव वंशोद्भवा ये च पूजयित्वा प्रभक्तितः .. 7 ..
5.175.m: Through non-worship it will go to destruction; there is no doubt about this. / And those born of your lineage who, having worshipped with intense devotion,

5.175.s:
etalliṃgaṃ kariṣyaṃti kṛtyāni vividhānica ..
tāni siddhiṃ prayāsyaṃti prasādādasya dīkṣita .. 8 ..
5.175.d:
एतल्लिंगं करिष्यंति कृत्यानि विविधानिच ..
तानि सिद्धिं प्रयास्यंति प्रसादादस्य दीक्षित .. 8 ..
5.175.m: this liṅga, will perform various rites— / those [rites] will attain success by its grace, O initiated one!'

5.175.s:
.. govardhana uvāca .. ..
ahamarcāṃ kariṣyāmi liṃgasyāsya sadā dvija ..
bhaktiṃ ca prakariṣyāmi hetorasya hetorasya kṛte dvija ..
pūjārthaṃ caiva ye cānye mama vaṃśasamudravāḥ .. 9 ..
5.175.d:
.. गोवर्धन उवाच .. ..
अहमर्चां करिष्यामि लिंगस्यास्य सदा द्विज ..
भक्तिं च प्रकरिष्यामि हेतोरस्य हेतोरस्य कृते द्विज ..
पूजार्थं चैव ये चान्ये मम वंशसमुद्रवाः .. 9 ..
5.175.m: Govardhana said: / "I shall always perform the worship of this liṅga, O twice-born! / And I shall display devotion on this account, on this account, O twice-born, / and also for the sake of worship, those others who are born in my lineage [shall do so]."

5.175.s:
.. pippalāda uvāca .. ..
govardhana drutaṃ viprāṃstatra cānaya nāgarān..
teṣāṃ matena devasya nāmamātraṃ karomyaham .. 6.176.10 ..
5.175.d:
.. पिप्पलाद उवाच .. ..
गोवर्धन द्रुतं विप्रांस्तत्र चानय नागरान्..
तेषां मतेन देवस्य नाममात्रं करोम्यहम् .. 6.176.10 ..
5.175.m: Pippalāda said: / "O Govardhana, quickly bring the N競争gara brahmins here; / according to their opinion, I shall confer the name upon the god."

5.175.s:
tataścānāyayāmāsa viprāṃścaiva vicakṣaṇān ..
śrutādhyayanasaṃpannānyajñakarmaparāyaṇān .. 11 ..
5.175.d:
ततश्चानाययामास विप्रांश्चैव विचक्षणान् ..
श्रुताध्ययनसंपन्नान्यज्ञकर्मपरायणान् .. 11 ..
5.175.m: Thereupon he caused the wise brahmins to be brought, / endowed with learning in the sacred scriptures and devoted to sacrificial rites.

5.175.s:
tānabravītpraṇamyoccaiḥ pippalādo mahāmuniḥ ..
mama mātā mṛtā pūrvaṃ kaṃsārīti ca nāmataḥ .. 12 ..
5.175.d:
तानब्रवीत्प्रणम्योच्चैः पिप्पलादो महामुनिः ..
मम माता मृता पूर्वं कंसारीति च नामतः .. 12 ..
5.175.m: Having bowed to them, the great sage Pippalāda spoke aloud: / "My mother, Kaṃsārī by name, previously died.

5.175.s:
tasyā uddeśato liṃgaṃ mayaitatsaṃpratiṣṭhitam ..
yuṣmadvākyātprasiddhiṃ ca prayātu dvijasattamāḥ .. 13 ..
5.175.d:
तस्या उद्देशतो लिंगं मयैतत्संप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
युष्मद्वाक्यात्प्रसिद्धिं च प्रयातु द्विजसत्तमाः .. 13 ..
5.175.m: In her name, this liṅga has been consecrated by me. / By your word, O best of the twice-born, let it attain fame!

5.175.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ yaścaitatsnāpayiṣyati ..
yājñavalkyeśvarotthaṃ ca sa vai śreyo hyavāpsyati .. 14 ..
5.175.d:
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां यश्चैतत्स्नापयिष्यति ..
याज्ञवल्क्येश्वरोत्थं च स वै श्रेयो ह्यवाप्स्यति .. 14 ..
5.175.m: And whoever bathes it on the eighth and the fourteenth [lunar day], / along with the one arising from Yājñavalkyeśvara, he shall indeed attain the highest good."

5.175.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha tairbrāhmaṇaiḥ sarvaistasya nāma pratiṣṭhitam ..
kaṃsārīśvara ityevaṃ gauravāttasya sanmu neḥ .. 15 ..
5.175.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ तैर्ब्राह्मणैः सर्वैस्तस्य नाम प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
कंसारीश्वर इत्येवं गौरवात्तस्य सन्मु नेः .. 15 ..
5.175.m: Sūta said: / Then, by all those brahmins, out of respect for that virtuous sage, / its name was established as 'Kaṃsārīśvara'.

5.175.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭho'smi dvijottamāḥ ..
kaṃsārīśvarasaṃjñastu yathā jātastu pāpahā ..
sthāpitaḥ pippalādena svayaṃ caiva mahātmanā .. 16 ..
5.175.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्ठोऽस्मि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
कंसारीश्वरसंज्ञस्तु यथा जातस्तु पापहा ..
स्थापितः पिप्पलादेन स्वयं चैव महात्मना .. 16 ..
5.175.m: All this, about which I was asked, has been related to you, O best of the twice-born, / how the sin-destroying [liṅga] named Kaṃsārīśvara came to be, / installed by the high-souled Pippalāda himself.

5.175.s:
yaścaitatpuṇyamākhyānaṃ tasya devasya saṃnidhau ..
saṃpaṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi samyakchaktisamanvitaḥ .. 17 ..
5.175.d:
यश्चैतत्पुण्यमाख्यानं तस्य देवस्य संनिधौ ..
संपठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि सम्यक्छक्तिसमन्वितः .. 17 ..
5.175.m: And whoever reads or listens to this sacred narrative / in the presence of that god, endowed with full capacity,

5.175.s:
manasā ciṃtitaṃ pāpaṃ paradārakṛtaṃ ca yat ..
tasya tannāśamāyāti pippalāda vaco yathā .. 18 ..
5.175.d:
मनसा चिंतितं पापं परदारकृतं च यत् ..
तस्य तन्नाशमायाति पिप्पलाद वचो यथा .. 18 ..
5.175.m: whatever sin was conceived in the mind or committed with another's wife, / that [sin] of his goes to destruction, in accordance with the words of Pippalāda.

5.175.s:
yastasya purato bhaktyā nīlarudrā nsadā japet ..
prāṇarudrānviśeṣeṇa bhavarudrasamanvitān .. 19 ..
5.175.d:
यस्तस्य पुरतो भक्त्या नीलरुद्रा न्सदा जपेत् ..
प्राणरुद्रान्विशेषेण भवरुद्रसमन्वितान् .. 19 ..
5.175.m: He who with devotion constantly recites the Nīlarudras before it, / especially the Prāṇarudras together with the Bhavarudras,

5.175.s:
brahmahatyodbhavaṃ caiva api tasya praṇaśyati ..
paracakrabhaye jāte hyanā vṛṣṭibhaye tathā .. 6.176.20 ..
5.175.d:
ब्रह्महत्योद्भवं चैव अपि तस्य प्रणश्यति ..
परचक्रभये जाते ह्यना वृष्टिभये तथा .. 6.176.20 ..
5.175.m: And the [sin] arising from the murder of a brahmin is also destroyed for him. / When danger from a foreign army arises, and likewise when there is fear of drought, 6.176.20

5.175.s:
atharvavede sādyaṃte paṭhite tasya cāgrataḥ ..
śatrurvilayamabhyeti vṛṣṭiḥ sañjāyate drutam .. 21 ..
5.175.d:
अथर्ववेदे साद्यंते पठिते तस्य चाग्रतः ..
शत्रुर्विलयमभ्येति वृष्टिः सञ्जायते द्रुतम् .. 21 ..
5.175.m: and the Atharvaveda is recited completely from beginning to end before him, / the enemy goes to destruction, and rain quickly falls. 21

5.175.s:
rājadauḥsthye samutpanne rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
sarvarogavinirmuktaḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ .. 22 ..
5.175.d:
राजदौःस्थ्ये समुत्पन्ने राजा भवति धार्मिकः ..
सर्वरोगविनिर्मुक्तः प्रजापालनतत्परः .. 22 ..
5.175.m: When misfortune befalls the king, the king becomes righteous, / freed from all disease, and intent on protecting his subjects. 22

5.175.s:
upasargabhaye jāte tasya doṣaḥ praśāmyati ..
śanaiḥ śanairasaṃdigdhaṃ pippalādavaco yathā .. 23 ..
5.175.d:
उपसर्गभये जाते तस्य दोषः प्रशाम्यति ..
शनैः शनैरसंदिग्धं पिप्पलादवचो यथा .. 23 ..
5.175.m: When fear of affliction arises, his defect is pacified / slowly and surely, according to the words of Pippalāda. 23

5.175.s:
kiṃ vā te bahunoktena yatkiṃcidvyasanaṃ mahat ..
tattasya vyasanaṃ kiṃcidatharvaṇaḥ prakī rtanāt .. 24 ..
5.175.d:
किं वा ते बहुनोक्तेन यत्किंचिद्व्यसनं महत् ..
तत्तस्य व्यसनं किंचिदथर्वणः प्रकी र्तनात् .. 24 ..
5.175.m: Or what need is there to say much to you? Whatever great distress there is, / that distress of his, from reciting the [hymns of the] Atharvan, 24

5.175.s: asya devasya purato yāti nāśaṃ ca vai drutam .. 25 ..
5.175.d: अस्य देवस्य पुरतो याति नाशं च वै द्रुतम् .. 25 ..
5.175.m: goes quickly to destruction before this deity. 25

5.175.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kaṃsāreśvarotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 176 ..
5.175.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कंसारेश्वरोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्सप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 176 ..
5.175.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-sixth chapter, named “The Description of the Māhātmya of the Origin of Kaṃsāreśvara,” in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 176
